meta.title: 走遍美国 Family Album U.S.A.

lines.en: Excuse me. My name is Richard Stewart.
May I take a picture of you and your little boy?
lines.cn: 我可以替你和你的小男孩拍一张照吗？

lines.en: I call it Family Album, U.S.A.
Well, it's fine if you take our picture.
lines.cn: 你想拍我们的照就请吧。

lines.en: Thank you. I appreciate your help.

lines.cn: 噢，欢迎你们到纽约来。好了，请稍等一下，我快要准备就绪了。
好了，请稍等一下，我快要准备就绪了。
请握住 Gerald 的手，很好！
现在请指着那些建筑物，

lines.en: Give Mommy a kiss, Gerald. Nice!
We'll be looking for your book.
Hey, let me take your picture!

lines.cn: 噢，它尚未完成，但我手头有一些照片，要不要看一看？

lines.en: but I have some of the pictures.
lines.cn: 噢，它尚未完成，但我手头有一些照片，

lines.en: Would you like to see them?
Here they are. Family Album, U.S.A.
It's an album of pictures of the United States: the cities, the special places, and the people.
lines.cn: 是关于美国的一些城市、一些特别的地方以及人们的摄影选辑。

lines.en: And these are pictures of people working: steelworkers, bankers, police, street vendors, ambulance drivers, doctors....
lines.cn: 这是工作中人们的照片：钢架工人、银行职员、警察、街头小贩、救护车驾驶、医生等等。

lines.en: Oh, this is my father. He's a doctor.
lines.cn: 噢，这是我父亲，他是一名医生。

lines.en: She works for a toy company.
lines.cn: 她在一家玩具公司工作。

lines.en: Here's my grandfather. He lives in Florida.
lines.cn: 这是我祖父，他住在 Florida。

lines.en: And this is my wife Marilyn.
Thanks. And what about your family?
That's a large city in northern Greece.
lines.cn: 那是希腊北部的一个大城市。

lines.en: But now I'm living in the Bronx.
I have to meet my wife.
It was a pleasure meeting you, too.
And good luck! I've got to go.
Bye-bye. Richard! Richard! You left your bag!
lines.cn: 再见。Richard！Richard！你掉了一个旅行袋！

lines.en: Can you tell me how to get to Linden Street, in Riverdale?
lines.cn: 你能告诉我怎么去 Riverdale 的林登街吗？

lines.en: "Richard Stewart, 46 Linden Street, Riverdale, New York."
You should take the number 1 subway.
Is there a station near here?
You should take the number 1 train
lines.cn: 你该搭 1 路到 Van Cortland 公园下车。
有，地铁站在那边。你该搭 1 路到 Van Cortland 公园下车。

lines.en: Number 1 train to Van Cortlandt Park. Thank you.
lines.cn: 一路车到 Van Cortland 公园，谢谢。

lines.en: Remember, the number 1 train. The uptown platform.
lines.cn: 记住，搭一路车，在北月台。

lines.en: Is this pink too bright for me?
lines.cn: 我穿粉红色会不会太过鲜艳？

lines.en: Mmm-hmm. It is a very bright pink.
lines.cn: 是的，这种粉红是亮了点。
试试这一件，尺码是八号。

lines.en: How about green? It's size ten.
lines.cn: 绿的怎么样？它是十号的。

lines.en: I'm taking too much of your time.
I was expecting him here at five forty-five.
lines.cn: 我们约好了五点四十五在这会面的。

lines.en: Don't worry. The traffic is very heavy at this hour.
lines.cn: 别担心，这个时间交通很拥挤。

lines.en: I know. But we're going to be late for dinner.
lines.cn: 我知道，但我们晚餐可要迟到了。

lines.en: I like the color on me, don't you?
lines.cn: 我觉得这种颜色较适合我，你说呢？

lines.en: I think it looks terrific on you.

lines.cn: 对不起，我迟到了这么久，

lines.en: I had a really bad day.
It's ten after six. We're late.
lines.cn: 现在是六点十分，我们迟了。

lines.en: Robbie's cooking tonight, and dinner's at six thirty.
lines.cn: 今晚 Robbie 做饭，晚餐六点半开始。

lines.en: I know. I know. I'm really sorry.
lines.cn: 我知道，我知道，真的很抱歉。

lines.en: I left my bag of film on the ferry.
lines.cn: 我把装底片的旅行袋遗放在渡船上了，

lines.en: I went back for it, but the ferry was gone.
lines.cn: 等我回去找的时候，船已经开走了，

lines.en: I lost a whole day's work.
lines.cn: 我丢掉一整天的工作成果。

lines.en: I'll call the Staten Island Ferry lost-and-found office.
lines.cn: 我来打电话给 Staten Island 渡轮的失物招领处。

lines.en: I didn't think of that. Thanks.
lines.cn: 我倒没有想到这个法子，谢了。
喂，我想问一下 Staten Island 渡轮失物招领处的电话号码。

lines.en: of the Staten Island Ferry lost-and-found office.
lines.cn: 我想问一下 Staten Island 渡轮失物招领处的电话号码。

lines.en: Five five five...zero eight zero eight.
Did anyone find a camera bag this afternoon,
lines.cn: 请问今天下午有人捡到一个照相机旅行袋吗，一个小的粗帆布袋，是在 J. F. Kennedy 渡船上丢的…
喂，请问今天下午有人捡到一个照相机旅行袋吗，一个小的粗帆布袋，是在 J. F. Kennedy 渡船上丢的……没有吗？

lines.en: on the J. F. Kennedy Ferry?...No?
The name is Stewart, Richard Stewart.
And the telephone number is five five five...
three oh nine oh. Thank you.
Sorry, Richard. They don't have it.
lines.cn: 对不起，Richard，他们那没有。不管怎样，

lines.en: There was a girl on the ferry.
Tell me about it on the way home.
lines.cn: 在回家的路上告诉我吧。

lines.en: And give her a teaspoon of the medicine after every meal.
lines.cn: 每餐之后给她吃一茶匙的药。
好啦，Marilyn 和 Richard 打电话来了，

lines.en: They'll be here soon, and then we'll eat.
lines.cn: 他们马上就到，一到就开饭。

lines.en: She has to work late tonight.
lines.cn: 她今晚得工作得晚一些。

lines.en: And what's Robbie cooking for dinner? Robbie
lines.cn: Robbie 为晚餐准备了什么？

lines.en: Robbie, the dinner was terrific. Robbie

lines.cn: Robbie！别愁，我们有很多冰淇淋。

lines.en: We've got lots of ice cream.
lines.cn: 别愁，我们有很多冰淇淋。

lines.en: Oh, I'd love some ice cream.
Well, there's chocolate and coffee and a little vanilla.
lines.cn: 好的，这有巧克力冰淇淋、咖啡冰淇淋和一点香草的。

lines.en: Is that all right with everyone?
Uh, one scoop of coffee and one scoop of chocolate for me.
lines.cn: 我要一勺咖啡的和一勺巧克力的。

lines.en: Robbie, will you help me serve? Robbie
I keep thinking about that bag of film. Eight rolls.
lines.cn: 我一直在想着旅行袋的事，一共有八卷，

lines.en: Does Richard Stewart live here? Richard Stewart

lines.cn: 是的，他是我哥哥，我叫 Robbie，

lines.en: Your brother left his bag of film on the ferryboat.
lines.cn: 你哥哥将他的旅行袋遗放在渡船上了，

lines.en: I'm really glad to see you.
lines.cn: 非常高兴见到你——我的意思是，

lines.en: I mean...my brother'll be really glad to see you!
lines.cn: 我哥哥见到你会非常高兴！

lines.en: Hello, Richard. I found your bag!
lines.cn: 你好，Richard，我找到了你的旅行袋！

lines.en: Richard showed me your photo. Richard
lines.cn: Richard 给我看了你的照片，

lines.en: Richard told us all about you. Richard
And this is my mother, Ellen Stewart.
And my father, Dr. Philip Stewart.
lines.cn: 这是我父亲，Philip Stewart 医生。
你已经见过 Robbie 了。

lines.en: Yes. And you must be Susan. Hi.
lines.cn: 是的，一定是 Susan 了，

lines.en: I'm so glad you found the bag and took the time and trouble to return it.
lines.cn: 我很高兴你发现了旅行袋，而且不怕麻烦，花时间将它送来。

lines.en: I just took the wrong train.
Would you like something to eat?
I'm late for dinner at my house.
lines.cn: 我回家吃晚饭要迟到了，

lines.en: Would you like to call home?
Alexandra's a high-school exchange student from Greece. Alexandra
lines.cn: Alexandra 是从希腊来的交换高中生，

lines.en: With a family in the Bronx.
lines.cn: 住在 Bronx 区的一个家庭。

lines.en: Oh, that's not too far from here!
I can only stay a few minutes.
Where do you go to school?
At the Bronx High School of Science.
lines.cn: 在 Bronx 区的理科中学读书。

lines.en: Oh, that's a very good school.
Richard tells me you're a doctor. Richard
And what does your father do?

lines.cn: 他是 Thessaloniki 的一名律师。

lines.en: It might be a little cold.
Thanks, no. I do have to go.
lines.cn: 谢谢了，不用，我真的得走了，

lines.en: It was nice meeting you all.
lines.cn: 很高兴见到你们一家人。

lines.en: Well, maybe you'll come for lunch some Sunday, so we can really thank you for bringing Richard's bag back.
lines.cn: 或许哪个星期天能来吃中饭，让我们好好地感谢你送回 Richard 的旅行包。

lines.en: The train is just up the street.
lines.cn: 谢谢，地铁车就在街的那一头，

lines.en: It won't take me long at all.
Well, you really saved the day for me, Alexandra.
She's a smart young lady, and very nice.
lines.cn: 她是个聪明的年轻姑娘，而且很善良。

lines.en: Very! Hey, she forgot her bag!
lines.cn: 非常！嘿，她忘了她的旅行袋！

lines.en: I guess we'll be seeing Alexandra again.
lines.cn: 我想我们不久又将见到 Alexandra，对吧，

lines.en: Excuse me. Can you help me?
That's easy. Walk to the corner.

lines.cn: 你走到拐角然后向左转。

lines.en: Then walk two blocks to the traffic light.

lines.cn: 再向左转就到了 Wooster 街了。

lines.en: To the corner and then a left?

lines.cn: 要热狗吗，只要七十五分钱。

lines.en: No. Thank you. I have a dinner date.
lines.cn: 谢谢。我要去赴晚餐约会。
我想找 Wooster 街 83 号。

lines.en: Yes. Wooster Street is two blocks,
lines.cn: 噢 Wooster 街还有两个街区，

lines.en: and 83 is to the right, about two houses.
lines.cn: 83 号是在右边，大约过两栋房子就到了。
我是 Harry Bennett。你是 Susan 吗？

lines.en: Hello, Harry. It's nice to meet you.
lines.cn: 你好 Harry 很高兴见到你。

lines.en: The traffic. The parking. I was lost.
lines.cn: 交通拥挤，又找不到停车的地方。我又迷路了。

lines.en: Don't worry about being late. It's fine.
lines.cn: 别为迟到担心了，没有关系。

lines.en: Excuse the mess. I just moved here.
lines.cn: 请别介意这里很乱，我刚搬来。

lines.en: Oh, I'd like you to meet my sister-in-law Marilyn.
lines.cn: 噢，我来向你介绍我嫂子 Marilyn。

lines.en: Marilyn Stewart, this is Harry Bennett.

lines.cn: 我也很高兴见到你 Harry。

lines.en: Are we too late for our dinner reservation?
lines.cn: 我们会不会错过晚餐的预订时间？

lines.en: No, the restaurant will hold our table.
lines.cn: 不会，餐厅会保留我们的席位。

lines.en: I know the owner very well.
Do you know the phone number of the restaurant?
lines.cn: 你知道那家餐厅的电话号码吗？

lines.en: I'd like to call home and leave the number with the baby-sitter.
lines.cn: 我想打电话回家。把餐厅的电话告诉临时保姆。

lines.en: Sure. The number is... five five five...seventeen twenty.
Five five five...one seven two oh. Hello?

lines.cn: 我能跟 Betty 说话吗？

lines.en: I want to leave the phone number of the restaurant...
lines.cn: 我要留餐厅的电话号码给她。

lines.en: Hi, Betty. I'll be at five five five...seventeen twenty.
lines.cn: 你好，Betty。到时候可以打 555……1720 找我。

lines.en: Well, that's done. Shall we go?
lines.cn: 好了，打完了。我们可以走了吗？

lines.en: I'm ready. See you later, Marilyn.
Bye, Marilyn. Hope to see you again.
lines.cn: 再见 Marilyn。希望能再看到你。

lines.en: This is my friend Harry Bennett.
lines.cn: 这是我的朋友 Harry Bennett。

lines.en: Any friend of Miss Stewart's is welcome at Somsak's.
lines.cn: Stewart 小姐的朋友到我的餐厅都受欢迎。

lines.en: I do, too. I come here often.
A special place for special people.
lines.cn: 这是为特殊人物而设的特别地方。

lines.en: Would you like something to drink?
Yes, I'd like a glass of ginger ale with ice.
lines.cn: 是的，我要一杯加冰的姜味汽水。

lines.en: Do you have a dry white wine?
lines.cn: 你这里有干白葡萄酒吗？
来一杯加利福尼亚的夏布利白葡萄酒怎么样？

lines.en: What would you like to eat?

lines.cn: 我要一份 mee krob（泰式酥脆炒面）。

lines.en: Harry, would you like to see a menu?
I'll have the mee krob also.
Crispy fried noodles. I love them.
lines.cn: 酥脆的炒面。我很喜欢吃。

lines.en: May I bring you a salad?

lines.cn: 我向你们推荐玫瑰花沙拉。

lines.en: What? Oh, yes. Starving. Well, I...
lines.cn: 什么，噢，是，我很饿。好啦，我……

lines.en: What do you do at Universe Toy Company?
lines.cn: 你在宇宙玩具公司做什么工作？

lines.en: I'm the vice-president of new toy development.
lines.cn: 我是负责新玩具开发的副总裁。
我知道你是一位注册会计师。

lines.en: I do some work for Smith and Dale, Your company's accounting firm.
lines.cn: 我为贵公司的会计顾问公司 Smith 和 Dale 事务所做一些工作。

lines.en: I know. How old is she?
That's a nice age. What's her name?
lines.cn: 正是很好的年纪。她叫什么名字？

lines.en: Do you have a picture of her?
And there's a phone call for you, Mr. Bennett.
I'll get the rest of the dinner.
lines.cn: 我去把晚餐的其余东西端来。

lines.en: I have to leave. I feel terrible, but...
lines.cn: 我得走了。我实在很过意不去，但是……

lines.en: I don't know. The baby-sitter says she has a stomachache, and she's crying.
lines.cn: 我不知道。临时保姆说她肚子疼，她一直哭。

lines.en: Of course. I'm so sorry for Michelle.
lines.cn: 当然。我为 Michelle 担心。

lines.en: And you didn't have a chance to eat.
Let me take you home first.

lines.cn: 这是我们的第一次约会。

lines.en: I hope your daughter is all right. Good-bye.
lines.cn: 我希望你女儿安然无恙。再见。

lines.en: I think she has a stomachache.
So... what do you think of him?
But I think he was nervous tonight.
lines.cn: 但我想他今晚有点紧张。

lines.en: It was his first date in two years.
lines.cn: 这是他两年来第一次约会。

lines.en: He didn't get a thing to eat.
You ordered enough for three or four people, but I'm not complaining.
lines.cn: 你叫了够三四个人吃的，不过我可没有抱怨。

lines.en: No. You won't believe it, Marilyn!
I believe it. Even without looking.
Your downstairs neighbor let me in.
lines.cn: 楼下的邻居让我进来的。

lines.en: I did , but everything is OK, so I decided to come back.
lines.cn: 回去了，不过一切都没事，于是我决定回来。

lines.en: To apologize for leaving so early, I brought you a little gift.
lines.cn: 为了表示我对提早走掉的歉意，我给你带了一件小礼物。

lines.en: It's a bonsai tree for your new apartment.
lines.cn: 这是一棵盆景树，送给你装点新公寓。

lines.en: Hi, Marilyn. I hope it's not too late.
lines.cn: 你好，Marilyn。希望我来得不算太晚。

lines.en: Oh, not at all. We're still eating.
lines.cn: 噢，没关系。我们还在吃着呢。

lines.en: It's our meal from the restaurant.
lines.cn: 这是从餐厅带回来的菜。

lines.en: It was only a tummy ache.
It's good that you went back.
Yes, I think it's important for me to be there since her mother died.
lines.cn: 是的，我觉得陪在她身边很重要，因为她妈妈去世了。

lines.en: As a matter of fact... I am hungry.
I have a lot of work to do to get ready for tomorrow.
lines.cn: 我得为明天做许多准备工作。

lines.en: Good night, Harry. It was nice meeting you.
She's going to a fashion show here in the city tomorrow.
lines.cn: 她将参加明天在本市举行的时装表演。

lines.en: She is sleeping here so she won't have to travel from Riverdale in the morning.
lines.cn: 她晚上住在这儿。免得早上从 Riverdale 赶过来。
你们两个关系一定很好。

lines.en: The whole Stewart family is close.
And then, two years ago, my wife died.
lines.cn: 接著，两年前我妻子去世了。

lines.en: I do...yes, but I have Michelle... and with time...
lines.cn: 不错……是的，但我还有 Michelle……而且随着时间流逝……

lines.en: Is there anyone else in your life?
lines.cn: 你现在还有其他交往对象吗？

lines.en: No, not yet. What about you?
Oh, I date occasionally, but my work keeps me busy.
lines.cn: 哦，我偶尔约会，但我老是忙于工作。

lines.en: Ooh, speaking of keeping busy- I have an early start tomorrow, and the baby-sitter has to get home.
lines.cn: 哦，说到忙于工作。我明天还得早起，而且临时保姆也该回家了。
让我过了一个愉快的夜晚。

lines.en: I'd like to meet your daughter someday.
lines.cn: 我希望有一天能见到你女儿。

lines.en: Does that mean that I can see you again?
lines.cn: 那是不是说，我可以再约你见面？

lines.en: and we'll go out to dinner.
lines.cn: 我会打电话给你，我们再一起出去吃晚饭。

lines.en: I promise I won't leave early.
lines.cn: 我发誓我再也不会早走了。

lines.en: It was for a good reason.
lines.cn: 你今天早走是有原因的。

lines.en: I think we're going to be good friends.
lines.cn: 我想我们可以成为好朋友。

lines.en: I never liked that umbrella stand.
Marilyn, you want coffee or tea?

lines.cn: 我感到好兴奋，明早这时候，爷爷就和我们一起坐在厨房啦。

lines.en: Grandpa will be sitting in the kitchen with us.
lines.cn: 明早这时候，爷爷就和我们一起坐在厨房啦。

lines.en: Are we picking him up at the station?
He doesn't want anybody picking him up.
Oh, let's go upstairs and prepare Grandpa's room.
lines.cn: 对，我们上去整理爷爷的房间。

lines.en: We are going upstairs to set up Grandpa's room.
lines.cn: 我们要上楼收拾一下爷爷的房间。

lines.en: I'm really excited about seeing Grandpa.
lines.cn: 一想到要见到爷爷，我就觉得兴奋。

lines.en: I hope Grandpa's going to like living with us.
lines.cn: 我希望爷爷喜欢和我们住在一起。

lines.en: It just takes time to feel comfortable in a new place.
lines.cn: 总需要一段时间才能适应一个新的环境。

lines.en: Won't he miss being in Florida?
lines.cn: 他不会想念佛罗里达吗？

lines.en: But I think he'll like being here with the family.
lines.cn: 但我想他会喜欢在这里和家人一起生活。

lines.en: It's crazy here most of the time.
You know, maybe I'll put together some photos of Grandpa as a "welcome" present.
lines.cn: 你知道吗，也许我可以把爷爷的一些照片整理在一起，作为欢迎他的礼物。

lines.en: I have a picture of Grandpa and Dad and me in my wallet.
lines.cn: 我皮夹有张照片是爷爷爸爸和我一起照的。

lines.en: It's from the Fathers and Sons' Breakfast at my junior high school graduation.
lines.cn: 那是在父子早餐上拍的。在我初中毕业的时候。

lines.en: I'd really like to pick up Grandpa at the railroad station.
lines.cn: 我真想去火车站接爷爷。

lines.en: Railroad stations or airports. Grandpa always tells us he'll get here by himself.
lines.cn: 无论是火车站或机场。爷爷总是告诉我们，他会自己到这里来。
这里面都是爷爷的东西吗？

lines.en: But I'm sure he has a few bags with him on the train.
lines.cn: 不过我相信他在火车上还有几件行李的。

lines.en: I want to put some of my good hangers in Grandpa's closet.
lines.cn: 我想在爷爷的衣柜放几个好衣架。

lines.en: You know I'm very excited about his arrival.
lines.cn: 你知道，我对他的到来非常兴奋。
Susan 今天一大早打来电话。
Susan 今天一大早打来电话。她很不开心，因为她得到芝加哥出差。而且要到今晚才能脱身。

lines.en: because she's had to go to Chicago on a business trip
lines.cn: 她很不开心，因为她得到芝加哥出差。而且要到今晚才能脱身。
Susan 今天一大早打来电话。她很不开心，因为她得到芝加哥出差。而且要到今晚才能脱身。

lines.en: She wants to be here for Grandpa.
Well, Grandpa will be disappointed, too.
She always reminds him of Grandma.
lines.cn: Susan 总是让他想起奶奶。

lines.en: Fine. We were just wondering about this trunk.

lines.en: I just saw a big one!
He's up there at the lodge.
OK, Robbie, maybe you should watch him.
It's almost lunchtime, and no fish yet.
lines.cn: 差不多到午餐时间，还没钓到鱼。

lines.en: I can go up to the lodge for some hot dogs and drinks.
lines.cn: 我可以到那边小屋，去弄些热狗和饮料来。

lines.en: We're here to catch our lunch.
lines.cn: 我们要在这钓我们的午餐。

lines.en: To catch fish, you need the right magic.
lines.cn: 要钓得到鱼，你得用对魔法。

lines.en: Well, first, you have to turn your hat around like this.
lines.cn: 首先，你得把你的帽子转一下，像这样。

lines.en: Then you close your eyes and say the magic words.
lines.cn: 然后，闭上眼睛念那咒语。

lines.en: Fish, fish, send me a fish.
Fish, fish, send me a fish.... I got one!
lines.cn: 鱼，鱼，给我一条鱼……我钓到了！

lines.en: Well, it always worked for me, too.
lines.cn: 嗯，这办法对我也屡试不爽。
慢慢来 Philip 慢慢来。

lines.en: Well, one more and I've got a pair of boots.
lines.cn: 嗯，再钓一只我就有一双靴子了。

lines.en: You didn't say the magic words.
Yes, but you did, and we've got our lunch.
lines.cn: 没错，但你念了，我们钓到了午餐。

lines.en: Let's build a fire and cook it!
Come on, Albert, you can help us!
I want to stay here and fish.
I hope you like your fish well done.
lines.cn: 我希望你们喜欢吃熟透了的鱼。

lines.en: Hey, I'm a doctor, not a chef.
lines.cn: 嘿，我是个医生，又不是厨师。

lines.en: Bring a blanket and my medical bag.
lines.cn: 拿一条毯子和我的医疗箱来。

lines.en: Now, come on, son. Come on, son.
Oh, it's going to be all right.
Wrap him in the blanket, Dad!
Easy now. Easy does it. That's it.
lines.cn: 放松，慢慢来。对，就是这样。

lines.en: Your dad is quite a guy.
How can I thank all of you?
He pulled him out of the water.
lines.cn: 是他把你孩子从水里拉上来的。

lines.en: I'm so thankful to all of you.
Well, what do you say we get back to our fishing?
lines.cn: 好啦，我们回去继续钓鱼，怎么样？

lines.en: I have to get to a phone.
It probably means we can't stay.
lines.cn: 看来我们不能待在这了。

lines.en: One of my patients has a high fever, and I have to go to the hospital.
lines.cn: 我的一位病人发高烧，我得赶去医院。

lines.en: I guess I ruined your day.
lines.cn: 我想我扫了你今天的兴。

lines.en: You didn't ruin my day, Dad.
Why are you back so early?
lines.cn: 你们怎么这么早就回来了？

lines.en: Philip had to go back to the hospital.
No, Mom. We had a great time.
lines.cn: 不，妈妈。我们玩得很高兴。

lines.en: Well, did you do any fishing?
Yeah, we caught lots of them. Look!
lines.cn: 当然，我们抓到不少鱼。看！

lines.en: They had a special on frozen fish down at the supermarket.
Oh, you really had a bad day.
Robbie pulled a boy out of the water.
lines.cn: Robbie 从水中救出一个孩子。
爸爸是个了不起的医生，妈妈。

lines.en: How about a cup of coffee, Son?
I'd love a cup of coffee.
Until today, I was never really interested in medicine.
lines.cn: 直到今天，我才对医学真正感兴趣。

lines.en: I had a good time today, Robbie.
lines.cn: 我今天玩得很开心 Robbie。

lines.en: Why don't we do it again?

lines.cn: 我准备把工作重新安排一下。

lines.en: Well, do we have a date?
lines.cn: 怎样，我们算是约定了吗？

lines.en: But I think you two can have a good time together without me.
lines.cn: 不过，我想没有我，你们两个也能一起玩得很开心。

lines.en: No, Dad, and certainly not without the right magic.
lines.cn: 不，爸爸，而且没有你的魔法更是绝对不行。

lines.en: OK, Philip. This is your third cup of coffee.
lines.cn: 好啦 Philip。这是你第三杯咖啡了。

lines.en: We should get to work, or we won't be finished by dinnertime.
lines.cn: 我们得开始做事了，要不然晚餐时间到了我们还做不完。

lines.en: OK. The beginning of my famous Thanksgiving apple pie.
lines.cn: 开始做我拿手的感恩节苹果派。

lines.en: One apple. Two apples. Three apples. Four apples.
lines.cn: 一个苹果。两个苹果。三个苹果。四个苹果。

lines.en: Get busy with your famous apple pie.
lines.cn: 快做你拿手的苹果派吧。

lines.en: There's much more to be done.
What goes into my apple pie besides apples?
lines.cn: 除了苹果以外，我的派还要放什么？

lines.en: Butter, nice and cold and hard.
Last but not least, the reason my apple pie is famous--cinnamon.
lines.cn: 最后但同等重要的一个，我的苹果派就是靠它出名的，肉桂。

lines.en: If there is any cinnamon, it's in the cabinet with the salt and pepper.
lines.cn: 要是有的话，应该在橱柜里，和盐、胡椒放在一起。

lines.en: Salt, pepper, dill weed, garlic powder, cinnamon. Ellen?
lines.cn: 盐，胡椒，莳萝，大蒜粉，肉桂。Ellen？

lines.en: Is it possible that we forgot to buy cinnamon?
lines.cn: 是不是我们忘了买肉桂？

lines.en: Yes, it is possible that we forgot to buy cinnamon.
lines.cn: 是的，我们可能忘了买肉桂。

lines.en: Well, how can I make my famous apple pie without cinnamon?
lines.cn: 这下好啦，没有肉桂，我那道著名的苹果派怎么做？

lines.en: Can you do me a favor?
Remember my apple pie on Thanksgiving?
lines.cn: 记得在感恩节我做的苹果派？

lines.en: What do you love about it?
lines.cn: 你最喜欢它的什么地方？

lines.en: Right. We don't have any cinnamon.
I'll go down to Henry's grocery. He's always open.
lines.cn: 我到亨利杂货店去。那总是开门营业。

lines.en: Oh, put your heavy jacket on, Robbie.
lines.cn: 把你的厚夹克穿上 Robbie。

lines.en: Tell her I'll call her right back.
lines.cn: 告诉她我会马上给她回电话的。

lines.en: Uh, why does he always have to slam the door?
lines.cn: 唉，他为什么总是要把门关得砰砰响？

lines.en: Hello.... Hello, Alexandra. How are you? ... Fine.
Robbie just went to the store.

lines.cn: 他说了他要给你打电话。

lines.en: ... Oh, oh, I see.... Oh ... certainly. ...
Well, do you have the phone number there?
lines.cn: 那么，你知道那里的电话号码吗？

lines.en: ... Oh ... I see.... Please, I know he wants to talk to you.... ...
lines.cn: 哦，我明白了。请再打来，我知道他想和你说话……

lines.en: Thank you, and happy Thanksgiving to you and your family, too.
lines.cn: 谢谢，祝你和你的全家感恩节愉快。

lines.en: Try to come by later for dessert.... Bye.
lines.cn: 晚些时候尽量过来吃甜点……再见。

lines.en: She and the Molinas are going to spend Thanksgiving with their cousins.
lines.cn: 她和 Molinas 一家。准备与亲戚一起过感恩节。

lines.en: She doesn't have the phone number.
lines.cn: 她不知道那儿的电话号码。

lines.en: Maybe she'll call back. She promised.
lines.cn: 也许她会打电话回来。她说了。

lines.en: It was a dollar and sixty cents.
You forgot to ask me for the change.
lines.cn: 你忘了问我要找回的零钱。

lines.en: Or did you forget to give it to me?
She said she'll call you later.
lines.cn: 她说她等会儿给你电话。

lines.en: You should have your breakfast, Son.

lines.cn: 这样才会让你觉得舒服些。

lines.en: It's nice to see young love.... Oh, to be young again!
lines.cn: 真高兴看见年轻人相爱……。啊，能再恢复年轻多好！

lines.en: The Thanksgiving Day parade is always such great fun.
lines.cn: 感恩节的游行总是如此有趣。

lines.en: Wowee! Just floating along high above Central Park West.
lines.cn: 哇！它正高高地飘在中央公园西路上空。

lines.en: Oh, and the bands and the music.
lines.cn: 哦，还有那些乐队和音乐。

lines.en: Da dada da da dada da da da da da da dada.
lines.cn: 哒，哒哒，哒，哒，哒哒，哒，哒，哒，哒，哒，哒，哒哒。

lines.en: Oh, look at that float, Robbie.
Maybe so, but parades always make me feel like a kid.
lines.cn: 也许是，但这些游行总是让我觉得像小孩子。

lines.en: Remember when you and your dad and I went to the Thanksgiving Day parade?
lines.cn: 还记得你，你爸爸和我。去参加感恩节游行？

lines.en: You were four or five years old, I think.
Yes, he missed a phone call from Alexandra.
lines.cn: 对，他没接到 Alexandra 打来的电话。

lines.en: Yes, I know, but he'll get over it.
lines.cn: 是的，我知道，过一下就会好的。

lines.en: Good. Then you'll be here about five?
lines.cn: 很好。那么大约在五点左右来？

lines.en: I look forward to seeing you and Harry and Michelle.
lines.cn: 我盼着见到你、Harry 和 Michelle。
尝尝 Ellen 做的火鸡填馅。

lines.en: It's my favorite part of the meal.
lines.cn: 这是全餐中我最爱吃的部分。

lines.en: What about my famous apple pie?
Dad, your apple pie is my favorite dessert.
lines.cn: 爸爸，你做的苹果派是我最爱吃的甜点。

lines.en: Philip, would you join me in the kitchen, please?
lines.cn: Philip，请你到厨房来帮我一下，好吗？
你只要放轻松陪陪爷爷就行了。

lines.en: I'll get you to help serve later.
lines.cn: 等一会我会叫你帮忙分菜。

lines.en: Ellen reminds me so much of Grandma.
What time does the Michigan football game come on?
lines.cn: Michigan 队的美式橄榄球比赛几点开始？

lines.en: I'll be back to see the game.
Grandpa, when did Dad graduate from Michigan?
lines.cn: 爷爷，爸爸是什么时候从 Michigan 毕业？

lines.en: He graduated from medical school in 1960 and from the University of Michigan in 1956.
lines.cn: 他在 1960 年从医学院毕业，一九五六年从 Michigan 大学毕业。

lines.en: Did you go to Michigan, too, Grandpa?
lines.cn: 爷爷，你也在 Michigan 大学读过书吗？
是的。我是一九三七年毕业的。

lines.en: I've got to start thinking about college soon.
lines.cn: 我很快也得开始考虑大学的事了。

lines.en: I want to welcome Harry and his daughter Michelle to Thanksgiving with us.
lines.cn: 我想对 Harry 和他女儿 Michelle。来参加我们的感恩节晚餐表示欢迎。

lines.en: But first, I think we should take a moment and remember the meaning of Thanksgiving.
lines.cn: 不过首先，我想我们应该用一两分钟。来追忆一下感恩节的意义。

lines.en: Philip, I took Michelle to a school play about the first Thanksgiving.
lines.cn: Philip，我带 Michelle 看过学校演出的一出戏，第一次感恩节历史剧。

lines.en: Well, why don't you tell us about that, Michelle?
lines.cn: 那好，能否给我们讲一讲 Michelle？

lines.en: Thanksgiving was about the Pilgrims, the first settlers in America.
lines.cn: 感恩节是关于清教徒，他们是第一批来美国定居的移民。

lines.en: They shared the first harvest with the Indians and gave thanks.
lines.cn: 他们与印第安人分享首次收获。感恩。

lines.en: Then in that spirit let each of us give thanks.
lines.cn: 现在，本着同样心意，让我们开始感恩。
每个人用自己的方式来表达。

lines.en: I give thanks for being here with my family and for being well, so I can enjoy you all.
lines.cn: 我感谢能在这和家人同住且很健康，让我享受到你们大家的温馨。

lines.en: I'd like to give thanks for a healthy year, a good job, and for meeting Harry and Michelle.
lines.cn: 我感谢这一年来身体健康，工作顺利，认识了 Harry 和 Michelle。

lines.en: We'd like to give thanks for meeting Susan and the Stewart family.
lines.cn: 我们要感谢认识了 Susan。和 Stewart 一家人。

lines.en: That was very kind of you.
I'd like to give thanks for Grandpa coming to live with us.
lines.cn: 我感谢爷爷到这和我们一起生活。

lines.en: And I'd also like to thank my math teacher for giving me a passing grade.
lines.cn: 我还要感谢我的数学老师。给我及格分数。

lines.en: Well, you all know I'm working on my photo album.
lines.cn: 好吧，你们都知道我正在进行我的写真集。

lines.en: And I'd like to thank Marilyn for being so patient.
lines.cn: 我要感谢 Marilyn 这么耐心。

lines.en: I should thank you for encouraging me to keep working on my fashion designs.
lines.cn: 我应该感谢你一直鼓励我。继续我的服装设计工作。

lines.en: I'm lucky to have a husband with an artistic eye.
lines.cn: 我很庆幸，我丈夫具有艺术的眼光。

lines.en: Oh, we have a lot to be thankful for.
lines.cn: 啊，我们有很多需要感谢的事情。

lines.en: For the food on this table.
lines.cn: 感谢这桌上的丰盛食物。

lines.en: I'll go along with that, Ellen.
It was a wonderful meal, Mrs. Stewart.
lines.cn: 真是一顿精美的晚餐 Stewart 太太。

lines.en: And now to see the end of the football game.
lines.cn: 现在去看看橄榄球比赛的最后一段。
记得吗，Michigan 队的橄榄球比赛？
爸爸，你最著名的苹果派。

lines.en: Just let me see the score, Ellen.
We should all take a little break before dessert.
lines.cn: 吃甜点之前我们大家应该稍微休息一下。

lines.en: I invited her to come by for dessert.
No, she doesn't know Harry Bennett and his daughter Michelle.
lines.cn: 不，她还不认识 Harry Bennett 和他的女儿 Michelle。

lines.en: And Alexandra brought us a pumpkin pie.
lines.cn: Alexandra 给我们带来了一个南瓜派。
爸爸 Richard Alexandra 来了。
Michigan 队需要一次达阵得分。
是啊 Michigan 队需要一次达阵得分。

lines.en: One tiny little touchdown, with just three minutes to play.
lines.cn: 一次小小的达阵得分，只剩下三分钟了。

lines.en: And Alexandra brought us a pumpkin pie.
lines.cn: Alexandra 给我们带来了一个南瓜派。

lines.en: We forgot to turn the oven on.
Philip, why don't you go watch the last three minutes of the game.
lines.cn: Philip，你何不去，看完比赛的最后三分钟。

lines.en: I will serve coffee and pumpkin pie.
lines.cn: 我来准备咖啡和南瓜派。

lines.en: OK. I'll be back in a few minutes.
Robbie, would you bring the dessert plates.
And, Marilyn, would you pour coffee, please.
lines.cn: 还有，Marilyn，请你倒一下咖啡，好吗？

lines.en: How was your Thanksgiving dinner, Alexandra?
lines.cn: 你的感恩节晚餐怎么样 Alexandra？

lines.en: The Molinas are a large family.
I'm glad you came by, Alexandra.

lines.cn: 达阵得分，达阵得分，达阵得分！

lines.en: And nobody misses Philip's famous apple pie.
lines.cn: 还有，没人再想到 Philip 著名的苹果派。

lines.en: Robbie, this new Walkman is absolutely wonderful.
lines.cn: Robbie 这个新的随身听真棒。

lines.en: Richard and Marilyn bought it for me for my birthday.
lines.cn: 这是 Richard 和 Marilyn 送我的生日礼物。

lines.en: You are very lucky, Robbie, to have such a nice family.
lines.cn: Robbie，你真幸运，有这么温馨的一个家庭。

lines.en: Come on, you can tell me.
I received a letter from my parents this morning.
lines.cn: 今天早上我收到父母寄来的信。

lines.en: Did they write some bad news?
lines.cn: 他们写了什么坏消息吗？

lines.en: Well, then why are you so sad?
lines.cn: 那么，你为什么这么难过？

lines.en: The Molinas treat me so nicely, and I love being with your family so much ...
lines.cn: Molina 一家人对我很好，我也很喜欢和你们在一起 ……

lines.en: but when I received the letter with photographs of my family, I cried.
lines.cn: 但是当我收到那封信。连同家人照片时，我哭了。

lines.en: I cried because I miss them all.
You really miss your family, don't you?
lines.cn: 你真的很想念家人，是不是？

lines.en: Yes. I know I must seem silly.
lines.cn: 是的，我知道我看起来一定很可笑。

lines.en: It's not like I have nobody.
lines.cn: 我身边并非没有亲近的人。

lines.en: I like the Molinas very much, and they're so kind to me.
lines.cn: 我很喜欢 Molina 一家人，他们对我真好。

lines.en: Hey, why don't we go out for a cheeseburger and french fries?
lines.cn: 嘿，我们何不出去。去吃个芝士汉堡和炸薯条呢？

lines.en: And you can use my Walkman.
But if we go out, please don't complain about your math teacher or your math homework.
lines.cn: 但是我们出去，你可别老抱怨。你的数学老师或你的数学作业。

lines.en: I have to turn off the lights, or else my father will get really angry.
lines.cn: 我得关掉灯，要不然，我爸爸会很生气。

lines.en: He says I never turn them out when I leave.
lines.cn: 他说我离开时从不关灯。

lines.en: If they come home and they're on ...
lines.cn: 要是他们回来看见灯开着……。

lines.en: It sounded like a dog barking.
It sounded like a dog barking right here.
Her name's Gemma, and she belongs to Mr. and Mrs. Levinson.
lines.cn: 它叫 Gemma，是 Levinson 夫妇家的狗。

lines.en: There's a phone number -- five five five ... eight four four eight.
Robbie, maybe you should call them and tell the Levinsons we have their cute little spaniel.
lines.cn: Robbie，也许你应该给他们打个电话，告诉 Levinson 夫妇，他们那只可爱的小猎犬在我们这里。

lines.en: I've always wanted a springer spaniel.
lines.cn: 我一直想养一只史宾格猎犬。

lines.en: The number you are calling -- 555-8448 -- is no longer in service.
lines.cn: 您拨打的号码 555-8448 已停止服务。

lines.en: The number's no longer in service.

lines.cn: 我们会找到狗的主人的。

lines.en: So how are we going to find the owners?
lines.cn: 那么，我们如何去找到主人呢？

lines.en: With a little help from the ASPCA, the American Society for the Prevention of Cruelty to Animals.
lines.cn: 请 ASPCA 帮个忙，也就是美国防止虐待动物协会。
我们有一次找到一只猫。

lines.en: She was caught in the branches of our tree.
lines.cn: 被我们家树上的树枝夹住了。

lines.en: They came and solved the problem.
lines.cn: 他们来了，也解决了问题。
Robbie 我们给他们打电话。

lines.en: Hello, my name is Robbie Stewart.
I have a lost dog I'd like to bring to you.
lines.cn: 我这有一只失散的狗，我想送来给你们。

lines.en: I'll bring the dog over by nine.
lines.cn: 我在九点之前把狗送来。

lines.en: We have two and a half hours.
Let's take Gemma by there now.
lines.cn: 我们赶紧把 Gemma 送去。

lines.en: I'm so sad to see this little dog without her family.
lines.cn: 看到这狗没有家，我真难过。

lines.en: I'm sure they'll find the owner.
lines.cn: 我相信他们会找到狗的主人。

lines.en: But if they don't, I'll adopt her.
lines.cn: 不过，如果找不到，我就收养它。

lines.en: I'd like to keep her, too.
But I'll be going home to Greece at the end of the semester.
lines.cn: 但是我就要回希腊去了。就在这个学期结束的时候。

lines.en: She just wants love and affection.
Let's get her to the animal shelter, so they can find her owners quickly.
lines.cn: 我们把它送到动物收容所，好让他们很快找到它的主人。

lines.en: It's not easy being away from home.
We're off to the animal shelter.
lines.cn: 我们这就去动物收容所。

lines.en: Your name will do, Mr. Stewart.
lines.cn: 你的名字就够了 Stewart 先生。

lines.en: Where did you find the dog?
lines.cn: 你在什么地方找到狗的？

lines.en: You tried calling the number on the collar?
lines.cn: 是否照狗脖子上的电话号码打过电话了？

lines.en: Yes, but the number's no longer in service.
lines.cn: 打过，但那个号码是空号。

lines.en: And there's no address on the dog tag?
You will try to find the dog's owner.
lines.cn: 你们会尽力去找寻狗的主人吧。
哦，我们会想办法，相信我。

lines.en: If you don't ... can I ... can I adopt the dog?
lines.cn: 如果找不到……我可以……我可以收养这只狗吗？

lines.en: If the owners don't claim the dog in forty-eight hours, then you can apply for adoption.
lines.cn: 如果狗的主人在四十八小时内不认领，你就可以申请收养了。

lines.en: If no one comes to claim Gemma, I'd like to adopt her.
lines.cn: 如果没有人来认领 Gemma，我想收养它。

lines.en: If you want to adopt an animal, first we need to know some references.
lines.cn: 如果你想收养动物，首先，我们需要知道一些可以为你提供证明的人。

lines.en: We need to talk to some people about you.
lines.cn: 我们得向一些人打听你。

lines.en: We want to be sure that you're responsible and that you can take good care of an animal.
lines.cn: 我们想确定你有责任心，而且能够好好照料动物。

lines.en: Then you have to fill out this form about your family background.
lines.cn: 然后你要填写这份表格。关于你的家庭背景的。

lines.en: We need to know about your history with animals.
lines.cn: 我们需要了解你过去养动物的经历。

lines.en: Have you ever owned an animal?
We had a cat when I was eight years old.
Do you have any animals now?
lines.cn: 你现在还养着什么动物吗？

lines.en: We also like to know your reasons for wanting an animal.
lines.cn: 我们还想知道。你要养动物的原因。

lines.en: Just to hold it and cuddle with it.
Just to have as a pet.
To have a friend -- a pal.
lines.cn: 想要一个朋友，一个伙伴。

lines.en: You know, man's best friend is his dog.
lines.cn: 你知道的，人类最好的朋友就是狗。

lines.en: If you're under twenty-one years of age ...
lines.cn: 如果你还不到二十一岁……

lines.en: Then an adult must sign for you.
lines.cn: 那就必须有一位成年人来替你签字。

lines.en: My parents will think it's a good idea.
lines.cn: 我的父母会觉得这是件好事。

lines.en: If the real owners don't come to claim Gemma ...
lines.cn: 如果狗的主人没认领 Gemma……

lines.en: Thanks for your information and for being so helpful.
lines.cn: 谢谢你的帮助和提供的信息。

lines.en: Nice talking to both of you.
Maybe the real owners will come to claim her.
lines.cn: 也许狗的主人会来认领的。

lines.en: I see you're both animal lovers.
lines.cn: 我看得出你们都是喜爱动物的人。

lines.en: We'll call in a couple of days.
lines.cn: 我们两三天后给你电话。

lines.en: Good-bye, and thanks for bringing Gemma in.
lines.cn: 再见，谢谢你们把 Gemma 送来。

lines.en: I keep thinking about the dog -- about Gemma, alone in the animal shelter.
lines.cn: 我一直在想着那只狗，想着 Gemma，独自待在动物收容所里。

lines.en: But I promise you, Alexandra, the dog is just fine.
lines.cn: 不过我向你保证，Alexandra，那狗会很好的。

lines.en: They're very kind to the animals.
lines.cn: 他们照料动物很细心在行。

lines.en: I mean about her being alone.
lines.cn: 我的意思是，它孤零零的。

lines.en: Even if they are kind to Gemma, she's still alone, without her family.
lines.cn: 即使他们对 Gemma 很好，它还是孤单的，没有家人在身边。

lines.en: I'll have the chef's salad, please.
I will have a cheeseburger, medium rare, with raw onion, and french fries, please.
lines.cn: 我要一个三分熟的芝士汉堡，配生洋葱和炸薯条，谢谢。

lines.en: Ginger ale with lots of ice for me, thank you.
lines.cn: 我要姜味汽水，多加冰，谢谢。

lines.en: Aren't you surprised that the animal shelter is so careful about finding homes for the animals?
lines.cn: 你不觉得意外吗，动物收容所这么认真谨慎，为这些动物寻找新家？

lines.en: And a cheeseburger, medium rare, with onion and french fries.
lines.cn: 还有一个三分熟的芝士汉堡，附加洋葱和炸薯条。

lines.en: And a ginger ale with lots of ice.
lines.cn: 一份姜味汽水，加很多冰块。

lines.en: Hey, I wanted you to hear my new sound system when the dog scratched on the front door.
lines.cn: 嘿，我本来想让你听听我的新音响，就在那只狗抓前门的时候。

lines.en: Let's finish eating, and then we'll go back to my house.
lines.cn: 我们赶紧吃完，然后回到我家。

lines.en: I want you to hear my new tapes.
lines.cn: 我想让你听听我的新录音带。

lines.en: I've got some great new dance music.
lines.cn: 我有几卷很好的新舞曲。
请问 Robbie Stewart 在吗？

lines.en: This is Linda Aborn from the animal shelter.
lines.cn: 我是动物收容所的 Linda Aborn。

lines.en: It's Linda from the animal shelter.
We have good news and bad news, Robbie.
lines.cn: 我给你带来了好消息，坏消息 Robbie。

lines.en: The good news is that the Levinsons have come by to pick up the dog.
lines.cn: 好消息是 Levinson 夫妇已来这儿。把狗领回去了。

lines.en: The bad news is, you won't be able to adopt the dog.
lines.cn: 坏消息是你不能收养那狗了。

lines.en: Come by one day and look at some of the other dogs.
lines.cn: 有空来一趟，看看其他狗。

lines.en: I'm sure there's one for you.
And the Levinsons thank you for bringing their dog to us.
lines.cn: Levinson 夫妇也谢谢你把他们的狗送来。

lines.en: She said if I come by, she'll help me find another dog.
lines.cn: 她说，如果我去一趟，她会帮我另外找一条狗。

lines.en: Molly, I need your special talent for handling special matters.
lines.cn: Molly 我需要你处理特殊状况的特殊才能。

lines.en: Well, I have a scheduling problem.
lines.cn: 嗯，我在安排日程时遇到了点困难。

lines.en: I have three tonsillectomies set for Friday with Dr. Earl.
lines.cn: 我排好要和 Earl 大夫在星期五进行三个扁桃体切除手术。

lines.en: I need to fit a fourth operation into his schedule.
lines.cn: 我得在他的工作计划再加第四个手术。

lines.en: And ... I know you can do it.

lines.cn: Carl Herrera。这孩子的扁桃体感染了，我们要尽快把它切除。

lines.en: and we should remove them as soon as possible.
lines.cn: 这孩子的扁桃体感染了，我们要尽快把它切除。

lines.en: Well, I'll try to arrange the schedule, Dr. Stewart.
lines.cn: 好吧，我尽力去安排 Stewart 大夫。

lines.en: But it's not going to be easy.
I know you'll be able to take care of it.
lines.cn: 我知道你能够处理好这件事。

lines.en: Well, Mrs. Herrera, Carl will be perfectly fine after we remove his tonsils.
lines.cn: 好 Herrera 太太，切除扁桃体之后 Carl 会完全恢复健康的。

lines.en: Thank you for your reassurance, Dr. Stewart.
lines.cn: 谢谢你消除了我忧虑 Stewart 大夫。

lines.en: He's had so many colds and sore throats recently.
lines.cn: 他最近常常感冒喉咙痛。

lines.en: Well, it's a very easy operation, Carl.
lines.cn: 这是个很简单的手术 Carl。

lines.en: But when do they do it?
Well, we could reschedule the operation, Mrs. Herrera, but I don't want to put it off too long.
lines.cn: 这样吧，我们可以重新安排手术 Herrera太太，但我希望不要拖得太久。

lines.en: No, I think it's important to do it now.
lines.cn: 不，我觉得还是应该现在动手术。

lines.en: We can have a birthday party for you, Carl, When you come out of the hospital.
lines.cn: 我们可以给你办一个生日聚会，Carl，等你出院的时候。

lines.en: But it won't be on my birthday.
lines.cn: 但是那就不是在我生日那天了。

lines.en: But your health is more important, Carl. Believe me.
lines.cn: 可是你的身体更重要 Carl 相信我的话。

lines.en: I don't want my tonsils out.
Nurse Baker, would you come in, please?
lines.cn: Baker 护士，请来一下，好吗？

lines.en: Hello, Mrs. Herrera. Hi, Carl, how you doing?
lines.cn: 你好，Herrera 太太。嗨，Carl，你怎么样？

lines.en: I don't want my tonsils out.
You and I will talk this over.
She has a special way with kids.
OK. Do you want to get better?
OK. We want you to get better, too.
lines.cn: 我们也希望你快点好起来。

lines.en: You'll have your tonsils out tomorrow, and you won't get so many colds anymore.
lines.cn: 你明天要做扁桃体切除手术，你就不会老患感冒了。

lines.en: But if I have my tonsils out tomorrow, I'll miss my birthday party on Saturday.
lines.cn: 但是，我如果明天切除扁桃体，就会错过星期六我的生日派对。
这确实是个问题，不是吗？

lines.en: Let me try to work something out.
I have to think about it.
Give me a chance to think about it, and I'll come up with something.
lines.cn: 给我一个机会想一想，我会想出个办法的。

lines.en: But you just put on your pajamas and robe, and I'll think of a surprise.
lines.cn: 不过，你先穿上睡衣和睡袍，我来想出一个惊喜。

lines.en: There are other boys and girls here, and they're having their tonsils out.
lines.cn: 这里还有其他男孩和女孩，他们也将切除扁桃体。

lines.en: Change your clothes, Carl. Everything will be just fine.
lines.cn: 把衣服换了 Carl 一切都会安好的。

lines.en: Do you know how to play charades?

lines.cn: Frank，你从来没玩过比手画脚猜词的游戏吗？

lines.en: Carl, you're sure you've never played?
lines.cn: Carl 你肯定你从没玩过吗？

lines.en: Frank, you can learn as we go.
And, Carl, you join in at any time.
lines.cn: 还有 Carl 你随时都可以加入。
我们知道是一部电影啊。

lines.en: The first word sounds like no.
lines.cn: 第一个单词听起来像 no。
好，一部电影，片名有六个单词。

lines.en: Snow White and the Seven Dwarfs.
Betty, you had it, but you didn't say it.
lines.cn: Betty，你也猜到了，只是没说出来。
Carl 现在你知道，什么是哑谜了。
你为什么不加入我们呢？

lines.en: Between now and tomorrow you're all going to have your tonsils out.
lines.cn: 从现在起到明天。你们都要切除扁桃体。

lines.en: And you won't be able to speak for a while.
lines.cn: 有一段时间，你没有办法讲话。

lines.en: So save your voices till then.
lines.cn: 所以，在那之前少说点话吧。

lines.en: I sure I am glad to see you, Dr. Stewart.
lines.cn: 真高兴见到你，Stewart 大夫。

lines.en: I didn't want to play charades, so they're angry at me.
lines.cn: 我不想玩哑谜，所以他们生我的气。

lines.en: Why don't you want to play?
Because I don't want to be here.
I don't want my tonsils out.
My mother promised me a birthday party with a clown.
lines.cn: 我妈妈答应给我一个有小丑的生日派对。

lines.en: But you can have one when you go home, Carl.
lines.cn: 但你回去以后还可以办一个呀 Carl。
但是我的生日就在明天。

lines.en: Carl, you'll have your party when you go home,
lines.cn: Carl，等你回家就可以办生日聚会了，

lines.en: But it won't be on my birthday!
lines.cn: 但那就不是在我生日那天了！

lines.en: And you promised me a surprise.
lines.cn: 而且你答应给我一个惊喜。

lines.en: You'll feel better tomorrow, Betty, believe me.
lines.cn: 明天，就会好些 Betty 相信我。

lines.en: Only one day, and it won't hurt as much.
lines.cn: 只要再一天，就不会像现在这样痛了。
噢，别显得那么无精打采。

lines.en: Let me tell you about your dinner.
lines.cn: 让我告诉你晚饭吃什么。

lines.en: I see you're feeling better already, Betty.
lines.cn: Betty，我看得出你已经感觉好些了。
那么，你愿意吃晚饭了吗？

lines.en: OK, honey, we'll see to it that you have strawberry and vanilla ice cream.
lines.cn: 好，亲爱的，我们会设法。让你吃到草莓和香草的冰淇淋。

lines.en: You need some rest to help you get better quickly.
lines.cn: 你需要休息，这样才能快点好起来。

lines.en: It doesn't hurt that much, does it?
Oh, I'm sorry it hurts so much, and you won't be able to have dinner.
lines.cn: 哦，很抱歉你这么疼，没办法吃晚饭。

lines.en: You're just going to have to have ice cream.
Well, I see you're feeling better.
Well, at least you're acting like you feel better.
lines.cn: 不过，至少你表现得好像你感觉好多了。

lines.en: Three scoops of chocolate ice cream for Tim coming up.
lines.cn: 给 Tim 的三勺巧克力冰淇淋马上送来。

lines.en: In the meantime, what would you like?
lines.cn: 在这期间，你想要点什么？

lines.en: I promised you a surprise, didn't I?
lines.cn: 我答应过要给你一件惊喜，不是吗？

lines.en: And it wasn't just ice cream, was it?
lines.cn: 这惊喜还不仅是冰淇淋，对吗？

lines.en: Your birthday is tomorrow, isn't it?
Well, maybe, just maybe, there will be a surprise.
lines.cn: 嗯，或许，只是或许，会有一项让你惊喜的事。

lines.en: But first you have to smile.
I just want to see one smile from you.
If you want a surprise, then you've got to smile first.
lines.cn: 如果你想要一个惊喜的事，你就得先笑一笑。

lines.en: Well, I'm glad you're feeling better because we have a little surprise for you today.
lines.cn: 我很高兴各位感觉好些。因为今天我们要给各位一项惊喜。

lines.en: It's Carl's birthday, and we have Popo the Clown to entertain you.
lines.cn: 今天是 Carl 的生日，我们请了小丑 Popo 来给大家表演助兴。

lines.en: And here he is--Popo the Clown.
I thought you might be hungry.
I brought you a chicken sandwich and a glass of milk.
lines.cn: 我给你带来了一个鸡肉三明治和一杯牛奶。

lines.en: I'm writing a story for the high-school paper.
lines.cn: 我正在为高中校刊写篇东西。

lines.en: No, I have to turn it in in the morning.
lines.cn: 不行，我明天早上就得交。

lines.en: I'm writing an article on the feelings about graduation.
lines.cn: 我在写一篇关于毕业感想的文章。

lines.en: The scary part's leaving home and moving to college.
lines.cn: 害怕的是要离开家到学校去。

lines.en: Oh, leaving home is part of growing up.
lines.cn: 呵，离开家是成熟过程的一部分。

lines.en: Well, maybe you should think about becoming a writer.
lines.cn: 那么，也许你应考虑成为一名作家。

lines.en: You have lots of time to decide.

lines.cn: 最伤脑筋的是作出决定。

lines.en: "Hail to the victors valiant, Hail to the conquering heroes, Hail, Hail to Michigan, The champions of the West!"
lines.cn: “向勇敢的胜利者致敬，向进取的英雄们致敬，致敬，向 Michigan 致敬，致敬，向 Michigan 致敬，西部的冠军！”

lines.en: Did the University of Michigan win another football game?
lines.cn: 是不是 Michigan 大学又赢了一场美式橄榄球比赛？

lines.en: I just spoke with Charley Rafer.
lines.cn: 我刚和 Charley Rafer 通了电话。

lines.en: He's the Dean of Admissions for the University of Michigan.
lines.cn: 他是 Michigan 大学的招生主任。

lines.en: And it turns out he's a classmate of Philip's.
lines.cn: 有意思的是他和 Philip 是同班同学。

lines.en: We were both on the tennis team.
lines.cn: 我们都是网球队的队员。

lines.en: He's going to be in New York tomorrow to interview applicants for admission.
lines.cn: 明天他要在纽约。与申请入学者面谈。

lines.en: And he's agreed to fit you into his schedule.
lines.cn: 他同意在日程里为你安排一次面试。

lines.en: But I may not want to go to Michigan.
It's one of the best schools in the country, Robbie.
lines.cn: 这是全国最好的大学之一 Robbie。

lines.en: Your grandfather went to the Engineering School there.
lines.cn: 你爷爷以前就读于那里的工学院。

lines.en: You said you wanted to be a doctor like your father.
lines.cn: 你说过你希望像爸爸一样成为一名医生。

lines.en: You couldn't pick a finer medical school than Michigan.
lines.cn: 你找不到比 Michigan 更好的医学院了。

lines.en: Let's meet with Charley at the university club.
lines.cn: 我们到大学俱乐部去见 Charley 吧。

lines.en: It doesn't mean you're going to Michigan.
lines.cn: 这不是说你就要去 Michigan 大学。

lines.en: It doesn't mean you have to be a doctor.
lines.cn: 这不意味着你一定要当医生。

lines.en: But the interview will be good experience for you.
lines.cn: 但这次面谈对你来说是一次很好的经验。

lines.en: Dad, growing up means making my own decisions, doesn't it?
lines.cn: 爸爸，长大意味着，我要自己做决定，不是吗？

lines.en: But, like your Grandpa suggested, have the interview.
lines.cn: 但是，照你爷爷所建议的，去参加这次面谈。

lines.en: And then make your own decision.
I know it's sudden, Robbie, but this is an important opportunity.
lines.cn: 我知道这件事很突然 Robbie。但这是一次很重要的机会。

lines.en: We'll head down there first thing tomorrow morning.
lines.cn: 明早第一件事就是去那。

lines.en: I want you to know something, Son.
lines.cn: 我希望你知道一件事，孩子。

lines.en: Well, I've got an appointment at the hospital.
I'll see you all at dinnertime.

lines.cn: 还有什么不对的地方吗 Robbie？

lines.en: Going away to college for the first time always makes one a little nervous.
lines.cn: 第一次离家上大学。总是让人有些紧张。

lines.en: I'll be OK. I just need time to think.
lines.cn: 我会适应的，我只是需要时间思考。

lines.en: Sorry, Robbie. Sorry to be late this morning,
lines.cn: 对不起 Robbie 对不起今天早上迟了点，

lines.en: but, well, we've still got some time for a cup of coffee.
lines.cn: 不过，我们还有喝杯咖啡的时间。

lines.en: I can't wait to see my old pal Charley Rafer.
lines.cn: 我迫不及待地想见到老朋友 Charley Rafer。

lines.en: So you thought about it, huh?
I knew you'd realize that this interview could be an important experience for you.
lines.cn: 我知道你会体会到。这次面谈是一次很重要的经验。

lines.en: Now let's head off for the city and the university club.
lines.cn: 现在，我们进城去，到大学俱乐部。

lines.en: Thanks for hearing me out. And ...
lines.cn: 谢谢你耐心听我说完。还有……

lines.en: And thanks for being such an understanding father.
lines.cn: 而且谢谢你是这样一位善于了解我的父亲。

lines.en: Well, thank you, Robbie. Thank you.
lines.cn: 嗯，谢谢你 Robbie 谢谢你。

lines.en: Charley Rafer--you look as young as ever.
lines.cn: Charley Rafer，你看起来还是那么年轻。

lines.en: Yes, this is my youngest son Robbie.
lines.cn: 是的，这是我的小儿子 Robbie。

lines.en: Robbie, I want you to meet one of the best tennis players on the Michigan team-- Charley Rafer.
lines.cn: Robbie，我想介绍你认识，Michigan 网球队最优秀的球员之一——。Charley Rafer。

lines.en: Nice to meet you, Dean Rafer.
lines.cn: 很高兴见到你 Rafer 主任。

lines.en: Well, are you as good a tennis player as your dad?
lines.cn: 嗯，你是否像爸爸那样是一名优秀的网球选手呢？

lines.en: No, I'm not very good at it.

lines.cn: 坦白说，我当年也不怎么样。

lines.en: Charley was the star of the team.
lines.cn: Charley 是当时队里的明星。

lines.en: She's still giving the toughest English history exams in the school and loving every minute of it.
lines.cn: 她仍用最艰深的英国历史试题考学生。在学校，且乐此不疲，时时如此。

lines.en: And speaking of minutes, I have interviews until noon, so why don't we get right to work?
lines.cn: 谈到时间，我从现在到中午，有一系列的面谈，我们现在就开始工作，好吗？

lines.en: Can you have lunch with us later?
lines.cn: 你能与我们一起共进午餐吗？

lines.en: I'd love to, Philip, but I'm afraid I can't.
lines.cn: 我很想 Philip 但恐怕不行。

lines.en: I'm only here two days, and I have interviews with twenty-six applicants.
lines.cn: 我只有两天时间，而要面谈的申请人有二十六位。

lines.en: Did you bring your transcript from high school?
lines.cn: 你把高中的成绩单带来了吗？

lines.en: I see under "activities" that you've been writing for the school paper.
lines.cn: 我看到“课外活动”这一栏写着，你为校刊写文章。

lines.en: What kinds of articles have you written?
lines.cn: 你写过一些什么样的文章？
各种各样的，体育，社论，剧评。

lines.en: You name it, I've written it.
Well, have you ever thought of becoming a journalist?
lines.cn: 好，你是否想过成为一名新闻从业人员？

lines.en: Michigan has a fine School of Journalism.
lines.cn: Michigan 大学有一所很好的新闻学院。

lines.en: You seem to have some reservations.
It's been very nice talking to you.

lines.cn: 我也很高兴与您交谈，先生。

lines.en: The most important thing is for you to decide your own future.
lines.cn: 最重要的是你要自己决定自己的未来。
再见 Robbie 祝你好运。

lines.en: I had an interview today, too.
lines.cn: 我今天也参加了一次面谈。

lines.en: I had a great interview with Admissions at Columbia University.
lines.cn: 我参加了一次很精彩的面谈。与 Columbia 大学的招生人员。

lines.en: Will you get into the school?
Well, they didn't say anything for sure.
lines.cn: 嗯，他们没有任何确定的答复。

lines.en: But I figure that with my grades and with my personality, I'll have no problem.
lines.cn: 但我想，凭我的成绩和我的品行，我不会有问题。
Columbia 是一所很棒的学校。

lines.en: What are you going to do?

lines.cn: 听起来你对 Columbia 大学跃跃欲试。
下不了决心，下不了决心。

lines.en: It's not easy, and this is an important decision we have to make.
lines.cn: 实在不容易，这又是我们必须做的一个重大决定。

lines.en: How was your interview with Michigan?
lines.cn: 你跟 Michigan 大学的人面谈得如何？

lines.en: My father would like me to go there.
lines.cn: 我爸爸希望我去那读书。

lines.en: He and my Grandpa both went there.
lines.cn: 他和我爷爷都曾在那读书。

lines.en: You can follow in your father's footsteps.
lines.cn: 你可以跟随你父亲的脚步。

lines.en: Ah! I'd like to follow in my own footsteps, Mike.
What do you want to study?
I think I want to study journalism to be a reporter--a newspaperman.
lines.cn: 我想学新闻学。将来当一名记者，一个新闻从业人员。

lines.en: You do a pretty good job on the Riverdale High School paper.
lines.cn: 你在 Riverdale 高中校刊做得有声有色。

lines.en: And I've been thinking about it a lot lately.
lines.cn: 最近我一直就此事考虑了很多。

lines.en: Have you discussed it with your parents?
Hi, Son. Is everything all right?
I was just waiting for you to get home so we could talk.
lines.cn: 我正等你回来。好跟你谈谈。

lines.en: Anything special you want to talk about?
lines.cn: 有什么特殊的事要谈吗？

lines.en: Well, I know you and Mom have given up a lot to save money for my college tuition.
lines.cn: 嗯，我知道你和妈妈做出了很多牺牲，存钱准备我的大学学费。

lines.en: We want you to go to college, Robbie.
lines.cn: 我们希望你上大学 Robbie。

lines.en: Well, I've thought a lot about which college, and one of them is Columbia.
lines.cn: 嗯，我为了上哪一所大学想了很多，其中一所是 Columbia 大学。

lines.en: First, they have an excellent School of Journalism.
lines.cn: 首先，那里有一所很出色的新闻学院。

lines.en: And your friends are planning to go to Columbia?
lines.cn: 而且你的朋友们也计划上 Columbia 大学，对吗？

lines.en: Mike and I had a hamburger this afternoon, and we talked.
lines.cn: 今天下午 Mike 和我去吃汉堡，一起讨论。

lines.en: Well, we talked about a lot of things.
He applied to Columbia, and his interview was very successful.
lines.cn: 他申请了 Columbia，他的面谈很成功。

lines.en: He thinks he'll be accepted, and he really wants to go there.
lines.cn: 他觉得他会被录取，他确实很想去那。
Rafer 主任今天打电话给我。

lines.en: He told me he was very impressed with you.
lines.cn: 他告诉我他对你印象很好。

lines.en: He told me you had some doubts about wanting to go to Michigan.
lines.cn: 他告诉我。你对上 Michigan 大学有些疑虑。

lines.en: I'm just not sure about what I want to do.
Let me tell you something, Robbie.
lines.cn: 让我告诉你一件事 Robbie。

lines.en: Something that might be surprising to you.
lines.cn: 一件也许会让你吃惊的事。

lines.en: Well, Grandpa wanted me to study engineering, like him.
lines.cn: 嗯，爷爷希望我像他一样学工程。

lines.en: Well, I wasn't clear about my future, but I knew engineering was not for me.
lines.cn: 我对自己的未来当时也不清楚，但我知道工程对我并不合适。
那你是如何对爷爷讲的？

lines.en: Then you're not upset about my not wanting to go into medicine?
lines.cn: 那么，我不想学医，你不会因此不高兴吗？

lines.en: I'm just happy that we're able to talk about it.
lines.cn: 我很高兴我们能够一起商讨这件事。

lines.en: I suppose you want to apply to Columbia.
lines.cn: 我猜想你会申请 Columbia 大学。

lines.en: Yes, but I also want to apply to several other colleges.
lines.cn: 是的，但我还想申请几所其他的大学。

lines.en: I thought you wanted to go to Columbia.
lines.cn: 我还以为你只想上 Columbia 大学。

lines.en: Well, I might want to go to Columbia.
lines.cn: 嗯，我也许去 Columbia 大学。

lines.en: I just want to be able to make my own decision.

lines.cn: 你真是我们 Stewart 家的人！

lines.en: And if I think about it long enough, you never know ...
lines.cn: 如果我一直考虑下去的话，说不定……

lines.en: If I make my own decision, I might choose Michigan.
lines.cn: 如果我自己作决定，我说不定选择 Michigan 大学。

lines.en: You know, when I was your age, I said exactly the same thing to Grandpa.
lines.cn: 要知道，当我像你这么大的时候，我跟你爷爷说了同样的话。
今天的工作是怎么安排？

lines.en: Ten o'clock, telephone FAO Schwarz about the new twin baby dolls.
lines.cn: 十点钟，打电话给 FAO Schwarz，谈谈新的双胞胎娃娃玩具。

lines.en: Telephone Mrs. Zaskey at the advertising agency.
lines.cn: 打电话给广告公司的 Zaskey 太太。
我已经打了。 继续说。

lines.en: Eleven o'clock, approve the sketches for the toy spaceship.
lines.cn: 十一点钟，批示玩具太空船的草图。

lines.en: What do you think of the spaceship?
lines.cn: 你觉得那个太空船怎么样？

lines.en: I think the kids'll love it.
Would you show me the drawings, please?
lines.cn: 请把草图给我看看好吗？

lines.en: Now, what else is on the schedule today?
lines.cn: 那么今天的工作表上还有些什么？

lines.en: Well, at one o'clock you have a lunch appointment with Mr. Levine, the client from the Toytown Stores.
lines.cn: 嗯，一点钟。跟 Levine 先生约好吃午饭，这个客户来自 Toytown Stores。

lines.en: At four o'clock, you have a meeting with the production staff in the conference room.
lines.cn: 四点钟，要与生产部门人员开会。在会议室。

lines.en: Make sure everybody is at that meeting.
lines.cn: 要确定每一位都出席这次会议。

lines.en: At six you're meeting, Mr. Ozawa.
lines.cn: 六点钟，你要会见 Ozawa 先生。

lines.en: Oh, yes. Are his models here?
lines.cn: 哦，对了。他的模型送来了吗？

lines.en: When was your last day off?
lines.cn: 上次休假是在什么时候？

lines.en: You really ought to take some time off.
To enjoy the simple things in life ...
Oh, wait a minute. What's today's date?
It seems to me I scheduled something else.
lines.cn: 好像我还安排了什么别的事情。

lines.en: There's nothing else in the appointment book.
lines.cn: 预约本上没有其他安排了。
我确信我安排了什么事。

lines.en: Oh, well, I'll probably remember it later.
lines.cn: 噢，也许过一会我会记起来。

lines.en: Would you call Priscilla Smith at FAO Schwarz, please?
lines.cn: 请打电话给 FAO Schwarz 的 Priscilla Smith，好吗？

lines.en: These are the models from the Japanese film maker.
lines.cn: 这些是那位日本电影制作人送来的模型。

lines.en: Thank you. Just put them on my desk.
lines.cn: 谢谢。把它们放在我桌上。

lines.en: And the new drawings for the toy spaceship.
lines.cn: 还有玩具太空船的新草图。
我们找来了一位新的美工人员，

lines.en: What time is my lunch date with Bill Levine?
lines.cn: 我与 Bill Levine 约好的中饭时间是几点？

lines.en: Remind me to leave at twelve forty-five.
lines.cn: 提醒我十二点四十五分走。

lines.en: Did you remember your other appointment for today?
lines.cn: 你想起今天另外那个约会了吗？

lines.en: No, but I have a feeling it's going to be too late when I do remember.
lines.cn: 记不起来了。但我觉得。等我想起来时已经太晚了。
我刚刚把那个谜底解开了。

lines.en: You have some guests in the reception room.
lines.cn: 有几位客人在接待室等。

lines.en: Mr. Harry Bennett and his daughter.
lines.cn: Harry Bennett 先生和他女儿。

lines.en: I made a lunch date with him and his daughter weeks ago.
lines.cn: 几星期前我约好和他以及他女儿共进午餐。

lines.en: Well, he's here with his daughter to have lunch.
lines.cn: 嗯，他和他女儿已到这等吃午餐了。

lines.en: I met her at Thanksgiving, and I promised to have lunch with both of them today.
lines.cn: 我在感恩节与她见面，我答应今天和他们共进午餐。

lines.en: What are you going to do about your appointment with Mr. Levine?
lines.cn: 那你打算怎么处理，和 Levine 先生的约会？

lines.en: It's nice to see you again.
We have both been excited about seeing you and having lunch with you today.
lines.cn: 我们两个很高兴见到你。与你一起吃中餐。

lines.en: Michelle picked these flowers out for you.
We're going to go to lunch in a few minutes, honey.
lines.cn: 我们一下子就去吃中餐，亲爱的。

lines.en: OK. You go out and get a drink of water at the fountain.
lines.cn: 出去在饮水机那儿喝点水吧。

lines.en: The fountain is over there, Michelle.
I used to be that way when I was her age.
lines.cn: 我像她这般年纪也是这样。

lines.en: Harry, if Michelle doesn't want to go, we don't have to.
lines.cn: Harry，如果 Michelle 不想去，我们不必勉强。

lines.en: Remember, I haven't dated any one else since her mother died.
lines.cn: 别忘了，自从她妈妈去世以后，我还没和其他人约会过。

lines.en: This is a little difficult for her.
lines.cn: 这对她来说有点不习惯。

lines.en: Yes. But could you wait one minute?
lines.cn: 是的。不过你能等一下吗？

lines.en: I have a call to make.
Sam, get Mr. Levine at Toytown Stores on the telephone for me, please.
lines.cn: Sam，请给 Toytown Stores 的 Levine 先生，拨个电话。

lines.en: Hello. Susan Stewart calling Mr. Levine, please.
lines.cn: 喂 Susan Stewart 想与 Levine 先生通话。
Levine 先生，我是 Susan Stewart。

lines.en: I find myself in an embarrassing situation.
lines.cn: 我现在遇到了一件尴尬的事。

lines.en: I made another lunch date for today and forgot to enter it in my appointment book.
lines.cn: 我和别人约好共进午餐。却忘记写进预约本了。

lines.en: Can you and I meet for drinks tomorrow?
lines.cn: 你和我能否在明天见面喝点什么？

lines.en: I'd really appreciate it.... Yes.... Thank you....
lines.cn: 我非常感激……好的……谢谢你……

lines.en: Tomorrow at five o'clock at the Biltmore.
lines.cn: 明天五点钟，在 Biltmore 饭店。

lines.en: Welcome to the South Street restaurant, folks.
lines.cn: 欢迎光临南街餐馆，各位。

lines.en: Well, the crab salad's always a big hit.
lines.cn: 嗯，蟹肉沙拉一向是很受欢迎的。

lines.en: Susan, would you like the crab salad?
Michelle, would you like to try the crab salad, too?
lines.cn: Michelle 要不要也试试蟹肉沙拉？

lines.en: We'll have three crab salads and a pitcher of lemonade.
lines.cn: 我们来三份蟹肉沙拉。和一壶柠檬水。

lines.en: Help yourself to celery and carrots and other vegetables.
lines.cn: 请你们自己盛芹菜，胡萝卜和其他蔬菜。

lines.en: We had a summer house on Fire Island.
lines.cn: 我们在火岛有一所避暑别墅。

lines.en: You and Mommy used to take me on the ferryboat.
lines.cn: 你和妈妈常带我坐渡船。

lines.en: Sometimes, at night, we would go down to the beach and catch crabs, remember?
lines.cn: 有时候，在夜里，我们走到海边抓螃蟹，记得吗？

lines.en: With a piece of meat on a string!
lines.cn: 用一根绳子拴着一点肉！

lines.en: Well, I think I'm going to go get us all some vegetables.
lines.cn: 好啦，我想我去给大家盛点蔬菜来。

lines.en: Michelle, can I help you with the lemonade?
lines.cn: Michelle，我帮你倒点柠檬水，好吗？

lines.en: Michelle, can we have a talk?
I know you miss your mother.
Yes. And I'm not trying to take her place.
lines.cn: 是的。而且我并不是想取代她的位置。

lines.en: Then why are you and Daddy spending so much time together?
lines.cn: 那为什么你和爸爸。老是在一起呢？

lines.en: And right now, he needs a friend.
lines.cn: 而且现在，他需要一个朋友。

lines.en: And so are you, I think.
I'd like to be your friend, too.
Will you let me be your friend, Michelle?
lines.cn: Michelle，你愿意让我做你的朋友吗？

lines.en: So, what were you two talking about?

lines.cn: 只是女孩子之间的谈话，爸爸。

lines.en: Oh, it's a quarter to four, and I have a production meeting at four.
lines.cn: 噢，差十五分就四点了，我四点钟有个生产会议。

lines.en: I planned to take you for a ride in Central Park in a horse and carriage.
lines.cn: 我原打算带你去中央公园。坐马车。

lines.en: Harry, I'd love to, but I have work to do.
lines.cn: Harry，我很想去，但我有工作要做。

lines.en: OK. We'll walk back to your office with you.
lines.cn: 我们陪你走回你的办公室去。

lines.en: I decided to forget about my accounting problems and just enjoy this beautiful spring day.
lines.cn: 我已决定不再去想那些会计上的问题。尽情享受这美好的春天。

lines.en: I know I should, but ... well, there are too many things to do.
lines.cn: 我知道应该这样，但是……我要做的事情太多了。

lines.en: I'll go for a ride with Michelle.
lines.cn: 我和 Michelle 一起去坐坐马车。

lines.en: Well, I had a really nice time.
I'm sorry you can't come with us, Susan.
lines.cn: 很遗憾你不能同我们一起去 Susan。

lines.en: Harry! Michelle! Can you wait till I make a phone call?
lines.cn: Harry Michelle 你们等一下让我打个电话好吗？

lines.en: The production department's waiting in the conference room.
lines.cn: 生产部门的人正在会议室等。

lines.en: Ask Paul Smith to fill in for me.
lines.cn: 叫 Paul Smith 代替我出席。

lines.en: He knows everything about the production schedule, and he can answer any questions.
lines.cn: 他知道生产进度的一切，他也可以回答任何问题。

lines.en: Don't tell any one, but I'm taking a little time to smell the flowers.
lines.cn: 别告诉别人，我正利用一点时间轻松一下。
这只是你我之间的秘密。

lines.en: But schedule another production meeting for tomorrow.
lines.cn: 务必安排在明天举行另一次生产会议。

lines.en: I'll be back for my six o'clock appointment with Mr. Ozawa.
lines.cn: 我会回来。参加六点钟与 Ozawa 先生的会议。

lines.en: That's a secret ... between us women.
lines.cn: 这是个秘密……我们女人的秘密。
Ellen 我想听听你的意见。

lines.en: Well, Richard and I feel that with a baby coming we need to have our own place to live.
lines.cn: 嗯，Richard 和我觉得，孩子快出生了，我们需要有自己的住处。

lines.en: Well, what do you think about Richard and me looking for a small house or an apartment at this point in our lives?
lines.cn: 那么，你觉得我和 Richard 现在开始找一栋小房子或一套公寓怎么样？

lines.en: We love having you here, and there is room, and ... and when the baby comes, the baby can stay in your room for a while.
lines.cn: 我们很喜欢你们住在这里，而且地方也够。等孩子出生后，可以先在你们房间里住一阵子。

lines.en: Richard feels we need to find a small house.
lines.cn: Richard 觉得我们需要一个小住宅。

lines.en: I remember when I was pregnant with Richard.
lines.cn: 我记得当我怀着 Richard 时。

lines.en: Philip and I were living with Grandma and Grandpa.
lines.cn: Philip 与我和爷爷奶奶住在一起。

lines.en: Philip was a young doctor, and he kept talking about having a house of our own.
lines.cn: Philip 当时是个年轻的医生，总在说想有一个我们自己的家。

lines.en: We looked at a lot of houses.
Grandpa wanted to lend us the money to buy one, but Philip is too independent.
lines.cn: 爷爷想借钱给我们买房子，但 Philip 太独立了。

lines.en: He didn't want to borrow any money.

lines.cn: 听起来跟 Richard 一样。
Richard 是个典型的 Stewart 家后代。

lines.en: He's independent, and sometimes just stubborn.
lines.cn: 他的独立性强，有时候甚至近乎顽固。

lines.en: When did you buy a house?
lines.cn: 那你们在什么时候买房子？

lines.en: I was teaching music, and Philip was opening his first medical office.
lines.cn: 我当时在教音乐，Philip 则刚开了自己的第一家诊所。

lines.en: Of course, it was a small house, but just right for us.
lines.cn: 当然那是一栋小房，但正好够我们住。

lines.en: Now Richard and I are having a baby, and we probably won't be able to afford a house right away, either.
lines.cn: 现在 Richard 和我也快有孩子了，而我们大概也没办法马上买得起房子。

lines.en: Why don't you look at some houses, Marilyn?
lines.cn: 何不去看一看房子呢 Marilyn？

lines.en: Look in the real-estate section of Sunday's Times.
lines.cn: 查一查星期天的纽约时报房地产版。

lines.en: Maybe we should speak to a real-estate agent about a house.
lines.cn: 也许我们应该找个房地产经纪人，谈谈买房子的事。

lines.en: And a bank about a mortgage.
lines.cn: 还要和银行谈谈住房抵押贷款。

lines.en: I'll talk to Richard about it.
I think it's a good idea, Ellen.
lines.cn: 我觉得这是个好主意 Ellen。

lines.en: We can learn a lot by asking.
lines.cn: 我们到处问问会学到不少东西。

lines.en: And if I can be of any help, let me know.
lines.cn: 如果我能帮上什么忙，就告诉我。

lines.en: As a matter of fact, my friend Virginia Martinelli is a real-estate agent.
lines.cn: 事实上，我的朋友 Virginia Martinelli 就是个房地产中介。

lines.en: You won't believe this, but she sold us our first house and this one.
lines.cn: 你可能不相信，我们的第一栋房子和现在这栋都是她卖给我们的。

lines.en: Well, I'll tell Richard, and we'll go to see her.
lines.cn: 嗯，我会告诉 Richard 我们会去找她。

lines.en: Do you think the skirt length is right, Ellen?
lines.cn: Ellen，你觉得这条裙子的长度合适吗？

lines.en: Do you think it's too long?
I think the skirt is just right.
Are you planning to attach a train to it?
lines.cn: 你打算给它加上拖尾吗？

lines.en: No. No train. Just the dress.
lines.cn: 不加拖尾。就做这条连衣裙。

lines.en: But I am going to make a headpiece of lace.
lines.cn: 但我准备做一个蕾丝头饰。

lines.en: And thanks for the advice about the house.
lines.cn: 也谢谢你关于房子的建议。

lines.en: I'll talk to Richard about it the minute he comes home.
lines.cn: Richard 一回家，我就跟他谈这件事。

lines.en: And remember, we love having you here.
lines.cn: 记住，我们喜欢你们住这。

lines.en: I remember your parents' first house very well.
lines.cn: 我还清楚记得你父母的第一栋房子。

lines.en: It was on Spring Avenue, near the park.
lines.cn: 那房子是在 Spring Avenue 公园附近。

lines.en: I grew up in that house.
lines.cn: 我就在那栋房子长大的。

lines.en: Yes, and you were such a cute baby.
lines.cn: 对，你当时是个很逗人喜爱的婴儿。

lines.en: I've been friendly with the Stewart family for a long time, so it's my pleasure to help you find a house now.
lines.cn: 我和 Stewart 一家交好多年，所以现在很乐意帮你们找房子。

lines.en: Well, we're not sure we can afford one.
lines.cn: 嗯，我们还不知道是不是负担得起。

lines.en: But we'd like to find out about the possibilities.
lines.cn: 但我们想知道，有多大的可能性。

lines.en: I love your house on Linden Street.
lines.cn: 我喜欢你们家在 Linden 街的房子。

lines.en: I sold your father that house seventeen years ago.
lines.cn: 十七年前我把那栋房子卖给你父亲的。

lines.en: Yes, Mom was pregnant with Robbie then, and they needed the extra room.
lines.cn: 是的，妈妈那时怀着 Robbie，他们需要更多空间。

lines.en: I hear you're expecting a baby, Mrs. Stewart.
lines.cn: 我听说你们快有小孩了 Stewart 太太。

lines.en: So we will be needing more room.
lines.cn: 所以我们也将需要更大的空间。

lines.en: Oh, so you don't need something immediately?
lines.cn: 呵，所以你们不是急着马上就要？

lines.en: No. But in five or six months ...
Well, when you called, you gave me enough information about your salaries and your savings.
lines.cn: 你们打电话来时，已经提供了足够的薪资和储蓄信息。

lines.en: So I have a good idea about your financial situation.
lines.cn: 所以，我很了解你们的财务状况。

lines.en: Let me show you some pictures of houses.
lines.cn: 我来给你们看看一些房子的照片。

lines.en: Yes, I think I can show you some.
lines.cn: 是的，我有一些可以给你们看。

lines.en: Of course, they won't be in Riverdale.
lines.cn: 当然这些房子不在 Riverdale。

lines.en: The cost of housing's too high for you here.
lines.cn: 这里的房子对你们来说太贵了。

lines.en: I haven't thought about living anywhere else.
lines.cn: 我还没有考虑要住到别的地方去。

lines.en: We've always lived in this area.
lines.cn: 我们一直住在这个地区。

lines.en: Where should we look for a house, Mrs. Martinelli?
lines.cn: 我们应到什么地方找房子 Martinelli 太太？

lines.en: Well, we have an office in Mount Kisco.
lines.cn: 好，我们在 Mount Kisco 有个办事处。

lines.en: It's a lovely area, and it's only about an hour's drive from here.
lines.cn: 那是个很好的地方，从这里开车过去大约只要一个小时。

lines.en: I have a book with photos of some homes in that area.
lines.cn: 我有一本相册，里面是那个地区的一些房子。

lines.en: This is a lovely two-bedroom house in your price range.
lines.cn: 这一栋可爱房子有两间卧室，在你们价格范围内。

lines.en: It's pretty, but I prefer a two-story home.
lines.cn: 是漂亮，但我喜欢两层楼的房子。

lines.en: I don't care for a ranch type.
Oh, this is a wonderful house.
lines.cn: 啊，这是一栋很好的房子，

lines.en: I sold it to the present owners.
lines.cn: 是我把它卖给了现在的主人。

lines.en: This is a two-bedroom, two-bath house.
lines.cn: 这是一栋有两间卧室，两间盥洗室的房子。

lines.en: It has a full basement, and it is on a half-acre lot.
lines.cn: 它有一个完整的地下室，占地半英亩。

lines.en: You can probably afford this one.
lines.cn: 你可能负担得起这栋房子。

lines.en: Would you like to go see it?
to talk to someone at the bank next week.
lines.cn: 我们打算下周找银行的人谈一谈。

lines.en: Perhaps we could see the house this weekend.
lines.cn: 也许这周末我们会去看看这栋房子。

lines.en: If someone doesn't buy it before then,
lines.cn: 如果到时候还没有被人买走的话。

lines.en: Just to get an idea of some other possibilities.
This is very helpful, Mrs. Martinelli.
lines.cn: 这样很有用 Martinelli 太太。

lines.en: This is a wonderful example of Spanish-style architecture.
lines.cn: 这是栋很棒的典型西班牙式建筑。

lines.en: Oh, I love the roof tiles on a Spanish-style house.
lines.cn: 噢，我喜欢西班牙式房屋的屋顶瓦。

lines.en: It looks like the houses in Hollywood.
lines.cn: 看起来好像是好莱坞的房子。

lines.en: A house like this in Riverdale costs double the price.
lines.cn: 在 Riverdale 像这样的房子价格要贵一倍。

lines.en: This house just came on the market.
lines.cn: 这栋房子刚刚推出要卖。

lines.en: No. It has three bedrooms and three baths.
lines.cn: 这栋房子有三间卧室，三间盥洗室。

lines.en: It has a brand new kitchen.
And a living room with a twelve-foot ceiling.
lines.cn: 还有一间天花板高十二英尺的客厅。
还有一个可放两辆车的车库。

lines.en: Then why don't we go look at this house, too?
lines.cn: 那我们何不也去看看这栋房子呢？

lines.en: Give my best to your parents.
Your father's a wonderful doctor, Richard.
lines.cn: 你父亲是个了不起的医生 Richard。

lines.en: He took care of my daughter when she was a child.
lines.cn: 我女儿小时候是他照顾的。

lines.en: He's the best pediatrician in Westchester.
lines.cn: 他是全 Westchester 最好的小儿科医师。
我会向他们转达你的问候。
我们非常感谢你的建议。

lines.en: I do think you should go see the houses and talk to the bank.
lines.cn: 我的确认为你们应该去看看这些房子，再和银行谈谈。

lines.en: Let me give you some information sheets about the houses.
lines.cn: 我给你们一些关于这些房子的简介。

lines.en: Well, thanks so much for your help and your time, Mrs. Martinelli.
lines.cn: Martinelli 太太，非常感谢你的帮助，也谢谢你抽出时间。

lines.en: We've got a lot to talk about.
lines.cn: 我们有很多可商量的了。

lines.en: I'm Richard Stewart, and this is my wife, Marilyn.
lines.cn: 我叫 Richard Stewart 这是我妻子 Marilyn。
我们也一样 Riley 先生。

lines.en: Please, sit down. What can I do for you?
lines.cn: 请坐下。我能为你们做什么？

lines.en: We'd like to discuss a mortgage.
lines.cn: 我们想请教一下贷款的事。

lines.en: Fine. Are you buying a house
or are you refinancing your present home?
lines.cn: 你们是要买房子，还是想给现有的房子重新办理贷款？

lines.en: We're planning to buy a house.
And we'd like to find out about a mortgage.
We are customers of the bank.
As a matter of fact, my whole family banks here.
lines.cn: 事实上，我们全家都是贵行的顾客。

lines.en: I have some questions to ask.
Do you own your house or do you rent?
lines.cn: 你们自己有房子还是租房？

lines.en: We live with my parents, Dr. and Mrs. Philip Stewart.
lines.cn: 我们和我的父母住在一起，也就是 Philip Stewart 医生夫妇。

lines.en: And, Mr. Stewart, what is your occupation?
lines.cn: 那么 Stewart 先生，你的职业呢？

lines.en: And, Mrs. Stewart, are you working?
lines.cn: 嗯 Stewart 太太，你有工作吗？

lines.en: Yes. I'm a designer, and I work in a boutique.
lines.cn: 是的，我是位设计师，我在一家服装店工作。

lines.en: Did you bring any savings or salary information?
lines.cn: 你们带了储蓄或薪资方面的资料吗？
比如去年的纳税申报表？

lines.en: OK. What ... what kind of house did you have in mind?
lines.cn: 你们打算买什么样的房子？

lines.en: We're talking about buying a two-bedroom house in Mount Kisco.
lines.cn: 我们正在商量买一栋位于 Mount Kisco、有两间卧室的房子。

lines.en: Here are the financial details on the house.
lines.cn: 这是那栋房子的财务资料。

lines.en: Are you prepared to make a ten-percent down payment?
lines.cn: 你们准备支付百分之十的首付款吗？

lines.en: Do you think we can get a loan?
lines.cn: 你觉得我们能得到贷款吗？

lines.en: Well, it depends. Do you own any other property?
lines.cn: 嗯，这还要看情况。你们拥有其他什么财产吗？

lines.en: I see. Then you don't have any collateral.
lines.cn: 我明白了。那么你们没有任何抵押物。

lines.en: Perhaps you could get a guarantor-- someone to sign for the loan for you.
lines.cn: 也许你们可以找一位担保人，替你们的贷款签字担保。

lines.en: Since you don't have enough income, and you don't already own any property, the bank needs to be sure you can pay the mortgage every month.
lines.cn: 因为你们的收入不够，也没有其他财产，银行需要确保你们每月都能偿还房贷。

lines.en: A guarantor is responsible for the loan if you can't make the payments.
lines.cn: 如果你们无法还款，担保人就要负责偿还贷款。

lines.en: I see. Well, the idea of buying a house is exciting.
lines.cn: 我明白了。嗯，买房子的想法真让人兴奋。

lines.en: Thank you, Mr. Riley. We'll read this over carefully.
lines.cn: 谢谢你 Riley 先生。我们会仔细阅读这些。

lines.en: Good-bye. And hope to see you soon.
lines.cn: 再见。希望很快再见到你们。

lines.en: It all sounded so easy until they mentioned needing collateral or a guarantor.
lines.cn: 在他们提到需要抵押物或担保人之前，一切听起来都那么容易。

lines.en: And I don't think it's a good idea to ask Dad to sign as a guarantor.
lines.cn: 而且，我不觉得请爸爸当担保人是个好主意。

lines.en: I don't feel right about it.
I understand your feelings about it, Richard.
lines.cn: 我了解你对这种事情的心情 Richard。

lines.en: We can get a loan from the bank [03:25.43]if we can put up some collateral.
lines.cn: 如果我们能提供一些抵押物，就能从银行获得贷款。

lines.en: And we don't own anything to use as collateral.
lines.cn: 可是我们没有任何可以做抵押物的东西。

lines.en: Or someone can sign with us as a guarantor.
lines.cn: 或者有人能当担保人帮我们签字。

lines.en: Why don't you speak to Dad?
lines.cn: 你们为什么不跟爸爸说说？

lines.en: No. If we buy a house, I want to be able to handle it alone.
lines.cn: 如果我们买房子，我希望能独立承担。
每个人都有需要帮助的时候 Richard。

lines.en: I understand Richard's feelings about it, Ellen.
lines.cn: 我了解 Richard 对此的想法 Ellen。

lines.en: In two or three months, I'll have an advance on my book and be able to put more money down.
lines.cn: 再过两三个月，我就能拿到那本书的预付稿酬，可以多付一些首付款。

lines.en: What about the house in Mount Kisco?
lines.cn: 在 Mount Kisco 的房子呢？

lines.en: Somebody else'll buy it by then.
Then there'll be other houses, Marilyn.
Richard has a point. You're just beginning to look. Richard
lines.cn: Richard 说得有道理。你们才刚开始看房子。

lines.en: We're in no great rush. It's true.
This has been a great learning experience for us, Marilyn.
lines.cn: Marilyn，这对我们是一次很好的学习经历。

lines.en: Talking to the loan officer at the bank.
lines.cn: 与银行的贷款负责人谈。

lines.en: It has been a learning experience. That's true.
lines.cn: 这真是一次学习经验，真的。

lines.en: I think you're doing the right thing. Taking your time.
lines.cn: 我觉得你们做得对。慢慢来。

lines.en: Looking around. Especially with a purchase of this kind.
lines.cn: 到处看看，特别是这一类买卖。

lines.en: You're talking about a lot of money.
lines.cn: 你们谈的可是一大笔钱。

lines.en: We'll call Mrs. Martinelli and tell her to keep looking for us.
lines.cn: 我们会打电话给 Martinelli 太太，请她继续帮我们找房子。

lines.en: And I'll call Mr. Riley at the bank and tell him we'll see him in a couple of months.
lines.cn: 我会打电话给银行的 Riley 先生，告诉他我们过几个月再去找他。

lines.en: And if you ever need Dad or me to help you ...
lines.cn: 如果你们的确需要我和爸爸的帮助的话 ……

lines.en: You know we'll be there for you.
lines.cn: 你们知道我们是会伸出援手的。

lines.en: It's a Stewart tradition. We're a family.
lines.cn: 这是 Stewart 家的传统。我们是一家人。

lines.en: Am I glad to see you!
And am I glad to see you!
I am also glad to be here.
I have been talking to a group of salesmen since ten this morning, and I'm real exhausted.
lines.cn: 从今天上午十点起，我一直在和一群销售人员谈话，真是累坏了。

lines.en: He and Michelle are visiting relatives in New Jersey today.
lines.cn: 他和 Michelle 今天去 New Jersey 拜访亲戚了。

lines.en: The rest of our family went to the movies.
lines.cn: 我们家其余的人都去看电影了。

lines.en: So it's just you and me, Susan.
lines.cn: 所以，这只有你和我 Susan。

lines.en: It's nice to be alone with you, Grandpa.
lines.cn: 很高兴单独与你在一起，爷爷。

lines.en: We don't get to see enough of each other.
lines.cn: 我们在一起的时间太少了。

lines.en: Oh, I feel the same way, Susan.
lines.cn: 噢，我也有同样的感受 Susan。

lines.en: But to tell the truth, next time I'd like to go into the city and meet you there, instead of you coming here.
lines.cn: 不过说实话，下次我想到城里去看你，不用你来这里。

lines.en: You don't need to do that, Grandpa.
I need to get out more.
Well, I mean there's a lot to do around the house, and I love being here with the family, you know, but I'm restless.
lines.cn: 我是说，家里有很多事可做，我也喜欢和家人在一起，你知道的，但我就是闲不住。

lines.en: Since I retired, I've got extra time on my hands.
lines.cn: 自从退休后，我多出了很多空闲时间。

lines.en: Frankly, I'd like to use my brain a little more.
lines.cn: 坦白说，我想多动动脑子。

lines.en: Grandpa, you have so much energy and so many years of experience.
lines.cn: 爷爷，你精力这么充沛，又有这么多年的经验。

lines.en: There are probably a lot of places for you to work Particularly in the construction field.
lines.cn: 应该有很多地方可以让你工作，特别是在建筑行业。

lines.en: But at my age, I'm not looking for a full-time job.
lines.cn: 不过到了我这个年纪，我不想再找一份全职工作。

lines.en: Let's go into the kitchen, and maybe you can help me set the table.
lines.cn: 我们到厨房去吧，也许你能帮我摆餐具。

lines.en: I prepared lamb chops, mashed potatoes, and a tossed green salad to begin with.
lines.cn: 我准备了羊排、土豆泥，还有一道拌蔬菜沙拉作为开胃菜。

lines.en: Grandpa, you are a terrific guy!
You're still thinking about something to do, aren't you?
lines.cn: 你还在想要找点事做，是吗？

lines.en: I've been thinking about it for weeks now.
lines.cn: 为这事我想了几个星期。

lines.en: There must be some way to put my mind to good use.
lines.cn: 总会有办法让我发挥才能。
我们会找到解决的办法。

lines.en: A positive solution to your finding a way to use that wonderful mind of yours.
lines.cn: 一定能找到好办法，让你聪明的头脑发挥作用。

lines.en: Sam, would you come in, please? Sam
You sound like something's bothering you, Susan.
lines.cn: 听起来好像有什么心事 Susan。

lines.en: The sketches for the cover of the new doll book?
lines.cn: 是新玩具书的封面设计？

lines.en: I need your advice on a personsal matter, but it's not about me.
lines.cn: 我有件私事想听听你的建议，不过不是关于我自己的。

lines.en: You need my advice on a personal matter,
lines.cn: 你有件私事想听我的意见，却又不是关于你自己。
你有件私事想听我的意见，却又不是关于你自己。好吧。

lines.en: It won't sound like a big deal, but it is.
lines.cn: 这事听起来也许不严重，但其实很重要。

lines.en: I had dinner with him Saturday, and he's very unhappy about not working.
lines.cn: 星期六我和他一起吃晚饭，他因为没工作而闷闷不乐。

lines.en: I thought he was retired and pleased to be living with the family.
lines.cn: 我以为他退休了，很高兴能和家人住在一起。

lines.en: He is, but there's so much energy and talent in the man, and he doesn't get to use it.
lines.cn: 是这样，但他有那么多精力和才华，却没有机会施展。

lines.en: What kind of advice are you looking for?
John Marchetta runs this company. John Marchetta
lines.cn: John Marchetta 经营这家公司。

lines.en: John Marchetta gave me my start here six years ago, When I first graduated from college.
lines.cn: 六年前，我刚大学毕业时，John Marchetta 给了我在这里起步的机会。

lines.en: He gave me the chance to use my talents and made me feel more confident.
lines.cn: 他给我施展才能的机会，让我更加自信。

lines.en: Maybe he can do the same thing for your grandfather.
lines.cn: 也许他能为你爷爷做同样的事。

lines.en: Or at least give him some advice.
lines.cn: 再不然至少可以给他一些忠告。
说来我替你解决问题了。

lines.en: I can always depend on you, Sam.
Shall I call Mr. Marchetta for you?
lines.cn: 要我替你打电话给 Marchetta 先生吗？
那么 Stewart 全家人都还好吧？
都好，谢谢你 Marchetta 先生。

lines.en: In fact, that is the reason why I'm here to see you.
lines.cn: 事实上，这是我来见你的原因。

lines.en: I know you're building a new factory, and I thought ... maybe ... my grandfather is so experienced in the construction trade, he could be so valuable.
lines.cn: 我知道你正在建一座新工厂，就想……也许……我爷爷在建筑行业经验丰富，能帮上不少忙。

lines.en: Tell him to come and see me at ten o'clock tomorrow morning.
lines.cn: 告诉他明天上午十点来见我。

lines.en: I have an idea that may solve the problem for him and help a lot of other people.
lines.cn: 我有个主意，也许既能解决他的问题，又能帮助许多其他人。
我可以把这消息告诉他？

lines.en: Ten o'clock in the morning. Here.
Susan has told me a great deal about you.
lines.cn: Susan 告诉我许多关于你的事。

lines.en: She says you're quite a man.
lines.cn: 她说你是个了不起的人。

lines.en: She says a lot of wonderful things about you too, Mr. Stewart.
lines.cn: Stewart 先生，她也说了很多你的好话。

lines.en: That's always nice to hear, Mr. Marchetta.
lines.cn: 听到这事总是好的 Marchetta 先生。

lines.en: I understand you used to be in the construction business.
lines.cn: 我听说你以前在建筑行业工作。

lines.en: Here's a brief description of forty-three years of on-the-job training.
lines.cn: 这是我四十三年工作实践经历的简要介绍。

lines.en: Half that time in my own construction company.
lines.cn: 一半时间是在我自己的营造公司。
大的工程，工厂，购物商场。

lines.en: After my wife died, and I felt I should spend more time with my children and grandchildren.
lines.cn: 我妻子去世后，我觉得应该多花点时间陪孩子和孙辈们。

lines.en: I lived in Florida, and they lived in New York.
lines.cn: 我住在 Florida，他们则住在 New York。

lines.en: My dautghter Cami lives in New York.
lines.cn: 我女儿 Cami 住在纽约。

lines.en: When I came here, I planned to take a few months off.
lines.cn: 刚来这里时，我打算先休息几个月。

lines.en: Relax with the family and then look for some work.
lines.cn: 与家人轻松一段时间然后找个工作。

lines.en: Put my experience on the line ...
but, unfortunately, there isn't any work for a retired person my age.
lines.cn: 但遗憾的是，找不到适合我这个年纪的退休人员的工作。

lines.en: Sometimes there is, and sometimes there isn't.
Well, I'm involved with an organization, and we're trying to resolve that problem.
lines.cn: 我参加了一个组织，我们正在努力解决这个问题。

lines.en: I'd like to be a member.
The organization serves major companies in this city.
lines.cn: 这个组织为本市各大公司服务。

lines.en: Because our members are men and women like you.
lines.cn: 因为这个组织的会员都是像你这样的人。

lines.en: But our members want to go out there and use their talents.
lines.cn: 但我们的会员想走出去，施展自己的才能。

lines.en: I've got an idea for you, Malcolm.
lines.cn: 我倒替你想出了一个主意 Malcolm。

lines.en: Just fill out this form for me.
It'll only take a few minutes.
Sit right here, and do it while I talk to my secretary.
lines.cn: 就坐在这里填吧，我去跟秘书说几句话。

lines.en: When I get back, we'll talk about my new factory.
lines.cn: 我回来后，我们谈一谈我的新工厂。

lines.en: My company is a member of TOPS.
lines.cn: 我的公司也是 TOPS（老年人才协会）的会员。

lines.en: So I try hard to find opportunities for people like you.
lines.cn: 所以我努力为像你这样的人寻找机会。

lines.en: And when I see an opportunity, I can act on it.
lines.cn: 一看到机会，我就能采取行动。

lines.en: Well, I can use your brainpower on the job right now.
lines.cn: 嗯，我马上可以将你的才智用在这项工程上。

lines.en: Have you got time this morning to go over to the construction site with me?
lines.cn: 今天上午你有空和我去工地看看吗？

lines.en: I'd like to have you meet my foreman-- get some background on the job.
lines.cn: 我想让你认识一下我的工头，了解这项工程的一些情况。

lines.en: We'll go over to the job site together.
Malcolm, you worked on the Spaceport project?

lines.cn: 我的公司承包了这项工程。

lines.en: I built the theater there with my own two hands, practically.
lines.cn: 那里的剧院几乎是我亲手建起来的。

lines.en: Well, I'm glad to see you two guys getting along so well because, Danny, Malcolm is on the TOPS team.
lines.cn: 看到你们俩这么合得来，我很高兴，因为 Danny，Malcolm 是 TOPS 团队的一员。

lines.en: He's going to be working with you for a while.
lines.cn: 他将与你一起工作一段时间。

lines.en: His experience will be valuable to both of us.
lines.cn: 他的经验对你我都很有用。

lines.en: I'm going back to my office.
Give me a call later, Malcolm.
lines.cn: 请稍后打电话给我 Malcolm。

lines.en: I'll tell you the time and date of the next TOPS meeting.
lines.cn: 我要告诉你 TOPS 下次聚会的时间。

lines.en: I'd like you to meet the group.
lines.cn: 我希望你能与协会的成员见面。

lines.en: I know you didn't expect to have me around, but I think I can be of some help to you.
lines.cn: 我知道你没想到我会来，但我想我能帮上你一些忙。

lines.en: Let me tell you something, Malcolm.
With your background and experience, I can learn something ... and I do need some advice on a difficult problem.
lines.cn: 凭你的背景和经验，我能学到不少东西……而且我的确有个难题需要请教。

lines.en: I don't want to give you a final opinion without studying these building plans more carefully.
lines.cn: 没仔细研究这些建筑图纸之前，我不想给你最终意见。

lines.en: But a simple solution might be to move the air-conditioning units instead of redesigning the entire system.
