lines.cn: 不过，一个简单的办法可能是挪动空调机组，而不用重新设计整个系统。

lines.en: It might be simpler and less expensive .
lines.cn: 这样可能比较简单而且省钱。

lines.en: You just earned your weight in gold, Malcolm.
I'm glad Mr. Marchetta was so helpful.
lines.cn: 我真高兴 Marchetta 先生如此帮忙。

lines.en: He actually took me to meet his foreman.
lines.cn: 事实上他带着我去见他的工头。

lines.en: I don't know how to thank you, Susan.
lines.cn: 我不知道如何谢你 Susan。

lines.en: It's good to see you so happy.
I'll be at the construction site tomorrow.
What are you doing tomorrow night?
lines.cn: 你明天晚上有什么安排？

lines.en: How about a date with your grandfather?
I owe you a good steak dinner.
I'll pick you up here at seven .
And you can tell me all about your first full day back on the job.
lines.cn: 到时候，你可以告诉我重返工作岗位第一个完整工作日的所有情况。

lines.en: There's nothing more joyous than the arrival of a new baby.
lines.cn: 没有任何事能比新生儿的到来更令人喜悦的了。

lines.en: Just imagine--Marilyn and Richard must be thrilled!
lines.cn: 想像得出 Marilyn 和 Richard 一定乐坏了！

lines.en: Oh, it's a sweet-sounding name for a sweet little boy.
lines.cn: 噢，好一个甜美悦耳的名字拿来配个甜美的小孩。

lines.en: He looks a lot like you, Mom. He does.
lines.cn: 妈妈，他长得很像你，真的。

lines.en: Well, I guess. He does look a lot like Richard,
and I guess he looks a lot like me.
lines.cn: 他的确很像 Richard，我想也挺像我。

lines.en: Oh, he's got Richard's eyes, though.
lines.cn: 噢，他的眼睛跟 Richard 的像极了。

lines.en: I really want Harry and Michelle to see Max.
lines.cn: 我真希望 Harry 和 Michelle 来看看 Max。

lines.en: Tomorrow. Harry has an account to work on today.
lines.cn: 明天。Harry 今天有项会计工作要做。

lines.en: Yes, he does have Richard's eyes. Big blue eyes.
lines.cn: 是的，他的眼睛很像 Richard。蓝色大眼睛。

lines.en: [01:20.17]The baby even looks at you like Richard does.
lines.cn: 这婴儿看你的时候也像 Richard 那样。

lines.en: Well, children usually resemble their parents.
Michelle is a lot like Harry in so many ways.
lines.cn: Michelle 在许多方面都很像 Harry。

lines.en: And she's shy with new people, just like he is.
lines.cn: 她见了生人就害羞，与他一样。

lines.en: You really like Michelle, don't you?
lines.cn: 你确实很喜欢 Michelle，对吧？

lines.en: Yes. I'm very fond of her.

lines.cn: 啊，已经四点半了，噢，天啦！

lines.en: Marilyn and Richard will be home from the hospital any minute, and we must prepare this room.
lines.cn: Marilyn 和 Richard 随时都会从医院回来，我们得把房间准备好。

lines.en: Where will we put all the presents?
Well, let's take everything to the living room.
lines.cn: 嗯，我们把东西都放到客厅去。

lines.en: Marilyn and Richard and the baby need the space.
lines.cn: Marilyn 和 Richard 还有婴儿需要空间。
欢迎的标语已经弄好了。
一个曾孙。 一个曾孙。

lines.en: Another generation to carry on the Stewart name.
lines.cn: 这是承继 Stewart 家族香火的新一代。

lines.en: You make me feel so proud to be part of our family.
lines.cn: 你让我以成为我们家庭的一员而自豪。

lines.en: One day, you'll have your own family, and I'll be proud to be part of it.
lines.cn: 总有一天你会有自己的家，那时我会以成为其中一员而自豪。

lines.en: Now you understand my feelings, Susan.
lines.cn: 现在你能理解我的感受了 Susan。

lines.en: I'm Grandpa's daughter-in-law, but I feel like a Stewart.
lines.cn: 我是爷爷的儿媳，但我觉得自己就是 Stewart 家的一员。

lines.en: He's always made me feel like his own daughter.
lines.cn: 他总是让我觉得我是他的亲生女儿。

lines.en: Well, that's because you're so much like us--wonderful!
lines.cn: 那是因为你和我们一样——都很棒！

lines.en: This will make a nice gift for Marilyn and Richard.
lines.cn: 这是给 Richard 和 Marilyn 的一件好礼物。

lines.en: They can keep a record of all of the important dates and information about Max's life here.
lines.cn: 他们可以在这里记录 Max 成长中的重要日期和各种信息。

lines.en: Does he have a middle name?
No, just Max. I like that.
lines.cn: 没有，就是 Max。我喜欢这样。

lines.en: No middle name. No middle initial.
lines.cn: 没有中间的名字。没有中间的字母。
像我一样。我叫 Malcolm Stewart。

lines.en: And Max has your initials, Grandpa:
lines.cn: 爷爷，Max 姓名的首字母和你一样，
八磅六盎司。真是个大宝宝！

lines.en: All the Stewart men were big.
lines.cn: Stewart 家的男孩子出生时都很大。

lines.en: Well, Robbie was eight pounds two ounces, and Richard was eight pounds three.
lines.cn: Robbie 出生时是八磅二盎司，Richard 是八磅三盎司。

lines.en: You were big, just like Max.
lines.cn: 你也很大，就像 Max 一样。

lines.en: Eight pounds six, just like me.
Richard says Max is twenty-one inches long.
lines.cn: Richard 说 Max 是二十一英寸长。

lines.en: Is that tall or average or what?
lines.cn: 这样尺寸是高呢，还是普通，或者算怎样？

lines.en: Tall. All the Stewart men are tall.
lines.cn: 高 Stewart 家的男人都高。

lines.en: Well, Grandpa, you're about five-nine or five-ten.
lines.cn: 爷爷，你大概有五英尺九英寸或五英尺十英寸高。

lines.en: I take after my mother's family.
They were ... they were ... they were average.
lines.cn: 他们……他们……他们是普通身材。

lines.en: And lots of pages for Richard's photos of Max.
lines.cn: 有好多页可用来贴 Richard 给 Max 拍的照片。

lines.en: Speaking of mother and of father --and speaking of Max--I hear the car.
lines.cn: 说到爸爸妈妈，还有 Max——我听到汽车声了。

lines.en: Oh! Oh, quickly! Go, go, go!

lines.cn: 让我看看。噢，欢迎回家来。

lines.en: Wait with your pictures for a second.
Oh, he's so cute! Oh, Marilyn!
lines.cn: 噢，他真逗人喜爱，噢 Marilyn！
一个真正的 Stewart 家后代。

lines.en: I'm so happy to be home with my family--and with Max.
lines.cn: 我真高兴回到家，和家人还有 Max 在一起。

lines.en: I've got to go. Tomorrow is Monday,
and work begins at eight in the morning for me.
lines.cn: 明天星期一，我早上八点就要上班。

lines.en: Oh, I'm so happy that Max is home.
lines.cn: 噢，我真高兴 Max 回到家了。

lines.en: I'll drive you to the station, dear.
lines.cn: 亲爱的，我开车送你去车站。

lines.en: You can catch the ten-twenty train to Grand Central Station.
lines.cn: 你能赶上十点二十分开往中央车站的火车。

lines.en: Then Grandpa, Robbie, and I can finish wrapping all these gifts.
lines.cn: 那爷爷、Robbie 和我就可以把这些礼物都包装好。

lines.en: It's so good to have you home again ... and to see Max asleep in his bassinet at home with us.
lines.cn: 你又回到家里，Max 也和我们在一起，睡在家中的摇篮里，真好。

lines.en: To be with our family and all that Stewart TLC.
lines.cn: 真高兴和全家人在一起，受到 Stewart 家族无微不至的照顾。

lines.en: Did you see the washcloth and the towels with the teddy bears on them?
lines.cn: 你看到那些印着泰迪熊的洗脸巾和毛巾了吗？

lines.en: Alexandra and the Molinas sent them for Max.
lines.cn: 那是 Alexandra 和 Molina 全家送给 Max 的。

lines.en: It was so kind of them.
Now Max has come into everyone's life.
lines.cn: 现在 Max 走进了每个人的生活。

lines.en: The house is so alive with him here.
lines.cn: 有他在，整个家都充满了生气。

lines.en: The welcome sign over the door.

lines.cn: 摇篮上的 MAX 字样。

lines.en: So cuddly. The beautiful crib from Mom and Dad.
lines.cn: 抱起来真舒服。爸爸妈妈送的漂亮婴儿床。
噢，还有爷爷的棒球手套。

lines.en: You know, it hung over my crib, too.
lines.cn: 要知道，我的小床上也曾挂过它。

lines.en: And it hung over Robbie's crib.

lines.cn: 这是爷爷魔法的一部分吗？

lines.en: That's right. Grandpa hangs it there for good luck.
lines.cn: 是的。爷爷把它挂着以求好运。

lines.en: He says it always brought him good luck on the baseball team.
lines.cn: 他说，当年他在棒球队，手套总是带给他好运。

lines.en: He believes it'll bring good luck to all the Stewart babies.
lines.cn: 他相信这手套会给 Stewart 家所有的婴儿带来好运。

lines.en: And then he takes it back when Max is ready to use it?
lines.cn: 等 Max 长大能用手套时，爷爷就把它收回去？

lines.en: Yes, and replaces it with a new glove so the old one will be ready for a new member of the Stewart family.
lines.cn: 对，换给他一只新手套，这只旧手套就能留给 Stewart 家的下一个新成员了。

lines.en: Grandpa really loves his family, doesn't he?
lines.cn: 爷爷确实很爱这个家，是吗？
这套婴儿装不是很可爱吗？

lines.en: Thanks so much, Harry and Michelle.
lines.cn: 太感谢你们了，Harry 和 Michelle。

lines.en: Yes, I told Daddy to pick blue ones.
lines.cn: 是的。我告诉爸爸选蓝色的。

lines.en: Blue is for boys, and pink is for girls.
lines.cn: 蓝色是男孩子的，粉红色是女孩子的。
他是个十足的 Stewart 家的人。

lines.en: That was so thoughtful of you, Michelle.
Especially to pick it out in blue.
lines.cn: 还特地选了一件蓝色的。

lines.en: Would you like to see baby Max, Michelle?
lines.cn: Michelle，你想看看小 Max 吗？
她能看看吗，我们能看看吗？

lines.en: Harry and Michelle can watch Max sleeping.
lines.cn: Harry 和 Michelle 可以去看 Max 在睡觉。
趁 Max 还没有醒来。

lines.en: Will you please take this upstairs, Susan?
lines.cn: Susan，麻烦你把这个带上楼，好吗？

lines.en: Michelle is very grown up for a ten-year-old, huh?
lines.cn: 以一个十岁的孩子来讲 Michelle 很成熟，是吗？

lines.en: She's smart and sensitive for her age.
lines.cn: 就这样的年龄来说，她很聪明而且懂事。

lines.en: Growing up without a mother is difficult.
lines.cn: 在没有母亲的情况下，长大不简单。

lines.en: Susan's like a mother to Michelle.
lines.cn: Susan 就像是 Michelle 的母亲。

lines.en: Do you think Susan and Harry will get married?
lines.cn: 你觉得 Susan 和 Harry 会结婚吗？

lines.en: Yeah. You can count on it.
lines.cn: 是的，这一点你可以放心。

lines.en: I think so. Yes. They get along so well.
lines.cn: 我也觉得是这样。他们相处得很好。

lines.en: I like him. He's good for Susan.
lines.cn: 我喜欢他。他很适合 Susan。

lines.en: It's hard to do anything but listen in this family.
lines.cn: 在这个家庭，除了听别人之外还能怎样。

lines.en: It's the way it should be.

lines.cn: 这就是 Stewart 家人的本性！

lines.en: They always were, and they always will be.
lines.cn: 他们过去一直如此，将来也永远如此。

lines.en: and if he talks as loudly as he cries, we're all in for trouble.
lines.cn: 要是他说话和哭起来一样响，我们可就有得受了。

lines.en: It's not necessary to whisper, Harry.
lines.cn: 没有必要压低声音 Harry。

lines.en: A baby gets used to voices.
We always whispered when Michelle was born.
lines.cn: Michelle 出生的时候，我们总是压低嗓门说话。

lines.en: And I didn't sleep well, Daddy told me.
lines.cn: 而我总是睡不好。爸爸告诉我的。

lines.en: And when I did, I woke up when I heard someone speak.
lines.cn: 即使睡着了，一听到有人说话，我也会醒来。
我打赌你当时很逗人喜爱。
不如 Max 这么逗人喜爱。

lines.en: Now I can help diaper him.
lines.cn: 我现在可以帮他换尿布了。

lines.en: What do you do when he cries like that?
lines.cn: 像他哭得这个样子，怎么办？
他这么小……才刚来到这个世界。
我们还是叫 Marilyn 来吧。

lines.en: Time for a feeding and time for a diapering.
lines.cn: 该喂奶换尿布的时候了。
你是个真正的 Stewart 家后代。

lines.en: You like living in New York, don't you?
lines.cn: 你喜欢住在 New York，对吧？

lines.en: I can take the bus to work ... or the subway ... or a taxi.
lines.cn: 我可以坐公交车去上班……也可以坐地铁……或者出租车。

lines.en: And there's so much to do.
lines.cn: 而且这总是有许多事可做。

lines.en: Lots of movie houses, and the theater.
I'd like to live in the city,
lines.cn: 我明白你的意思。我也想住在城里，不过 New Jersey 的郊区更适合 Michelle，有树，也有草地。

lines.en: but living in New Jersey and the suburbs
lines.cn: 我也想住在城里，不过 New Jersey 的郊区更适合 Michelle，有树，
我明白你的意思。我也想住在城里，不过 New Jersey 的郊区更适合 Michelle，有树，也有草地。

lines.en: There's a lot of good things about suburban living.
lines.cn: 郊区生活是有许多优点。

lines.en: I grew up in Riverdale, remember?
lines.cn: 你记得吗，我就是在 Riverdale 长大？

lines.en: But, as a working woman, I think New York has all the conveniences-- including the best tomatoes.
lines.cn: 但作为职业女性，我觉得 New York 一切都很便利，连最好的西红柿都买得到。

lines.en: The truth is, I'd like to live in the city.
lines.cn: 老实说我也想住到城里来。
Michelle 正处于成长的年龄。

lines.en: There are lots of things for her here.
lines.cn: 这里有许多适合她的东西。
今天就是一个很好的例子。

lines.en: Michelle and her friends are at the aquarium in Brooklyn.
lines.cn: Michelle 和她的朋友们在参观 Brooklyn 的水族馆。

lines.en: They come back here for lunch, then go uptown to the Museum of Natural History.
lines.cn: 她们回来吃午饭，然后去上城区的自然历史博物馆。

lines.en: There's so much for young people to see and do.
lines.cn: 这有很多可供年轻人看和做的事情。

lines.en: I've never been to the aquarium
lines.cn: 我从来没去过水族馆，也没去过自然历史博物馆。你呢？

lines.en: or the Museum of Natural History.
lines.cn: 我从来没去过水族馆，也没去过自然历史博物馆。
去过，Harry。我父母以前常在周末带我们到城里各处玩。

lines.en: often took us somewhere in the city on the weekends.
lines.cn: Harry。我父母以前常在周末带我们到城里各处玩。

lines.en: Dad was a busy doctor, but he usually managed to squeeze a Sunday in with Richard, Robbie, and me.
lines.cn: 爸爸是个忙碌的医生，但他通常会设法抽出星期天，陪 Richard、Robbie 和我。

lines.en: I used to love to go to the Metropolitan Museum of Art.
lines.cn: 我过去很喜欢去大都会美术馆。
其中两次是和 Michelle 去的。

lines.en: You ought to think about spending more time with Michelle at all the great places in the city.
lines.cn: 你应该考虑多花些时间陪 Michelle，去城里那些好地方看看。

lines.en: Well, perhaps, you'll help me select some of the great places.
lines.cn: 也许你可以帮我挑一些好地方。
午餐的一切都准备好了 Harry。
它看起来很令人食指大动。

lines.en: I wish Michelle and her friends would get here.
lines.cn: 我希望 Michelle 和她的朋友很快就到这。

lines.en: I can't wait to take a bite of the pumpernickel.
lines.cn: 我简直迫不及待想吃一口黑面包。

lines.en: Come in, Michelle, and bring your friends along.
Susan, I really appreciate your doing this for Michelle and her friends.
lines.cn: Susan，谢谢你为 Michelle 和她的朋友们做这些。

lines.en: I'm not just doing it for Michelle.
lines.cn: 我不仅是为 Michelle 做这些。

lines.en: I'm doing it for us, Harry.
lines.cn: 我是为我们大家做的 Harry。

lines.en: Well, it's ... it's important for Michelle to see us together more often.
lines.cn: 让 Michelle 经常看到我们在一起，是……是很重要的。
确实如此。Michelle 和我更了解彼此是很重要的。

lines.en: for Michelle and me to get to know each other better.
lines.cn: Michelle 和我更了解彼此是很重要的。

lines.en: What, Harry? What makes you feel good?
lines.cn: 什么 Harry 什么使你感到高兴？

lines.en: Well, that you care about Michelle, that you care about me, and that you care about us.
lines.cn: 我是说，你关心 Michelle，关心我，也关心我们大家。

lines.en: Well, Harry, that's because I do.
lines.cn: 哦 Harry 那是因为我关心。

lines.en: Susan, I'd like to continue this conversation later.
lines.cn: Susan 我希望等一下能继续我们的谈话。

lines.en: We'll finish the conversation when they go to the museum.
lines.cn: 他们去博物馆之后我们再聊。

lines.en: We had such a good time at the aquarium.
lines.cn: 爸爸，我们在水族馆玩得真开心。
我看到一条真正的鲨鱼，
嗨，Michelle，为什么不把大家介绍给 Susan 呢？

lines.en: why don't you introduce everybody to Susan?
lines.cn: Michelle，为什么不把大家介绍给 Susan 呢？

lines.en: I'd like you to meet Audrey and her mother, Mrs. Cooper.
lines.cn: 我来向你介绍 Audrey 和她母亲 Cooper 太太。

lines.en: Nice to meet you, Mrs. Cooper.
lines.cn: 很高兴见你 Cooper 太太。

lines.en: And this is Shirley and Nicole.
I had never been there before.
lines.cn: 我以前从来没有去过那。

lines.en: The girls learned a great deal.
lines.cn: 女孩们学到了许多东西。

lines.en: Well, please sit down and tell us all about it during lunch.
lines.cn: 请坐，一边吃午饭，一边把你们见到的都告诉我们。

lines.en: We prepared some tuna fish and cheese sandwiches for lunch.
lines.cn: 午餐我们准备了金枪鱼和奶酪三明治。

lines.en: I remember when I used to be a Girl Scout.
lines.cn: 我记得我还是一名女童子军的时候。

lines.en: My mother would take us everywhere, too.
lines.cn: 我妈妈也是带我们各处走。

lines.en: Susan, I understand you're in the toy business.
lines.cn: Susan 听说你是在玩具业工作。

lines.en: My company manufactures toys and games for children.
lines.cn: 我们公司为孩子们生产玩具和游戏器具。

lines.en: Susan's vice-president in charge of new toys and games.
lines.cn: Susan 是主管新玩具和新游戏器具的副总裁。

lines.en: And the marketing of new toys and games.
lines.cn: 还负责新玩具和新游戏的市场推广。

lines.en: Can we test a new game for you, Susan?
lines.cn: 我们可以帮你试验你的新游戏吗 Susan？

lines.en: I happen to have a game which I brought home to study.
lines.cn: 我这儿碰巧有一个我带回来研究的游戏。

lines.en: We tested it last week on twelve- to fifteen-year-olds, and they found it to be too easy-- in other words ... boring.
lines.cn: 上周我们让十二到十五岁的孩子试过，他们觉得太简单了——换句话说，就是无聊。

lines.en: We think it might be just right for ten- to twelve-year-olds.
lines.cn: 我们想它或许对十岁到十二岁大的孩子正合适。

lines.en: First, you shuffle the deck and lay them face down.
lines.cn: 首先洗牌，然后把牌面朝下放好。

lines.en: The leader takes the first ten cards and lays them face up on this stand.
lines.cn: 主持人拿起最上面的十张牌，牌面朝上放在这个架子上。

lines.en: Everyone gets a turn, going counterclockwise, left to right.
lines.cn: 大家按逆时针方向，从左到右轮流玩。

lines.en: You have thirty seconds to make a word, using as many letters as possible.
lines.cn: 你们有三十秒时间，用尽可能多的字母组成一个单词。

lines.en: You get one point for each letter, plus the person with the longest word gets ten extra points.
lines.cn: 每个字母得一分，组成最长单词的人额外得十分。

lines.en: The first one to get one hundred points wins.
lines.cn: 首先达到一百分的人赢。

lines.en: OK, let's go around the table.

lines.cn: 到现在为止，你们不分胜负。
Sheet 是五个字母的单字。

lines.en: Michelle wins with a six-letter word, plus she gets an additional ten points for a total of sixteen points.
lines.cn: Michelle 用一个六字母单词获胜，再加上额外的十分，一共得十六分。

lines.en: How are you enjoying the game so far?
lines.cn: 到现在为止你们喜欢这个游戏吗？

lines.en: She just said it's too easy.
Thank you so much, but we have to get going to meet the rest of the troop at two o'clock at the museum.
lines.cn: 非常感谢，不过我们得走了，两点要在博物馆和其他童子军会合。

lines.en: Oh, it was nice meeting all of you.
lines.cn: 哦，很高兴会见你们各位。

lines.en: I hope you have a wonderful time at the Museum of Natural History.
lines.cn: 祝你们在自然历史博物馆玩得愉快。

lines.en: See you in front of the museum at five o'clock.
And thanks again for the lunch and for the game.
lines.cn: 再次谢谢你们提供了午餐和游戏。

lines.en: You helped save our company a lot of money.
lines.cn: 你们帮我们公司省了一大笔钱。

lines.en: Isn't there a conversation that we have to finish?
lines.cn: 我们不是有话还没说完？

lines.en: There's a conversation we have to finish.
lines.cn: 我们有一段话还没有谈完呢。

lines.en: I said that it makes me feel good that you care about Michelle.
lines.cn: 我说，你关心 Michelle 让我很高兴。

lines.en: Well, I do care about Michelle.
And it makes me feel good that you care about me.
lines.cn: 而且你关心我，也让我感到很高兴。

lines.en: And it makes me feel good that you care about us.
lines.cn: 你关心我们大家，也让我很高兴。

lines.en: It's only natural that if I care about Michelle and I care about you, then I care about us.
lines.cn: 既然我关心 Michelle，也关心你，自然也就关心我们大家。

lines.en: We had this part of the conversation before Michelle and her friends arrived.
lines.cn: 在 Michelle 和她的朋友们来之前，这一部分我们已经谈过了。
现在最精彩的部分来了。

lines.en: Well, assume that if you care about Michelle and you care about me and you care about us, that we can talk about us.
lines.cn: 假如你关心 Michelle，关心我，也关心我们大家，那我们就可以谈谈我们的事。
我的意思是说说你和我。

lines.en: What are you trying to say, Harry?
Here are ten letters that express my feelings for you.
lines.cn: 这，有十个字母可以表达我对你的感情。

lines.en: Seven letters ... two words ... that express the feelings that I feel for you in my heart.
lines.cn: 七个字母……两个单词……表达我心里对你的感情。

lines.en: Well? Does that mean you'll marry me?
lines.cn: 噢，你的意思是，答应嫁给我？

lines.en: Is that a proposal, or are we just playing a game?
lines.cn: 这是求婚呢，还是仅仅在玩游戏？

lines.en: There's something I have to ask you.

lines.cn: 这是一个如此重要的决定。

lines.en: There's so many things to talk about.
There are three things that have to be done first, Harry.
lines.cn: 首先我们必须做三件事 Harry。

lines.en: First, we have to decide where to live.
lines.cn: 首先，我们得决定住在哪。
我们先前谈过这个问题。

lines.en: Second, we have to talk to Michelle together about being married.
lines.cn: 第二，我们得一起和 Michelle 谈谈结婚的事。

lines.en: You have to ask for my father's permission.
lines.cn: 你必须征得我父亲的同意。

lines.en: We have to go pick up Michelle.
lines.cn: 我们得去接 Michelle 了。

lines.en: Not as happy as I am.
I'm sorry I missed him. I had to work late.
lines.cn: 很抱歉我错过了他醒着的时候。我必须工作到很晚。

lines.en: What are the flowers for, Richard?
Five years of happiness. Happy anniversary.
lines.cn: 为了五年的幸福。结婚纪念日快乐。

lines.en: But our anniversary isn't until Saturday.
lines.cn: 可我们的结婚纪念日要到星期六才到呀。

lines.en: Besides, we are not going to be here Saturday.
lines.cn: 另外，我们星期六将不在这了。

lines.en: Where are we going to be?
If you had your choice of all the places in the world. where would you choose to spend our anniversary?
lines.cn: 如果世界上的地方任你挑，你会选哪里庆祝我们的结婚纪念日？

lines.en: I loved that place when we went on our honeymoon.
lines.cn: 当初我们度蜜月时我便很喜欢那个地方。

lines.en: Perfect! You picked the right place.
You and I, Mrs. Stewart, are going to spend a second honeymoon at the Watermill Inn.
lines.cn: Stewart 太太，你和我要到 Watermill 旅馆度第二次蜜月。
噢 Richard 那真是，太好了，可是……

lines.en: Aren't we taking the baby on our honeymoon?
lines.cn: 难道我们要带着宝宝一起去度蜜月？

lines.en: The world's greatest grandmother, Mrs. Ellen Stewart, has agreed to take care of him for the weekend.
lines.cn: 世界上最棒的奶奶 Ellen Stewart 太太，已经答应周末照顾他了。

lines.en: Richard, isn't that too much to ask of your mother?
lines.cn: Richard 那是不是太麻烦你母亲啦？

lines.en: Too much? She loves taking care of Max.
lines.cn: 太麻烦，她喜欢照顾 Max。

lines.en: Well, we'll phone every hour, and you can listen to him over the phone.
lines.cn: 我们每小时打一次电话，你可以在电话里听听他的声音。

lines.en: It's time you and I had a romantic weekend alone together.
lines.cn: 是我们俩单独在一起过一个浪漫周末的时候了。

lines.en: We've earned it. What do you say?
lines.cn: 这是我们应得的。你觉得怎么样？
你说得对，这是我们应得的。

lines.en: Great! I'll make a reservation right now.
lines.cn: 太好了，我现在就订房间。

lines.en: Remember that wonderful little balcony where we had our meals ... with a view of the Hudson River?
lines.cn: 还记得那个漂亮的小阳台吗？我们在那里吃饭……还能看到 Hudson 河。

lines.en: My wife and I spent our honeymoon at the inn.
lines.cn: 我太太和我在你们旅馆度的蜜月。

lines.en: No, we didn't leave anything in the room.
lines.cn: 不，我们没有把东西落在房间里。

lines.en: We'd like to make a reservation for this weekend.
lines.cn: 我们想预订一个这个周末的房间。

lines.en: Yes, a double room, please. What?
lines.cn: 对，双人房间，麻烦你。什么？

lines.en: Can you recommend someplace nice--someplace nearby?
lines.cn: 你能推荐一个附近的好地方吗？

lines.en: He says there's another inn just half a mile down the road from the Watermill.
lines.cn: 他说沿路从 Watermill 再走半英里，就有另一家旅馆。

lines.en: It won't be the same, but what do you say?
lines.cn: 那就不一样了，但你说呢？

lines.en: My mom is available to baby-sit this weekend.
lines.cn: 我妈妈在这个周末可以照顾小宝宝。

lines.en: Well, OK. See if they have a room.
lines.cn: 那，好吧，看看他们是否还有房间。

lines.en: Hello. Is this the Old Country Inn?
lines.cn: 喂，是 Old Country Inn 吗？

lines.en: The desk clerk at the Watemill suggested your inn.
lines.cn: Watermill 旅馆的前台职员推荐了你们这里。

lines.en: Would you happen to have a room for two availbale this weekend?
lines.cn: 请问这个周末还有双人房吗？

lines.en: My wife and I are celebrating our fifth anniversary.
lines.cn: 我和太太要庆祝结婚五周年。

lines.en: Yes. I'll hold. He's checking. You do?
lines.cn: 好，我会等。他正在查。真的有？

lines.en: Great! What is the daily rate?
lines.cn: 太好了！每天的房价是多少？

lines.en: Yes, we'll be arriving by car about ten o'clock Friday night.
lines.cn: 是的，我们将于星期五晚上十点钟左右开车抵达。

lines.en: Done! You and I, Mrs. Stewart.
are going to have a wonderful, romantic weekend!
lines.cn: Stewart 太太，你和我将度过一个美妙、浪漫的周末！

lines.en: Right this way, Mr. and Mrs. Stewart.
lines.cn: 走这边 Stewart 先生和太太。
噢，它是小了点，但是干净。

lines.en: Thank you. I don't believe this.
Well, it isn't the Watermill Inn, but let's get a look at the view.
lines.cn: 虽然这不是 Watermill 旅馆，不过我们还是看看窗外的景色吧。

lines.en: Great, if you enjoy looking at a parking lot.
lines.cn: 好得很，假如你喜欢看一个停车场的话。

lines.en: Well, maybe we'll see the view in the morning.
lines.cn: 好了，也许我们可以在早晨看风景。

lines.en: Right now, we should clean up this room.
lines.cn: 现在，我们应当清理一下房间。

lines.en: Well, the rain, the room, the view of the parking lot.
lines.cn: 唉，这雨，这房间，这停车场的景色。

lines.en: It isn't the way I hoped it would be.
After all, we're here, we're alone, we're together.
lines.cn: 毕竟，我们来到这儿了，我们又单独在一起了。

lines.en: And I love you. Isn't that enough?
lines.cn: 而且我爱你，这还不够吗？

lines.en: It is for me, but I wanted this weekend to be special for you.
lines.cn: 对我来说够了，但我希望这个周末对你来说很特别。
这的确很特别。结婚纪念日快乐。

lines.en: It's still raining. I want to play tennis.
lines.cn: 仍然在下雨。我想打网球。

lines.en: Let's call room service and order a nice breakfast, and then we'll figure out what to do today.
lines.cn: 我们打电话叫一份好吃的早餐，然后再想想今天做什么。

lines.en: Right. Would you give me room service, please?
lines.cn: 好，请帮我接客房送餐服务。

lines.en: I beg your pardon? Oh, I see.
They don't have room service at Old Country Inn.
lines.cn: Old Country Inn 没有客房送餐服务。

lines.en: Well, let's go down to the coffee shop.
lines.cn: 哦，那我们下去咖啡厅吧。

lines.en: They don't have a coffee shop.
We can get our meals at Mrs. Montefiore's down the road.
lines.cn: 我们可以沿大路走到 Montefiore 太太的旅馆去吃。

lines.en: I love walking in the rain.
Oh, you're being a really good sport about this, Marilyn, but I think we should face the truth.
lines.cn: Marilyn，你真的很体谅，可我觉得我们应该面对现实。

lines.en: This is not the way to spend our fifth anniversary.
lines.cn: 我们的结婚五周年不该这样度过。

lines.en: Well, what do you want to do?
Why don't we get in the car and drive home?
Oh, Richard, it really isn't that bad.
lines.cn: 喔 Richard 事情没有那么糟。

lines.en: Do you want to stick it out for the whole weekend?
lines.cn: 难道你想在此地耗掉整个周末？

lines.en: Well, I'll admit the room is uncomfortable.
lines.cn: 嗯，我承认这个房间很不舒服。

lines.en: And I do feel bad about your mother having to take care of the baby all weekend.
lines.cn: 而且让你妈妈整个周末都照顾宝宝，我也觉得过意不去。

lines.en: Why don't we just check out?
Hello? Yes. Yes, this is she.
Oh, hello! How nice of you to remember us!
lines.cn: 哦，你好！你还记得我们，真是太好了！

lines.en: You do? Really? It won't be any trouble?
lines.cn: 有，真的，不会有任何麻烦？

lines.en: Oh, yes, I think we'd like that very much.
lines.cn: 噢，好的，我想我们非常乐意。

lines.en: Mrs. Montefiore from the Watermill Inn.
lines.cn: 是 Watermill Inn 的 Montefiore 太太打来的电话。
有一个人刚刚结帐走了。

lines.en: and Mrs. Montefiore has reserved the honeymoon suite for us.
lines.cn: Montefiore 太太为我们保留了蜜月套房。

lines.en: Oh. Now all it has to do is stop raining.
lines.cn: 现在唯一希望的就是停止下雨。

lines.en: Oh, Richard, it's exactly as it was when we were married!
lines.cn: 哦，Richard，这里和我们结婚时一模一样！

lines.en: Even the old patchwork quilt is the same!
lines.cn: 连这床旧拼布被都和以前一样！

lines.en: My great-grandmother made that quilt when Teddy Roosevelt was President.
lines.cn: 那床被子是我曾祖母在 Teddy Roosevelt 当总统时缝制的。

lines.en: In those days, when they made quilts. they cut patches so that each one would be a part of it.
lines.cn: 那时做拼布被，人们会从家里每个人的旧衣服上剪下布块，让每个人都成为这床被子的一部分。

lines.en: I remember you and your wife
lines.cn: 从你和太太第一次住在这里起，我就记住你们了。
我们现在有一个小宝宝了。

lines.en: How wonderful! A boy or a girl?
Would a professional photographer be without a picture?
lines.cn: 一位专业摄影师会没有照片？

lines.en: Like his father. A real Stewart.
lines.cn: 像他爸爸一样。一个真正的 Stewart 家成员。

lines.en: And very good-looking, like his mother.
Well, it's nice to have you with us again.
lines.cn: 噢，非常高兴你们又来了。
下次把小宝宝一起带来。

lines.en: You see, Richard? Max is welcome here.
lines.cn: 你看到了吧 Richard 他们这儿欢迎 Max 呢。
可不能在我们的结婚纪念日。

lines.en: This vacation is for you and me.
If there's anything you need, please call me.
lines.cn: 假如你们需要什么，请打电话给我。

lines.en: I'll be in the front office all day.
lines.cn: 我一整天都会在前台办公室。

lines.en: Oh, I took the liberty of ordering some breakfast for you.
lines.cn: 噢，我冒昧给你们订了早餐。

lines.en: Just put it over there, Charles.
Now, this is my idea of a good time.
Let's see ... hotcakes and maple syrup, with scrambled eggs.
lines.cn: 让我看看……薄煎饼配枫糖浆，还有炒蛋。

lines.en: Umm ... smell that coffee ... cinnamon and cloves.
lines.cn: 嗯……闻闻这咖啡……有肉桂和丁香的香味。

lines.en: Slices of orange with burnt honey.
First I want to call home and check on your mother and the baby.
lines.cn: 我想先打电话回家，问问你妈妈和宝宝的情况。

lines.en: Honey, if there were any problems, she would call us.
lines.cn: 亲爱的，如果有什么问题，她会打电话给我们的。

lines.en: She doesn't know we've changed hotels.
lines.cn: 她不知道我们换了旅馆呀。

lines.en: I'd like to call Riverdale, New York.
lines.cn: 请接 New York 的 Riverdale。

lines.en: This food is heavenly, isn't it?

lines.cn: 这整个地方都太美好了。

lines.en: Do you remember that old desk?
Mrs. Montefiore told me that George Washington sat at that desk and wrote to his wife Martha.
lines.cn: Montefiore 太太告诉我，George Washington 曾坐在那张桌子前，给妻子 Martha 写信。

lines.en: What do you want to do after breakfast?
Why don't we take a walk down to the river?
lines.cn: 我们何不一路散步到河边去？

lines.en: No. Look out the window. The sun is shining!
Now this is my idea of a good time!
The mailman just dropped some mail in our box, Grandpa.
lines.cn: 爷爷，邮递员刚往我们的信箱里放了些信。

lines.en: Probably a lot of advertising and bills.
lines.cn: 大概是一大堆广告和账单。

lines.en: Why don't you write to me, Robbie, so I can get some interesting mail?
lines.cn: Robbie，你为什么不给我写信呢？这样我就能收到有趣的信了。

lines.en: Yes. It's just like I said, Robbie.
lines.cn: 正像我说的那样吧 Robbie。

lines.en: You won't believe it, Grandpa, but there's a letter here addressed to you, Mr. Malcolm Stewart, and it looks like a personal letter.
lines.cn: 爷爷，你可能不信，这里真有一封写给你的信，收件人是 Malcolm Stewart 先生，看起来像封私人信件。

lines.en: Oh, it must be a bill.
The return name and address is Pete Waters, RFD Number 1, Chesterton.
lines.cn: 寄信人的姓名和地址是：Pete Waters，Chesterton，乡村免费邮递一号路线。
Pete Waters，Chesterton，乡村免费邮递一号路线。

lines.en: He was my roommate in college.
He visited with Grandma and me in Florida about five years ago.
lines.cn: 大约五年前，他去 Florida 看望过奶奶和我。

lines.en: He's writing to invite me to spend a weekend with him at his farm.
lines.cn: 他写信邀请我去农场和他一起过周末。

lines.en: He's planning a get-together with two or three other college friends.
lines.cn: 他打算和另外两三个大学朋友聚一聚。

lines.en: A kind of a fifty-year anniversary reunion.
lines.cn: 等于是五十年重逢聚会。

lines.en: It sounds like fun to me, too, Robbie.
lines.cn: 对我来说也像是蛮好玩的 Robbie。

lines.en: What kind of farm does he have?
I've never been there, Robbie, but he has chickens and cows and all.
lines.cn: Robbie，我从没去过那里，但他养了鸡、牛之类的。

lines.en: That means fresh eggs and fresh milk.
lines.cn: 也就是说会有新鲜的鸡蛋和牛奶。

lines.en: He's not as lucky as I am to have a family and grandchildren.
lines.cn: 他不像我这么幸运，有自己的家庭，还有孙辈。

lines.en: How come he never got married?
He never married because the girl he was in love with in college married someone else.
lines.cn: 他一直没结婚，因为大学时爱上的姑娘嫁给了别人。

lines.en: He must have loved her very much.
lines.cn: 他一定非常非常地爱她。

lines.en: She was in love with Donald McGrath, the quarterback on our football team.
lines.cn: 她爱的是 Donald McGrath，我们橄榄球队的四分卫。

lines.en: Football players are always popular with the ladies.
lines.cn: 橄榄球队员总是很受姑娘们欢迎。

lines.en: She liked Pete, and they went to dances together.
lines.cn: 她喜欢 Pete 他们也一起去跳舞。

lines.en: But her heart was with Donald.
Did he ever get over it?
Maybe Lillian will be at the reunion.
lines.cn: 或许 Lillian 也会来参加聚会。

lines.en: I wish I could go there with you, Grandpa.
lines.cn: 我真希望我能够跟你一起去，爷爷。

lines.en: What do you think the surprise will be?
lines.cn: 你想会是什么样的意外？

lines.en: With Pete, you never know, Robbie.
lines.cn: 你不可能猜到 Pete 会耍什么花样 Robbie。

lines.en: Won't it be exciting to see all your college friends there again?
lines.cn: 在那又要见到你的大学朋友，难道不兴奋？

lines.en: I'm kind of excited about going now.
Next weekend ... sleep over Friday and Saturday night and come back Sunday.
lines.cn: 下周末……星期五和星期六在那儿过夜，星期天回来。

lines.en: Don't you think you ought to call Pete and tell him you're coming?
lines.cn: 你是不是该打电话给 Pete，告诉他你会去？
你说的正是我想的 Robbie。

lines.en: Hello. What can I do for you?
lines.cn: 你好。我能为你做点什么？
Pete Waters 的农场在 Chesterton 附近。

lines.en: Pete Waters's lived around here almost as long as I have.
lines.cn: Pete Waters 住这差不多跟我一样久了。

lines.en: How long is it going to take for me to get there?
There's a shortcut--if you know it.
lines.cn: 假如你识路的话，有一条近路可走。

lines.en: Could you tell me how to use the shortcut?
lines.cn: 你能告诉我怎么走这条近路？

lines.en: Sure. You take the next left turn.
lines.cn: 当然，在下一个路口左转。
你会看到一个停车标志。

lines.en: Make a right at the stop sign.
Stay on that road, and you'll cross a blue bridge.
lines.cn: 沿着路开下去，你会经过一座蓝色的桥。

lines.en: Then you'll see a big old red barn.
lines.cn: 然后你会看到一座又大又旧的红色谷仓。

lines.en: That's the back of Pete Waters's place.
lines.cn: 那就是 Pete Waters 住处的后面。

lines.en: That's quite a difference from the directions that Pete sent me.
lines.cn: 这和 Pete 寄给我的路线指示很不一样。

lines.en: Now, if you take that route, it's probably a lot simpler, but it'll take you ten minutes longer.
lines.cn: 如果走他给的那条路线，可能更简单，不过会多花十分钟。

lines.en: I take the next left turn to the stop sign.
lines.cn: 在下一个路口左转，一直开到停车标志处。

lines.en: Then a right across a blue bridge, and then a big red barn.
lines.cn: 然后右转，经过一座蓝色的桥，就能看到一座红色的大谷仓。

lines.en: How much do I owe you?
Well, that'll be eighteen dollars and seventy cents.
Ah. OK. That's a dollar and thirty cents change.
lines.cn: 好啦。这是一美元三毛零钱。

lines.en: There we go ... will make twenty. Thanks.
lines.cn: 你看……加起来正好二十美元。谢谢了。
这一定是 Pete 的谷仓了。
向右拐就到他的房子了。

lines.en: Hi. What can I do for you?
Is this the Pete Waters farm?
lines.cn: 这是 Pete Waters 的农场吗？

lines.en: Keep along this road till you get to the end of the fence.
lines.cn: 沿着这条路走，一直走到栅栏的尽头。

lines.en: His house is on the left.

lines.cn: 请随意，就像在自己家一样。

lines.en: Except for the beard, he hasn't changed in fifty years.
lines.cn: 除了有胡子，他五十年来没有变。

lines.en: You haven't changed much in fifty years.
lines.cn: 你五十年来没有什么变化。

lines.en: Who am I, you old rascal?
lines.cn: 我是谁呀，你这个老顽童？

lines.en: You don't recognize me, do you?
No. He left a note on the door
lines.cn: 不在。他在门上留了张字条，说去火车站接一个惊喜回来。

lines.en: saying he was going to the railroad station
lines.cn: 他在门上留了张字条，说去火车站接一个惊喜回来。
不在。他在门上留了张字条，说去火车站接一个惊喜回来。

lines.en: Always full of surprises, even fifty years later.
lines.cn: 总是让人惊喜，过了五十年还这样。

lines.en: The two of you look unbelievable!
lines.cn: 你们俩看起来简直让人难以置信！

lines.en: Oh, I was sorry to hear about your wife having passed away.
lines.cn: 听说你太太去世了，我很难过。

lines.en: And you're living with your children now? In New York?
lines.cn: 你现在跟孩子们一起住在纽约对吗？

lines.en: Pete wrote us and told us.
Retired and moved to New York to live with my son and his family.
lines.cn: 我退休后搬到了 New York，和儿子一家住在一起。

lines.en: By the way, what do you think this big surprise is?
lines.cn: 对了，你们觉得这个大惊喜是什么？

lines.en: It could be most anything, knowing Pete.
lines.cn: 任何事情都可能，你是知道 Pete 的。

lines.en: Now we'll find out about the surprise.
lines.cn: 现在我们可以知道是什么样的惊喜了。

lines.en: So good to see you all!
Oh, it's so good to see you!
We were together in the Thursday night drama society.
lines.cn: 我们过去总在星期四晚上的话剧社聚会。
噢，还像以前一样漂亮 Lillian。

lines.en: Donald passed away a couple of years ago.
I would not have missed this get-together for the world!
lines.cn: 世界上任何事情都阻止不了我来参加这次聚会！

lines.en: You really surprised me by having us all come together.
lines.cn: 你把我们大家聚在一起，就已经让我够惊喜了。

lines.en: You don't know what the surprise is yet?
lines.cn: 你们还不知道这个惊喜是什么？

lines.en: We'll tell you the big surprise.
lines.cn: 我来告诉你们这个大惊喜。

lines.en: I've invited you here for the weekend to help celebrate.
lines.cn: 我邀请你们到这儿来度周末一起庆祝！

lines.en: No. Pete wants to tell you ...
Now, let me have the honor, Lillian.
lines.cn: 现在，容我享有这个荣幸 Lillian。

lines.en: For goodness' sake, Pete, tell us!
lines.cn: 天啊 Pete 快告诉我！

lines.en: Well, I am pouring this iced tea so that we can toast Lillian--and me.
lines.cn: 我倒上这杯冰茶，好让我们为 Lillian 和我举杯庆祝。

lines.en: You don't mean to tell me that you and ...
lines.cn: 你不会是告诉我们你和……

lines.en: I have loved Lillian all these years, so I asked her to be Mrs. Pete Waters.
lines.cn: 这些年来，我一直爱着 Lillian，所以我请她做 Pete Waters 太太。

lines.en: I knew it! I knew it!
lines.cn: 我就知道是这样，我就知道是这样！

lines.en: Oh, Lillian, I am so happy for you both.
Lillian will make me a happy man--finally.
lines.cn: Lillian 会使我终于成为一个快乐的人。

lines.en: You are full of surprises, Pete.
We are going to spend the entire weekend having a good time together here on the farm.
lines.cn: 我们要在农场一起度过整个周末，玩个痛快。

lines.en: We are going to celebrate all weekend.
lines.cn: 我们整个周末都要好好庆祝。

lines.en: Lillian and I were married two weeks ago in Detroit.
lines.cn: Lillian 和我已在两周前在 Detroit 结婚了。

lines.en: Wait till I tell my family about this!
lines.cn: 等我告诉我家人这件事！
你想你已经拍齐了什么？
表演艺术，表演艺术中心。

lines.en: I think I've got them all, but I'm not sure.
lines.cn: 我想我都已经拍齐了，但我不能肯定。

lines.en: I think you have got it, Richard.
Lincoln Center, home of the Metropolitan Opera, the New York City Ballet, the New York Philharmonic.
lines.cn: 林肯中心，大都会歌剧院、纽约市芭蕾舞团和纽约爱乐乐团的所在地。

lines.en: Shubert Alley, center of the theater on Broadway. Shubert Alley
lines.cn: Shubert Alley，百老汇剧院的中心地带。

lines.en: And the Kennedy Center for the Performing Arts in Washington.
lines.cn: 还有华盛顿的肯尼迪表演艺术中心。

lines.en: And the Music Center in Los Angeles.
lines.cn: 还有位于洛杉矶的音乐中心。

lines.en: And the others. I do have it all.
lines.cn: 还有其他的。我确实拍齐了。

lines.en: You have been working on this for some time, Richard.
lines.cn: 你从事这工作已有一段时间了 Richard。

lines.en: I'm glad you feel you've finally put it all together.
lines.cn: 我很高兴你终于就绪了。

lines.en: Oh, you think you're going to have a hard time getting the album published?
lines.cn: 你觉得让这本摄影集出版会很困难吗？

lines.en: So, what do you think you're going to do?
Does the name Harvey Carlson ring a bell?
lines.cn: 对 Harvey Carlson 这个名字有印象吗？

lines.en: Oh, yes! Harvey Carlson! I remember.
lines.cn: 噢，是的 Harvey Carlson 我记得。

lines.en: He said I should call him.
lines.cn: 他说我可以打电话给他。

lines.en: He's the publisher of the Carlson Publishing Company.
lines.cn: 他是 Carlson 出版公司的出版人。

lines.en: He said they need a new book of photographs, and he really liked my concept.
lines.cn: 他说他们需要一本新的摄影集，而且很喜欢我的构想。

lines.en: So, why don't you call him in the morning?
lines.cn: 那你为什么不明早打电话给他呢？

lines.en: Do you think I have enough to show him?
lines.cn: 你觉得我有足够的照片给他看吗？

lines.en: I've been through every section with you, Richard.
lines.cn: 我和你一起检视过每个部分 Richard。

lines.en: And now that you're satisfied with the performing arts section, I think you should show it to Mr. Carlson.
lines.cn: 既然你现在对表演艺术这一部分也满意了，我觉得该给 Carlson 先生看看了。

lines.en: You're right. My Family Album, U.S.A. feels right.
lines.cn: 你说得对。我觉得《美国写真集》已经准备好了。

lines.en: I'll call in the morning and set up an appointment to see him.
lines.cn: 我明天早上就打电话给他，跟他约个时间去看他。

lines.en: He's going to love your work.
lines.cn: 他一定会欣赏你的作品的。

lines.en: Come on. Let's get some sleep.
Is it too early to call Mr. Carlson?
lines.cn: 现在打电话给 Carlson 先生会不会太早了？

lines.en: Seven after nine? No. I'm sure he's in his office.
lines.cn: 九点零七分不会太早的。我肯定他到办公室了。

lines.en: His number is five, five, five, seven, five, three, two.
Five, five, five, seven, five, three, two. 5557532

lines.cn: 你好，请找 Carlson 先生。

lines.en: Mr. Carlson is busy at the moment.
lines.cn: Carlson 先生现在正忙着呢。

lines.en: I'd like to make an appointment with him.
lines.cn: 我想跟他约个晤谈时间。

lines.en: He told me to call him about my project, Family Album, U.S.A.
lines.cn: 他让我打电话给他，谈谈我的《美国写真集》项目。

lines.en: I guess they're trying to set up an appointment for me.
lines.cn: 我猜他们正设法给我安排晤谈。

lines.en: Mr. Stewart, I just spoke to Mr. Carlson.
lines.cn: Stewart 先生，我刚同 Carlson 先生通了话。

lines.en: He would like to see you.
But the only time he's available this week is tomorrow morning at ten o'clock.
lines.cn: 不过他这周唯一有空的时间，是明天上午十点。

lines.en: Well, it's done. Tomorrow morning at a publisher's office.
lines.cn: 好了，事情办成了。明天早晨要到出版社老总的办公室。

lines.en: Well, finally a publisher will see my work.
lines.cn: 好了，终于有一个出版商要看我的作品了。

lines.en: Good morning. My name is Richard Stewart.
I'm here to see Mr. Carlson.
Please  sit down,Mr.Stewart.  Mr. Carlson will be with you shortly.
lines.cn: 请坐 Stewart 先生。Carlson 先生不久就可以见你。

lines.en: Excuse me, Mr. Carlson, but Richard Stewart is here for his ten o'clock appointment with you.
lines.cn: 打扰一下，Carlson 先生，和您约好十点见面的 Richard Stewart 已经到了。

lines.en: Like I said, he'll be with you shortly.
lines.cn: 正像我所说，他不久就可以与你会面。
是的 Carlson 先生，是的，先生。

lines.en: He's ready for you, Mr. Stewart.
lines.cn: 他可以见你啦 Stewart 先生。
是的，在那里面。祝你好运。

lines.en: This is a crazy morning. Hello, Richard.
lines.cn: 今天早上忙得不可开交。你好，Richard。

lines.en: Thank you for seeing me on such short notice.
lines.cn: 谢谢您这样快就安排见我。

lines.en: I hope you've brought your pictures along.
lines.cn: 我希望你带了你的照片一起来。

lines.en: I see that you have. Let's get right to it.
lines.cn: 看来你带来了。我们直接开始吧。

lines.en: We need a new coffee-table book, and a book of photos about the United States still feels right.
lines.cn: 我们需要一本新的精美画册，而一本关于美国的摄影集仍然是很合适的选择。

lines.en: Good. Very good. Family Album, U.S.A.
lines.cn: 不错，很不错。 美国写真集。

lines.en: If you had to describe the book in one sentence, how would you do it?
lines.cn: 如果用一句话来描述这本书，你会怎么说？

lines.en: Well, I'd describe it as a book which is a ... a portrait of the United States-- the places, the people--mostly the people.
lines.cn: 我会把它描述为……一幅美国的肖像，描绘各个地方和人们，主要是人们。

lines.en: The things they do, the ways they live, the places they visit, and the landmarks.
lines.cn: 他们做的事、生活的方式、去过的地方，还有地标。
一次透过摄影作品的旅行。

lines.en: These are wonderful-- these photos in your performing arts section.
lines.cn: 你表演艺术部分的这些照片太棒了。
卡内基音乐厅，林肯中心。

lines.en: There's something missing. You've got a good eye, Richard.
lines.cn: 少了些东西。Richard，你的眼光很好。
你是一名出色的摄影师。

lines.en: But before I can publish your work, I need to meet with my marketing department, and you've got to do one more thing.
lines.cn: 不过，在出版你的作品之前，我得和市场部开会，而你还需要做一件事。
文化这一部分，你拍了表演艺术中心，却遗漏了街头表演，比如哑剧演员。
文化这一部分，你拍了表演艺术中心，却遗漏了街头表演，

lines.en: but you've left out street performance. The mimes.
The musicians. The dancers--in the parks and on the streets.
lines.cn: 音乐家啦，在公园或街头跳舞的人啦。

lines.en: Richard, if you go out    Richard, and photograph street performances in the city, you'll have it.
lines.cn: Richard，如果你去拍一些城里的街头表演，这本书就完整了。

lines.en: The performing arts centers and the street performances.
lines.cn: 表演艺术中心及街头表演。

lines.en: If you do it, I'll publish your work.
lines.cn: 假如你拍好了，我就出版你的作品。
我从来没有比现在更认真了。

lines.en: When do you think you can return with street performances?
lines.cn: 你觉得何时可以带来街头表演艺术的摄影？

lines.en: If they're as good as the rest of these pictures, it's a deal.
lines.cn: 假如它们跟这其余的照片一样好的话我们的交易就成。

lines.en: You won't be disappointed, Mr. Carlson. Thanks.
lines.cn: 我不会让你失望的 Carlson 先生。谢谢。

lines.en: Good-bye, Richard, and good luck. See you in two weeks.
lines.cn: 再见 Richard 祝你好运。两周后见。
再见 Carlson 先生。谢谢。

lines.en: So if you like the street-performance photos, you'll really publish Family Album, U.S.A.?
lines.cn: 也就是说，如果你喜欢那些街头表演的照片，就真的会出版《美国写真集》？

lines.en: When I say something, I mean it.
Two weeks. I said I could do it in two weeks, and I did it.
lines.cn: 两周。我说过我两周就能完成，现在我做到了。

lines.en: The pictures you've taken are fabulous, Richard.
lines.cn: 你拍的照片太精彩了 Richard。

lines.en: I'm going to show him the photos on Monday morning.
lines.cn: 我要在星期一早晨给他看这些照片。

lines.en: I'm very proud of you. You really did a beautiful job.
lines.cn: 我真以你为傲。你真的拍得很漂亮。

lines.en: I know he will love the new photographs for your book.
lines.cn: 我相信他会喜欢你为你的书所拍的这些新照片。

lines.en: Yeah. I really did do a good job, didn't I?
lines.cn: 是的，我确实拍得不错，对吧？

lines.en: Hey, you know? There's still some film left on this roll,
and there's one person I haven't photographed in a long time.
lines.cn: 你知道吗？这卷胶卷还剩一些，而且有个人我很久没给她拍照了。

lines.en: Richard! I haven't brushed my hair. Richard,
It's not fair, Richard. I'm not even ready.
lines.cn: 这样不公平 Richard。我甚至一点准备都没有。
噢，真是美极了，真是美极了！好极了！

lines.en: What a job! Good work, Richard!
lines.cn: 你拍得很棒，好作品 Richard！

lines.en: I'm so glad you like them so much.
lines.cn: 你这样喜欢它们，我真是太高兴了。

lines.en: Like them? They represent your best work.
lines.cn: 何止喜欢，它们代表了你最佳的作品。

lines.en: Well ... what do you think? Do I have my book?
lines.cn: 那么，你看怎么样，我的书可以出版？

lines.en: You do. You do. There's a book here.
I'll have a contract and an advance payment waiting for you first thing in the morning.
lines.cn: 明天一早，我就会准备好合同和预付稿酬等你来。

lines.en: And while you're here, I would like to introduce you to your editor.
lines.cn: 趁你在这里，我想介绍你认识一下你的编辑。

lines.en: And I want you to meet the people in the art department.
lines.cn: 我也希望你与美编部的人见见面。

lines.en: I'll set up an appointment with the marketing people.
lines.cn: 我会与市场营销部的人安排一次会谈。

lines.en: When do you think we'll be through?
lines.cn: 你觉得我们什么时候能谈完？

lines.en: In about half an hour. Why?
lines.cn: 大约半个小时。为什么问这？

lines.en: I can't wait to tell Marilyn!
lines.cn: 我迫不及待地想告诉 Marilyn！

lines.en: He's running for the school board.
lines.cn: 他正在竞选学区教育委员会委员。

lines.en: What's wrong with wanting to be on the school board?
lines.cn: 想进入学区教育委员会有什么错？

lines.en: But he wants to cut the school budget!
lines.cn: 但他想削减学校的预算！

lines.en: Cutting the budget is fine, but he wants to do it by cutting all the cultural programs.
lines.cn: 削减预算没问题，可他想通过取消所有文艺活动来省钱。

lines.en: No music, no dance, no concert, no stage presentations.
lines.cn: 没有音乐，没有舞蹈，没有音乐会，也没有舞台演出。

lines.en: Why does he want to do that?
He says it's to save the taxpayers' money, and I think he believes that the taxpayers will vote for him if he spends less on the cultural programs.
lines.cn: 他说是为了省纳税人的钱，我觉得他认为，只要减少文艺活动的支出，纳税人就会投票给他。

lines.en: Lots of people want their taxes used for new books and a new paint job in the schoolrooms.
lines.cn: 很多人希望把税款用来买新书、重新粉刷教室。

lines.en: Maybe some of us would like to pay a little bit more and keep the cultural programs for our kids.
lines.cn: 也许我们当中有些人愿意多交一点钱，为孩子们保留这些文艺活动。

lines.en: I hear it from my patients.
lines.cn: 我是从我的病人那儿听到这些的。

lines.en: Lots of people are tired of higher taxes.
lines.cn: 许多人对于增税很厌烦。

lines.en: I know, but if Boswell wins he'll be an important decision-maker on the school board, and he doesn't know anything about our children's education.
lines.cn: 我知道，可如果 Boswell 当选，他就会成为学区教育委员会的重要决策者，而他对孩子们的教育一无所知。
没有人。这就是问题所在。

lines.en: Well, it sounds to me like Carter Boswell is going to win this seat on the board.
lines.cn: 听起来，Carter Boswell 要赢得委员会这个席位了。

lines.en: Oh, not if I can stop him!
lines.cn: 噢，要是我能阻止他，他就甭想！

lines.en: And how are you going to stop him?
Why shouldn't you run for what, Mom?
lines.cn: 妈妈，你说不该竞选什么？

lines.en: Your mother is thinking of running for the school board.
lines.cn: 你妈妈在考虑竞选学区教育委员会委员。

lines.en: Well, if I run for office, the voters will have a clear choice.
lines.cn: 如果我参加竞选，选民就会有一个明确的选择。

lines.en: I stand for everything Boswell doesn't.
lines.cn: 我代表 Boswell 所不赞成的立场。

lines.en: I think a lot of people will vote for you against Boswell, Ellen.
lines.cn: Ellen，我想很多人会支持你，而不支持 Boswell。

lines.en: Will you help me if I do run?
lines.cn: 假如我真的竞选你会帮我忙？

lines.en: The trouble is it takes a little bit of money to run a campaign.
lines.cn: 问题是，开展竞选活动需要一些钱。

lines.en: I think you can make a difference, Ellen.
And in a short campaign you wouldn't need as much money.
lines.cn: 而且竞选期这么短，用不了那么多钱。

lines.en: Why not give the people of Riverdale a clear choice?
lines.cn: 为什么不让 Riverdale 的人民有一个明确的选择呢？

lines.en: What would you like to see me about?
Well, I'm editor of the most influential newspaper in Riverdale.
lines.cn: 我是 Riverdale 最有影响力的报纸的编辑。
事实上，它是唯一的报纸。

lines.en: A lot of people would like my help.
I'm planning to run for the school board.
lines.cn: 我打算竞选学区教育委员会委员。

lines.en: Will you announce that I'm running?
lines.cn: 你能刊登我参加竞选的消息吗？

lines.en: Why will the voters vote for you against Boswell, Mrs. Stewart?
lines.cn: Stewart 太太，选民为什么会投票给你，而不是 Boswell 呢？
“投票给 Ellen Stewart。她关心大家。”

lines.en: But what do you care about?
Well, I care about the children of our town.
lines.cn: 噢，我关心我们镇上的孩子们。

lines.en: I don't want them to grow up without cultural programs in our school.
lines.cn: 我不希望他们在没有校园文艺活动的环境中长大。

lines.en: I want our children to learn more than reading, writing, and arithmetic.
lines.cn: 我希望孩子们学到的不只是阅读、写作和算术。

lines.en: I want to keep the after-school programs-- the music, the concerts.
lines.cn: 我想保留课外活动，比如音乐和音乐会。

lines.en: But who's going to pay for all of this?
The citizens of Riverdale, of course.
lines.cn: 当然是 Riverdale 的公民。
我打算争取 Riverdale 商人和企业的帮助。

lines.en: Exactly what do you want from me, Mrs. Stewart?
lines.cn: 究竟对我有什么要求 Stewart 太太？

lines.en: I can't expect you to take my side against Boswell.
lines.cn: 我不敢期望你站在我这一边来对抗 Boswell。

lines.en: But I do need some publicity so that the people of our town know that I'm running for office and that I care about our children.
lines.cn: 不过我确实需要一些宣传，让镇上的人知道我在竞选，也知道我关心我们的孩子。

lines.en: I certainly can print the news.
lines.cn: 我当然可以刊出这则新闻。

lines.en: And you are now making news.
lines.cn: 而你现在就是在创造新闻。

lines.en: Grandpa: Here are the fliers, hot of the press!
Marilyn: Right over there, Grandpa. You fold the fliers, Richard and I will put them into the envelopes.
lines.cn: 请到这来，爷爷。你来折传单。我和 Richard 把它们放进信封。

lines.en: Richard: We finished addressing over three hundred envelopes.
lines.cn: 我们写了三百多个信封地址了。

lines.en: Mike: Hi, this is Mike Johnson. Can I speak with Mr. Or Mrs. Anderson? Thanks.
lines.cn: 嗨，我是 Mike Johnson。我可以跟 Anderson 先生或太太说话？谢谢。

lines.en: Robbie: Mr. Nelson. Hi. This is Robbie Stewart. Did you know my mother is running for the school board?
lines.cn: Nelson 先生。我是 Robbie Stewart。你知道我妈妈在竞选学区教育委员会委员吗？

lines.en: Jimmy: Yes, Miss Kim, Ellen Stewart.”She cares.” Oh, see you at the polls.
lines.cn: 是的 Kim 小姐，是 Ellen Stewart。“她关心”。噢，在投票所见。

lines.en: Robbie: Certainly, I’ll give her your best wishes, Mr. Nelson.
lines.cn: 当然。Nelson 先生，我会把你的祝福转达给她。

lines.en: Mike: Hi, this is Mike Johnson. Can I speak with Mr. or Mrs. Burns? Thank you.
lines.cn: 嗨，我是 Mike Johnson。我可以跟 Burns 先生或太太通话吗？谢谢。

lines.en: Ellen: We have done so much in such a short amount of time. I can’t believe it! Wait till Philip come and sees our progress!
lines.cn: 我们在这么短的时间里做了这么多事。我简直不敢相信！等着瞧 Philip 回来看到我们进展时的反应。

lines.en: Robbie: Everyone saw story in the Riverdale newspaper.
lines.cn: 每个人都已看到 Riverdale 报纸上的新闻。

lines.en: Ellen: Mr. Maxwell was very kind to print my announcement.
lines.cn: Maxwell 先生真好，刊登了我宣布参选的消息。

lines.en: Grandpa: It helps enormously. Everybody in Riverdale reads his paper.
lines.cn: 这个帮助很大。Riverdale 的每个人都读他的报纸。

lines.en: Richard: Your photo in it helped, too.
lines.cn: 在报纸上的照片也有帮助。

lines.en: Ellen: Thanks to you, Richard, it’s a good picture.
lines.cn: 多亏了你，Richard，照片拍得很好。

lines.en: Philip: Well, hi, all. Richard&Robbi e Hi, Dad.
Philip: And I lick the envelopes.
Robbie: Hey, everybody, Mrs. Greenberg is on the phone. She says Carter Boswell is on the TV right now-doing a commercial.
lines.cn: 大家听一下，Greenberg 太太来电话了。她说 Carter Boswell 正在电视上做广告。

lines.en: Boswell: …and if you ask what I care about, I’ll tell you. I care about the school buildings in need of paint. I care about more lockers for the teachers. I care about new fixtures in the hallways-not music or dancing or entertainment. I care about the practical things. If you do, vote for me, Carter Boswell.
lines.cn: ……如果你们问我关心什么，我会告诉你们。我关心学校的建筑物需要粉刷。我关心教师要有更多的储物柜。我关心走廊里的新灯具，而不是音乐、舞蹈或娱乐。我关心实用的事物。假如你有同感，请投我一票 Carter Boswell。

lines.en: Ellen: A lot of people will agree with him.
Robbie: Too bad kids can’t vote. It’s our school, but we can’t vote.
lines.cn: 可惜小孩不能投票。那是我们的学校，可是我们却不能投票。

lines.en: Richard: There are people in favor of the cultural programs, Mom.
lines.cn: 会有许多人赞成文化活动的，妈妈。

lines.en: Marilyn: There are, Ellen. Don’t be upset by Boswell’s commercial.
lines.cn: 一定有 Ellen。不要为了 Boswell 的广告而忧心。

lines.en: Philip: You have to go on television, too.

lines.cn: Boswell 是个有辩才的演讲家。

lines.en: Philip: You can be, too. Your ideas are good ones.
lines.cn: 你也可以。你的想法很好。

lines.en: Ellen: I don’t know. I’m not sure I’m up to it.
lines.cn: 我不知道。我不能肯定我是否能做得来。

lines.en: Ellen: …my slogan is”I care”. I care about people, not things, Vote for me, Ellen Stewart. I care. How was it?
lines.cn: ……我的口号是“我关心”。我关心人，而不是东西。请投我 Ellen Stewart 一票。我关心。怎么样？

lines.en: Ellen: Hello. My name is Ellen Stewart, and I’m running for the open seat on the school board. My slogan is”I care”. What does the word care mean?…I care about people, not things. Vote for me, Ellen Stewart. I care.
lines.cn: 大家好，我叫 Ellen Stewart，正在竞选学区教育委员会空缺的席位。我的口号是“我关心”。所谓，关心，是指什么？请投我 Ellen Stewart 一票。我关心。

lines.en: Philip: I like it, but now what? How can we possibly get it on so Riverdale will see it and hear it?
lines.cn: 我觉得不错，但接下来怎么办呢？我们怎么才能把它播出来，让 Riverdale 的人看见并听见呢？

lines.en: Ellen: …I mean that when I say”I care”. I care about people, not things. Vote for me, Ellen Stewart. I care.
lines.cn: 请投我 Ellen Stewart 一票。我关心。

lines.en: Richard: Mom is now on television in every appliance store in Riverdale, except Hamlin's. He's a Boswell voter.
lines.cn: 现在，Riverdale 每家电器商店的电视上都有妈妈，只有 Hamlin 的店除外。他是 Boswell 的支持者。

lines.en: Philip: That’s a brilliant idea, Richard!
Grandpa: You inherited your father’s brains.
lines.cn: 你继承了你父亲的好头脑。

lines.en: Philip: We got our brains from you, Day.
lines.cn: 我们从你那儿继承了好头脑，爸爸。

lines.en: Richard: And guess what? I called channel five. Their TV news is going to cover it.”Housewife campaigns in appliance stores.”And I’ll bet some magazine will pick up the story, too.
lines.cn: 你们猜怎么着？我打电话给了第五频道。他们的电视新闻将报导这一消息。“家庭主妇在电器商店开展竞选活动。”我敢说，也会有杂志报道这件事。

lines.en: Robbie: Mom, you’re going to win! I know it!
lines.cn: 妈妈，你一定会赢！我知道！

lines.en: Philip: Hold it, Robbie! Just cool down. I know we’re getting some attention now, but in the end the voters will have to decide.
lines.cn: 停停 Robbie！冷静一点。我知道我们现在引起了一些关注，但最终还是要由选民决定。

lines.en: Grandpa: You’re going to win. Trust me!
Reporter: In the hotly contested race for the one seat on the Riverdale School Board, Mrs. Ellen Stewart has taken an early lead.
lines.cn: 在争夺 Riverdale 学区教育委员会一个席位的激烈选举中，Ellen Stewart 太太目前暂时领先。

lines.en: Robbie: She’s winning! Mom, you’re winning!
lines.cn: 她领先了！妈妈，你领先了！

lines.en: Reporter: Now returning to other local news…Riverdale High School beat its rival Horace Mann in baseball today…
lines.cn: 现在再报导其它地方新闻。Riverdale 高中在今天的棒球赛中击败了对手 Horace Mann……

lines.en: Ellen: It’s too soon to know for certain.
lines.cn: 现在还太早，不知道确切情况。

lines.en: Philip: You’re ahead. That’s better than being behind.
lines.cn: 你现在领先。这总比落后要好。
广告后还有许多运动消息。

lines.en: Ellen: It’s not over yet. Let’s just all calm down, and wait for the final results.
lines.cn: 还没有完呢。大家都冷静下来，等最终结果吧。

lines.en: Grandpa: Ellen, why don’t you go out to the backyard and get some fresh air?
lines.cn: Ellen，你何不到后院去呼吸一下新鲜空气？

lines.en: Ellen: Thank you, Grandpa. I need some.
lines.cn: 谢谢你，爷爷。我确实需要。

lines.en: Philip: You came very close, Ellen.
Grandpa: You lost by only a hundred and twenty-one votes.
lines.cn: 你只差一百二十一票就赢了。

lines.en: Marilyn: You lost by a very small number of votes.
Robbie: Only one hundred and twenty-one votes! I’m sorry, Mom.
lines.cn: 仅仅一百二十一票！我很难过，妈妈。

lines.en: Ellen: There just wasn’t enough time.
lines.cn: 实在是没有足够的时间。

lines.en: Philip: Look, you’ve made a very strong impressing on our community. You’ll have another chance next election.
lines.cn: 你给我们社区留下了非常深刻的印象。下次选举你还会有机会。

lines.en: Philip: Hello. Oh, yes, yes, Mr. Maxwell.
lines.cn: 你好。噢，是的，是的 Maxwell 先生。

lines.en: Maxwell: How are you? I just called to tell you that you are very impressive. You lost the election, but you won the attention of the residents of Riverdale, of Boswell, and of me.
lines.cn: 你好吗？我打电话来，是想告诉你，你给大家留下了深刻的印象。虽然你输了选举，却赢得了 Riverdale 居民、Boswell 和我的关注。

lines.en: Ellen: Well, thank you, Mr. Maxwell. I appreciate your kind words. I needed that.
lines.cn: 噢，谢谢你 Maxwell 先生。我很感谢你好心的安慰。我正需要这个。

lines.en: Maxwell: I hear Boswell wants to appoint you to a special arts committee. I’m sending over a reporter in the morning to interview you.
lines.cn: 我听说 Boswell 想请你加入一个特别艺术委员会。我明早会派一位记者来采访你。

lines.en: Maxwell: I’m going to do an article on”Ellen Stewart-she cares.”Maybe we’ll all care now. Good-bye.
lines.cn: 我要写一篇关于“Ellen Stewart——她关心大家”的文章。也许我们大家现在都关心起来了。再见。

lines.en: Ellen: You were right, Philip. I did make a difference in town.
lines.cn: 你说对了 Philip。我确实在镇上发挥了影响力。
也给这个家带来了改变。

lines.en: Richard: Are they always that difficult to make?
Philip: The truth is…yes. I’ll try again.
lines.cn: 老实说……是很难。我再试一次。

lines.en: Robbie: At this rate, the wedding will take place tomorrow.
lines.cn: 照这个速度，婚礼得明天才能举行了。

lines.en: Philip: Not to worry. OK. Here we go.
Harry: I’m worried, Philip. What if we can’t tie the tie?
lines.cn: 我很担心 Philip。如果我们打不好领结怎么办？

lines.en: Richard: If we can’t tie the tie, then there can’t be a wedding.
lines.cn: 如果打不好领结，那就没法举行婚礼了。

lines.en: Robbie: You’d better not make Harry any more nervous than he is. Don’t worry. We'll figure a way.
lines.cn: 你最好别让 Harry 更加紧张了。别担心，我们会想法子的。

lines.en: Harry: Not so good, Grandpa. We can’t get this bow tie tied. Nobody knows how to do it. Do you?
lines.cn: 情况不太好，爷爷。我们打不好领结。没有人会打。你会吗？

lines.en: Grandpa: No. I never could, either.
Philip: Well, you have your own tuxedo. How do you tie your bow tie?
lines.cn: 可是，你有自己的晚礼服呀。你怎么打领结的？

lines.en: Robbie: Yeah, Grandpa, I’ve seen you in it. You look great. How do you tie it?
lines.cn: 对呀，爷爷。 我曾见过你那身打扮。你看起来很神气。 你怎么打的？

lines.en: Grandpa: I never could tie one of those…things…bow ties. I have always worn a clip-on bow tie.
lines.cn: 我从来就不会打那一类的……玩意儿……领结。我都是用夹上去的领结。

lines.en: Philip: Of course. Now I remember.
Grandpa: Yes, it’s so easy. All you do is clip it around under your collar.
lines.cn: 没错，它真简便。你所要做的就是，将它夹在领子下方。

lines.en: Richard: We all need one of those.
lines.cn: 我们都需要一个这样的领结。

lines.en: Robbie: The tuxedo rental store. Do you think they’re open?
lines.cn: 礼服出租店。你们说现在还开门？

lines.en: Philip: Should be. Sunday’s their big day.
lines.cn: 应该是开的。 星期天是他们大生意的日子。

lines.en: Richard: I’ll call and find out.
Grandpa: Well, if they’re not, I’ll lend you mine, Harry. You’re the only one who really needs to be wearing a tuxedo, anyway.
lines.cn: Harry，如果店没开，我就把我的借给你。反正你才是我们当中唯一真正需要穿晚礼服的人。

lines.en: Philip: I’m the father of the bride. I’m supposed to be worried about my daughter, and here I am with the man that’s marrying my daughter-worrying about him.
lines.cn: 我是新娘的父亲。我本来应该为女儿担心，结果却在这里，为这个即将娶我女儿的人操心。

lines.en: Grandpa: Poor Harry. I know the feeling. Wedding-day litters.
lines.cn: 可怜的 Harry。 我知道这种感觉。婚礼当天的紧张情绪。

lines.en: Richard: We’re in luck. They’re open. And they have lots of clip-on bow ties.
lines.cn: 我们运气好。 店开着。而且他们有许多夹上去的领结。

lines.en: Robbie: I’ll bicycle down to the village and get them.
Grandpa: There’s lots of time. A little over two hours.
lines.cn: 时间多得很。两个钟头多一点。

lines.en: Harry: In two hours and fifteen minutes I’ll be married to Susan.
lines.cn: 再过两小时十五分钟，我就要和 Susan 结婚了。

lines.en: Philip: And be a true member of the Stewart family.
lines.cn: 也真正成了 Stewart 家庭中的一员。

lines.en: Grandpa: Oh, you’re a lucky guy, Harry. Susan is one of the best women you’ll ever find. She’s just like her grandma.
lines.cn: 噢，你是一个幸运的家伙 Harry。Susan 是你能找到最好的女人之一。她就像她的祖母一样。

lines.en: Richard: Now, once you put the ring on Susan’s finger, you are one of us, Harry. And don’t ever forget it.
lines.cn: Harry，一旦你把戒指戴到 Susan 手上，你就是我们家的一员了。永远别忘记这一点。

lines.en: Harry: Ring? Ring? Oh my! What did I do with the rings? I put them in the pocket of my sports jacket.
lines.cn: 戒指，戒指，噢，我的天，我把戒指放哪儿了？我把它们放进了休闲西装外套的口袋里。

lines.en: Richard: No, I think you put them in your tuxedo jacket pocket. Remember?
lines.cn: 不对，我想你把它们放在晚礼服上衣的口袋里了。记得吗？

lines.en: Harry: Right. What did I do with the rings?
Philip: Didn’t you give them to Richard? He’s your best man. I remember. You gave them to Richard.
lines.cn: 你不是把它们交给 Richard 了？他是你的伴郎呀。我记起来了。 你交给了 Richard。

lines.en: Richard: Oh, yeah. I remember now. You handed them to me. What did I do with them?
lines.cn: 噢，对了。 我现在想起来了。你将它们给了我。我把它们放在哪儿？

lines.en: Harry: I hope they aren’t lost.
Grandpa: Oh, don’t worry, Harry. They have to be here.
lines.cn: 别担心 Harry。它们肯定就在这儿。

lines.en: Richard: I remember. I gave them to Robbie to hold so I wouldn’t lose them.
lines.cn: 我想起来了，我交给 Robbie 拿着，免得自己弄丢。

lines.en: Harry: Oh, I forget. What time is it?
lines.cn: 噢，我忘了。现在是什么时间了？

lines.en: Grandpa: It’s still a little over two hours, Harry. Just relax.
lines.cn: 仍然还有两个多小时 Harry 不用紧张。

lines.en: Richard: I’m sure Robbie has them.

Harry: No, NO, Robbie doesn’t have them. He gave them to me to hold on to them because he didn’t want the responsibility of holding them. I put them in my tuxedo but in the lapel pocket. That’s a relent. I was really worried.
lines.cn: 不，不 Robbie 没有拿。他把戒指交还给我保管，因为他不想承担保管戒指的责任。我把它们放进了晚礼服的胸前口袋里。现在我放心了。 刚才我真的很担心。

lines.en: Richard: I’ll hold on to them for you. The best man always keeps the rings.
lines.cn: 我为你保管吧。戒指一向由伴郎保管。

lines.en: Harry: You’re right. You’re right. You hold on to them so there won’t be problem later.
lines.cn: 你说的对。你来保管，免得等一下又出问题了。

lines.en: Philip: Well, now, I think we’d better get dressed, fellas.
lines.cn: 好了，现在我们最好去穿好衣服，各位。

lines.en: Richard: Robbie will bring the ties back.
Philip: Try to take it easy. It’ll all be over in two hours.
lines.cn: 放轻松点。再两个小时就结束了。

lines.en: Grandpa: The wedding ceremony will be over. You’ll be husband and wife.
lines.cn: 婚礼会结束。你们就成为夫妻了。

lines.en: Harry: I guess you’re right. Two hours from now. Two hours from now.
lines.cn: 说的也对。 从现在起还有两个小时。从现在起两小时。

lines.en: Marilyn: And now for…something old, something new, something borrowed, and something blue.
lines.cn: 现在轮到……一件旧的、一件新的、一件借来的，还有一件蓝色的东西。

lines.en: Susan: OK. Let’s see. Something borrowed. That’s this dress. Borrowed from Marilyn.
lines.cn: 让我们看看。借来的东西。就是这件礼服，向 Marilyn 借的。

lines.en: Ellen: Something blue. My wristband. I wore it when I married your father.
lines.cn: 蓝色的东西。我的腕带。我和你父亲结婚时戴着它。

lines.en: Susan: Oh, Mother. I forgot you still had it. It’s just so lovely.
lines.cn: 噢，妈妈。我忘了你仍然保留着它。它是那么可爱。

lines.en: Ellen: I bought it in an antique shop when I was about eighteen years old. I saved it for my wedding day.
lines.cn: 我十八岁左右时，在一家古董店买了它。我留着等我的结婚日才用。

lines.en: Susan: And you saved it for me, didn’t you, Mother?
lines.cn: 也留着要给我，对吗，妈妈？

lines.en: Ellen: Yes, honey I did. Are we ever going to finish?
lines.cn: 是的，亲爱的，是这样。我们这样谈得完吗？

lines.en: Ellen: All right. OK. Something borrowed.
Marilyn: The wedding dress. And something blue.
Ellen: Something old. Right. What’s old?
lines.cn: 旧的东西。对了，旧的东西是什么？

lines.en: Susan: Of course! Something old. I had planned to wear them.
lines.cn: 当然有！旧的东西。我早就预备戴它们。

lines.en: Ellen: Grandma’s pearls! Oh, Grandpa will be so pleased that you’re wearing them. I’m sure he misses Grandma on a day like this.
lines.cn: 奶奶的珍珠项链！噢，戴了它，祖父一定会非常高兴。我想在这样的日子祖父一定会思念祖母。

lines.en: Susan: Help me with them, Marilyn. I’ve never worn them before. I’ve been saving them for today.
lines.cn: 帮我戴上 Marilyn。我从来没有戴过这个。我一直留着等今天才戴。

lines.en: Ellen: Saving them for today? Oh, you’re a real Stewart!
lines.cn: 留着等今天？哦，你真是个地道的 Stewart 家人！

lines.en: Marilyn: Oh, there you go. Lovely!
lines.cn: 噢，一切都好了。太可爱了！

lines.en: Marilyn: Something borrowed, something blue. Something old… and now for something new.
lines.cn: 借的东西，蓝色的东西。旧的东西……现在该看新的东西了。

lines.en: Susan: The veil. Oh, it’s so beautiful, Marilyn!
Ellen: You really are a fabulous designer, Marilyn.
lines.cn: Marilyn，你真是个出色的设计师。

lines.en: Marilyn: Doesn’t it look just right on Susan?
lines.cn: Susan 戴起来正好，不是吗？

lines.en: Marilyn: And when you both say, “I do,” Harry will lift this veil over your head and kiss the bride.
lines.cn: 当你们两人都说“我愿意”时，Harry 就会掀起你的头纱，亲吻新娘。

lines.en: Susan: When you said, “I do, ” Marilyn, it suddenly became real.
lines.cn: Marilyn，你刚说“我愿意”的时候，这一切突然变得真实了。

lines.en: Marilyn: That’s all right, Susan. You’ve got the wedding-day jitters! In less than two hours, you will be Mrs. Harry Bennett.
lines.cn: 没有错 Susan。你这是婚礼当天的紧张情绪！再过不到两个小时，你就成为 Harry Bennett 太太了。

lines.en: Ellen: Oh, that reminds me. If we don’t get dressed, we won’t be there to see Susan become Mrs. Harry Bennett.
lines.cn: 噢，倒提醒了我。如果我们还不去换衣服，就赶不上看 Susan 成为 Harry Bennett 太太了。

lines.en: Susan: Before you leave-do I look all right?
lines.cn: 在你们离开之前，告诉我，我这样子可以吗？

lines.en: Marilyn: She’s right. And that’s dear little Max. Got to go and feed him.
lines.cn: 她说得没错。那是亲爱的小 Max。我得去喂他了。

lines.en: Susan: What am I Supposed to do?
Marilyn: Take off the veil, kick off your shoes, and sit down.
lines.cn: 摘下头纱，脱掉鞋子，坐下来。

lines.en: Ellen: We’ll come upstairs and get you in a little while.
lines.cn: 我们待会儿就上楼来带你下去。

lines.en: Marilyn: Richard’s going to take some wedding pictures before the ceremony. So just relax.
lines.cn: Richard 会在仪式开始前拍些婚礼照片。所以，放轻松点。

lines.en: Susan: Susan Stewart…you are about to become Susan Bennett-Mrs. Harry Bennett.
lines.cn: Susan Stewart……你就要成为 Susan Bennett，也就是 Harry Bennett 太太了。

lines.en: Judge: How are you? How are you?
Judge: I think it’s time for the wedding to begin.
lines.cn: 我想是婚礼可以开始的时候了。

lines.en: Judge: All right, ladies and gentlemen. Please take your places. The wedding ceremony is about to begin.
lines.cn: 好啦，女士们，先生们。请大家就座。婚礼就要开始了。

lines.en: Judge: OK, Jane. Start the music.

Judge: Dearly beloved, we are gathered here today to join this man and this woman in holy matrimony. Do either of you have any reason why you should not legally be joined in marriage? Is there anyone present who can show any just cause why these two people should not be legally joined in marriage? Then, Harry Bennett, do you take Susan Stewart to be your lawful, wedded wife?
lines.cn: 亲爱的各位，今天我们聚在这里，见证这位男士和这位女士缔结神圣的婚姻。你们两位是否有任何理由……（原稿此句未完）在座是否有人能提出任何正当理由，说明这两位不应合法结婚？那么，Harry Bennett，你愿意接受 Susan Stewart 作为你的合法妻子吗？

lines.en: Judge: And you, Susan Stewart, do you take Harry Bennett to be your lawful, wedded husband?
lines.cn: Susan Stewart，你愿意接受 Harry Bennett 作为你的合法丈夫吗？

lines.en: Judge: The rings, please. Richard  I have them, Harry.
lines.cn: 请把戒指拿来。在我这 Harry。

lines.en: Judge: By the power vested in me by the laws of the State of New York, I now pronounce you husband and wife. You may kiss the bride now, Harry.
lines.cn: 凭借纽约州法律赋予我的权力，我现在宣布你们结为夫妻。你可以吻新娘了 Harry。

lines.en: She went to a school-board meeting.
lines.cn: 她去参加学区教育委员会会议了。

lines.en: I don't know how she does it.
lines.cn: 我不知道她怎么办到的。

lines.en: There are lots of places to go, lots of things to do.
lines.cn: 有很多地方要去，许多事情要做。

lines.en: She can't sit around and do nothing.
lines.cn: 她总不能闲坐着无所事事呀。

lines.en: I wish I had her energy.
lines.cn: 我希望我有她那样的精力。

lines.en: She went to a school-board meeting.
lines.cn: 她去参加学区教育委员会的会议。

lines.en: There's a note for you on the refrigerator.
lines.cn: 冰箱上有她留给你的字条。

lines.en: Mike and I had a hamburger at the diner. Mike
lines.cn: Mike 和我在小餐馆吃了汉堡。

lines.en: I came home a little while ago.
You've been working late almost every night this week, Dad.
lines.cn: 爸爸，这星期你几乎每晚都工作到很晚。

lines.en: I don't have time to be exhausted.
lines.cn: 我没有时间去精疲力尽。

lines.en: You and Mom haven't had dinner together with us in almost a full week.
lines.cn: 你和妈妈差不多整整一周没和我们一起吃晚饭了。

lines.en: Yeah, I feel bad about us not having dinner with the family, but our schedules are so different.
lines.cn: 是啊，没能和家人一起吃晚饭，我也很过意不去，可我们的时间安排差得太多了。

lines.en: Either I'm at the hospital doing paperwork, or Mom is at a committee meeting.
lines.cn: 不是我在医院处理文书工作，就是妈妈在参加委员会的会议。

lines.en: I frankly don't know what to do about it.
lines.cn: 我真不知道该怎么解决。

lines.en: I'm worried about you and Mom.
You really have been working too hard.
Well, I think I've had enough of that sandwich.
lines.cn: 好啦，我想我已经吃够了三明治。

lines.en: It's not good to eat before going to bed.
Well, I'm heading off for bed and a good night's sleep.
lines.cn: 好啦，我先去睡觉了，睡一个好觉。

lines.en: Haven't you finished balancing that checkbook?
lines.cn: 你还没有核对完支票簿账目？

lines.en: I'll be off to bed myself in a minute.
lines.cn: 我再过一会也要上床睡觉了。

lines.en: I'm really concerned about them, Grandpa.
lines.cn: 我真的为他们担心，爷爷。

lines.en: They hardly ever see each other.
Dad often works late, and Mom has all these committees she's on.
lines.cn: 爸爸经常工作到很晚，妈妈又参加了那么多委员会。

lines.en: What do you propose to do about it?
You have that look in your eye.
lines.cn: 你看起来好像有了主意似的。

lines.en: I don't know, but there must be a way of getting them to spend more time together.
lines.cn: 我不知道，但总该有办法让他们多花些时间相处。

lines.en: What are you doing up this late?
lines.cn: 这么晚还没睡，在做什么？

lines.en: What are you doing up this late?
lines.cn: 这么晚你不睡在干什么？

lines.en: Do you care to talk about them?
Sure, if you don't mind listening.
lines.cn: 当然，假如你不介意听的话。

lines.en: Robbie, Robbie, remember me? Robbie Robbie

lines.cn: 还记得我吗？我是你妈妈。

lines.en: If you have something you want to talk about, I'm always prepared to listen.
lines.cn: 只要你有想谈的事情，我随时愿意听。

lines.en: You haven't been around much lately.
lines.cn: 最近你在家的时候不多。

lines.en: You and Dad are like ships that pass in the night.
lines.cn: 你和爸爸就像在夜里交错而过的船一样。

lines.en: Dad works hard, and he works late.
lines.cn: 爸爸工作忙，而且忙到很晚。

lines.en: You work hard on all your committees, and you work late.
lines.cn: 你忙着各个委员会的工作，也忙到很晚。

lines.en: I thought you were proud of the work I do.
lines.cn: 我还以为你为我所做的工作感到骄傲。

lines.en: You are one fantastic mom, but ... but I've been noticing how little quality time you spend with Dad and me ... and the family.
lines.cn: 你是个很棒的妈妈，可是……我注意到，你和爸爸、我以及家人用心相处的时间太少了。

lines.en: There must be a way that Dad and you can spend more time together.
lines.cn: 总该有办法让你和爸爸多一些相处时间。

lines.en: Well, we always talk about taking a vacation together--with the family.
lines.cn: 我们总说要全家一起去度假。

lines.en: I think you ought to take a vacation away from the family--alone.
lines.cn: 我觉得你们该暂时离开家人，单独去度个假。

lines.en: It would be wonderful, but our schedules won't allow it.
lines.cn: 那当然很美好，可我们的时间安排不允许。

lines.en: I think I have an idea.
I think I have an idea that will bring Dad and you together in a more scheduled way.
lines.cn: 我想到了一个办法，能让你和爸爸更有规律地一起相处。

lines.en: Well, you know how Dad is always talking about the kids in the ward and how important it is for them to be paid attention to?
lines.cn: 你知道，爸爸总说起病房里的孩子，还有他们多么需要有人关心，对吧？

lines.en: Well ... and how hard it is because the doctors and nurses are so busy?
lines.cn: 也说过要做到这点很难，因为医生和护士都太忙，对吧？

lines.en: Well, how would it be if you took some time to work with Dad towards solving that problem?
lines.cn: 那你抽点时间和爸爸一起解决这个问题，怎么样？

lines.en: Like setting up a regular weekly reading program.
lines.cn: 譬如说开办一项每周一次的定期阅读计划。
你和爸爸，也就是你和 Philip Stewart 医生，每周一两次去儿童病房，为孩子们朗读。

lines.en: going to the children's ward once or twice a week
lines.cn: 也就是你和 Philip Stewart 医生，每周一两次去儿童病房，为孩子们朗读。
你和爸爸，也就是你和 Philip Stewart 医生，每周一两次去儿童病房，为孩子们朗读。

lines.en: As a matter of fact, it fits right in with something I'm working on right now with the school-board committee.
lines.cn: 其实，这正好符合我目前和学区教育委员会一起筹划的一个项目。

lines.en: I've been trying to work out a program in the public school that will bring parents and teachers together once a week to read to the students--their own children, really.
lines.cn: 我一直在为公立学校设计一项计划，让家长和老师每周聚在一起，为学生们——其实就是他们自己的孩子——朗读。

lines.en: By doing that, it will encourage reading.
So it might fit in with a program for reading to the kids in the hospital.
lines.cn: 所以，这也许能和为住院孩子朗读的计划结合起来。

lines.en: I'm going to talk to Daddy about it right now.
lines.cn: 我现在就去跟爸爸谈谈这件事。

lines.en: But Dad was so exhausted when he came home from work.
lines.cn: 但爸爸工作回来时已经累得不得了。

lines.en: Why don't you talk to him about it tomorrow?
You are a very smart young man, Robbie.
lines.cn: 你是个绝顶聪明的年轻人 Robbie。

lines.en: I think I'll wait until tomorrow.
It is a great idea, and I promise you I won't forget.
lines.cn: 这是个好主意，我向你保证不会忘记。
花儿闻起来好香，不是吗？

lines.en: That's why I'm reading my paper and having my coffee on the patio this morning.
lines.cn: 所以今天早晨我才在露台上看报、喝咖啡。

lines.en: How was your school-board meeting last night?
lines.cn: 你昨晚的学区教育委员会会议开得怎么样？

lines.en: You must've come home very late.
Did you find the sandwich I made for you?
lines.cn: 你找到我为你做的三明治了？

lines.en: I was so tired I didn't even finish it.
lines.cn: 我太累了，连三明治都没吃完。

lines.en: Philip, I've been working on this special project Philip with the school board, and I'd like your opinion about it.
lines.cn: Philip，我一直在和学区教育委员会筹划一个特别项目，想听听你的意见。

lines.en: I've been trying to find a way to encourage reading.
lines.cn: 我一直在想办法鼓励大家阅读。

lines.en: Well, I think I may have found a way to do it.
lines.cn: 噢，我想我也许已找到一种办法。

lines.en: I work with families every day, Ellen.
lines.cn: 我每天的工作就是接触一些家庭 Ellen。

lines.en: I see how people spend their leisure time-- young and old.
lines.cn: 我看得出人们怎样度过闲暇时间，不论老少。

lines.en: Well, that would be OK if, and I repeat, if people took the time to read.
lines.cn: 那倒没关系，只要——我再说一遍——只要人们也愿意花时间阅读。

lines.en: I couldn't agree with you more.
The question is, how do we get them to read more?
lines.cn: 问题是，怎样才能让他们多读书？

lines.en: I think you're going to give me the answer to that question.
lines.cn: 我想，你会告诉我这个问题的答案。

lines.en: You have that look in your eye.
lines.cn: 你的眼睛显示出你已有了答案。

lines.en: I do have an answer, Philip.
Or at least I think I do.
The plan is a simple one.
Involve the entire family in a reading project.
lines.cn: 让整个家庭都参与阅读计划。

lines.en: But how do you plan to do that?
By arranging with the public schools to schedule one hour a week--to start with.
lines.cn: 和公立学校商量，先从每周安排一小时开始。

lines.en: During that time parents are invited to attend-- and to read along with the children--their children.
lines.cn: 在这段时间里，邀请家长来和自己的孩子一起阅读。

lines.en: It can go beyond the school system, Ellen.
lines.cn: 这可以推广到学校体制以外 Ellen。

lines.en: I guarantee you it would go very well in the hospitals.
lines.cn: 我保证在医院这种计划会推行得很好。

lines.en: My patients--mostly kids-- would love to read and be read to.
lines.cn: 我的病人大多是孩子，他们会喜欢自己读书，也喜欢有人读给他们听。

lines.en: Maybe we can experiment with your patients and see how the plan works.
lines.cn: 也许我们可以先在你的病人中试一试，看看这项计划的效果。

lines.en: Would you work with me on it?
And that way, we'll spend more time together, Ellen.
lines.cn: Ellen，这样我们就能多一些时间在一起了。

lines.en: We just don't see each other anymore.
lines.cn: 我们彼此差不多见不到面了。

lines.en: You and I are very busy these days.
lines.cn: 这些天来我们俩都很忙。

lines.en: We need to find time to be together more, to do things together more--you and I.
lines.cn: 你和我需要找时间多相处，多一起做些事情。

lines.en: This would be a wonderful way to accomplish that.
lines.cn: 这倒是达到这个目的的绝佳办法。

lines.en: To the patients in the ward?
Well, let you and I talk about it.
lines.cn: 好，我们一起讨论一下吧。

lines.en: What would you like to read to them?
lines.cn: 你想读些什么给他们听？

lines.en: Mrs. Stewart and I Stewart will read a poem by Robert Frost.
lines.cn: Stewart 太太和我将朗读 Robert Frost 的一首诗。

lines.en: It's called "Stopping by Woods on a Snowy Evening."
lines.cn: 诗的题目是《雪夜林边小驻》。

lines.en: "Stopping by Woods on a Snowy Evening"
Whose woods these are I think I know.
lines.cn: 这是谁的树林，我想我知道。

lines.en: His house is in the village though;
lines.cn: 不过他的房子在村子里；

lines.en: He will not see me stopping here
lines.cn: 他不会看见我停在这里，

lines.en: To watch his woods fill up with snow.
lines.cn: 望着他的树林落满白雪。

lines.en: My little horse must think it queer
lines.cn: 我的小马一定觉得奇怪，

lines.en: To stop without a farmhouse near
lines.cn: 为何停在附近没有农舍的地方，

lines.en: Between the woods and frozen lake
lines.cn: 在树林与冰封的湖面之间，

lines.en: The darkest evening of the year.
lines.cn: 在一年中最幽暗的夜晚。

lines.en: He gives his harness bells a shake
lines.cn: 它摇了摇挽具上的铃铛，

lines.en: To ask if there is some mistake.
lines.cn: 仿佛在问是不是弄错了。

lines.en: The only other sound's the sweep
lines.cn: 除此之外，只听见轻轻掠过的声音，

lines.en: Of easy wind and downy flake.
lines.cn: 那是微风和柔软的雪花。

lines.en: The woods are lovely, dark and deep,
But I have promises to keep,
And miles to go before I sleep,
lines.cn: 安睡之前，还得走上许多英里，

lines.en: And miles to go before I sleep.
lines.cn: 安睡之前，还得走上许多英里。

lines.en: You two belong on stage! That was wonderful!
lines.cn: 你们俩简直是职业演员，太棒了！

lines.en: Dad ... Robbie. When did you come?
We've been listening to you both.
lines.cn: 我们一直在听你们朗诵。
你们喜欢在一起朗诵吗？

lines.en: Well, we may read together aloud at home.
lines.cn: 嗯，我们或许可以在家，一起大声朗诵。

episodes.title: A Big Fish in a Little Pond

lines.en: I really like this one Susan. Do you? Susan
lines.cn: Susan，我真的很喜欢这一件。你呢？

lines.en: Turn around, Michelle. Let me see the back of it.
lines.cn: 转过去一下 Michelle。让我看看它的背面。

lines.en: I like it a lot. It fits well.
It doesn't need any alterations. We must've bought the right size.
lines.cn: 不需要任何修改。我们一定买对了尺寸。

lines.en: I like the color. She looks good in blue.
lines.cn: 我喜欢这颜色。她穿蓝色的很好看。

lines.en: Try on the skirt and blouse outfit, Michelle-- the one that Daddy wanted you to wear.
lines.cn: 试试上衣和裙子那一套，Michelle——就是爸爸想让你穿的那套。

lines.en: Michelle has been a different kid since we've been married.
lines.cn: 自从我们结婚后 Michelle 变成另一个人了。
她从来没有像现在这样快乐过。

lines.en: And I've never been happier, Harry.
lines.cn: 我也从来没有这样快乐过 Harry。

lines.en: I love her very much. She's been a joy.
lines.cn: 我很爱她。她是个讨人喜欢的孩子。

lines.en: We're very lucky, the three of us ... and becoming part of the Stewart family, too.
lines.cn: 我们三个都很幸运……而且还能成为 Stewart 家的一员。

lines.en: We couldn't ask for anything more, could we?
lines.cn: 我们再没什么可求的了，对吧？

lines.en: Well ...? Could we ask for anything more?
lines.cn: 嗯…… 我们还有什么可求的？

lines.en: How do you like it, Daddy?
It's good for every day. It will be good for school, Michelle.
lines.cn: 这套衣服每天都可以穿。它适合上学时穿 Michelle。

lines.en: I like it, too. I always like skirts that go like this.
lines.cn: 我也喜欢它。我一直喜欢能像这样飘动的裙子。

lines.en: Do you want to see the winter jacket on me, Susan?
lines.cn: 你想看看我穿上冬季夹克的样子吗，Susan？

lines.en: Yes, I do. Change back into your jeans,
and put on the new winter jacket we bought today.
lines.cn: 我想看看。换回你的牛仔裤，再穿上我们今天买的新冬季夹克。

lines.en: You had something on your mind when I said we couldn't ask for anything more.
lines.cn: 我说我们再没什么可求的时候，你心里显然有事。

lines.en: Let's take a look at the winter jacket. Come on over here, honey.
lines.cn: 让我们看看冬季夹克。到这儿来，亲爱的。

lines.en: It is. That's why we bought it for you.
lines.cn: 是的。这就是我们买给你的原因。

lines.en: This will be a perfect jacket for the wintertime when it's very cold out.
lines.cn: 冬天外面很冷时，这件夹克就再合适不过了。

lines.en: But it's kind of small also. We must've bought the wrong size.
lines.cn: 不过它也有点小。我们一定买错了尺寸。

lines.en: Looks like we should've bought a bigger one.
lines.cn: 看来我们应该买一件大些的。

lines.en: I guess we'll have to exchange it, too.
lines.cn: 我想我们还得去换一件。

lines.en: I'm sure the store has others.
lines.cn: 我相信那家店一定还有其它的尺寸。

lines.en: I look silly! It is too small!
Can I take it off? I'm hot!
Sure. Put it back in your room, and we'll hang everything up later.
lines.cn: 当然。把它放回你的房间，过一会儿我们把衣服都挂好。

lines.en: Well, are you going to tell me what's on your mind, Harry?
lines.cn: 好了，Harry，你要不要告诉我你在想什么？

lines.en: I have been offered a job with a major accounting company in Los Angeles.
lines.cn: 洛杉矶一家大型会计公司给了我一个工作机会。

lines.en: I have been offered a job with a major accounting company
Los Angeles? That's a big decision. Los Angeles
lines.cn: Los Angeles 这可是个大决定。

lines.en: I know. It will also affect you and your job, if we decide to go.
lines.cn: 我知道。假如我们决定去的话，也会影响到你和你的工作。

lines.en: Wow! It sure will. But first tell me about the job, Harry.
lines.cn: 喔，当然会。但首先告诉我是什么样的工作 Harry。

lines.en: If it's a good one, then we'll make it work for us.
lines.cn: 如果是份好工作，我们就想办法协调好。

lines.en: I have a client in the garment business, on Seventh Avenue.
lines.cn: 我有个客户在 Seventh Avenue 从事成衣生意。

lines.en: I do his taxes every year.
He has a big sales office in Los Angeles, and the company in Los Angeles that does his major accounting work is looking for an executive. And he recommended me.
lines.cn: 他在洛杉矶有个很大的销售办事处，那里为他处理主要会计业务的公司正在物色一位主管，他推荐了我。

lines.en: Yes, but it would mean that we'd have to move to L.A.
lines.cn: 是的。但这意味着我们必须搬到洛杉矶。

lines.en: Susan, I don't plan to make any decisions Susan until I have a chance to talk with you about it.
lines.cn: Susan，在有机会和你谈这件事之前，我不打算做任何决定。

lines.en: And I don't have to make a quick decision.
lines.cn: 而且我也不需很快下决定。

lines.en: They know that I'm married and that I have a family.
lines.cn: 他们知道我结婚了，有一个家。

lines.en: Well, there's a lot to think about.
If it's a good job, then I've got to do some thinking about my career opportunities in Los Angeles.
lines.cn: 如果是份好工作，那我就得考虑一下自己在洛杉矶的事业机会了。

lines.en: Are you ready for lunch with your grandpa?
lines.cn: 准备好和爷爷一起吃午饭了吗？

lines.en: Oh! Hi, Grandpa. Yes, of course, I am, but my mind isn't.
lines.cn: 嗨，爷爷。是的，当然，我准备好了但是有点心事。

lines.en: Does it have anything to do with you and Harry?
lines.cn: 是关于你和 Harry 的事吗？

lines.en: Yes, but I don't know where to start.
lines.cn: 是的，但我不知道从何说起。

lines.en: Maybe I can help. Tell me what it is, Susan.
lines.cn: 也许我能帮忙。说给我听听 Susan。

lines.en: Oh! Harry has been offered a job in Los Angeles.
lines.cn: 有人聘请 Harry 到 Los Angeles 工作。

lines.en: Well, this is something to think about.
lines.cn: 噢，这种事确实需要想一想。

lines.en: There are so many things to consider. There's Michelle.
lines.cn: 要考虑的事太多了。首先是 Michelle。

lines.en: I wonder if a move would be a bad thing for her. And my job.
lines.cn: 我不知道搬家对她来说是否是件坏事。还有我的工作。

lines.en: I don't know if I can get a good job in Los Angeles.
lines.cn: 我不知道我能否在 Los Angeles 找到好工作。
另外就是我们家的人怎么办？

lines.en: Can I tell you what I think?
lines.cn: 让我告诉你我的想法，好吗？

lines.en: I think that you're very successful and that you have a fantastic reputation in the toy industry.
lines.cn: 我觉得你事业很成功，在玩具行业也有很好的声誉。

lines.en: I think you could talk to Mr. Marchetta, and I think he could help you find a real good job in Los Angeles.
lines.cn: 我想你可以和 Marchetta 先生谈谈，我觉得他能帮你在洛杉矶找到很好的工作。

lines.en: He was very helpful to me, remember?
I suppose I could call him.
lines.cn: 我想我可以打电话给他。

lines.en: But I'm not so sure that I want to leave New York, you, and the rest of our family.
lines.cn: 但我不确定自己想不想离开纽约，离开你和家里的其他人。

lines.en: Well, I'm not going to kid you, Susan.
You know we'd all miss you.
lines.cn: 你知道，我们都会想念你的。

lines.en: But this should be your decision.
It's something that only you and Harry can work out.
lines.cn: 这件事只有你和 Harry 才能定夺。

lines.en: If moving to L.A. is in Harry's best interest, I have to do what I can do to support him.
lines.cn: 如果搬去洛杉矶对 Harry 最有利，我就得尽力支持他。

lines.en: In every marriage, sacrifices have to be made by one partner from time to time.
lines.cn: 在每一段婚姻中，双方总得有人不时做出牺牲。

lines.en: I think Michelle is better off staying where she is.
lines.cn: 我觉得 Michelle 待在原地比较好。
