lines.en: Well, you'll have to ask her.
I think I'm going to have a talk with Mr. Marchetta and get his feelings about my leaving.
lines.cn: 我想我要和 Marchetta 先生谈谈，听听他对我离开的看法。

lines.en: And about helping me find a job in Los Angeles.
lines.cn: 请他帮我在 Los Angeles 找一份工作。

lines.en: I'll call him right now. No point in delaying.
lines.cn: 我现在就打给他。没有道理要拖拉。

lines.en: Harry, it's the perfect job for you. You'll love it. Harry
lines.cn: Harry 那是份最适合你的工作。你会喜欢的。

lines.en: It's a big decision for me, Bill.
lines.cn: 对我来说这是个大决定 Bill。

lines.en: And I have to discuss it with my wife.
lines.cn: 我必须跟我的太太讨论。

lines.en: I don't know if it's right for her.
lines.cn: 我不知道这事对她是否恰当。

lines.en: She'll love it. It's a once-in-a-lifetime offer, Harry.
lines.cn: 她也会喜欢的。这是个千载难逢的机会 Harry。

lines.en: OK. Tell it to me again.
The company is Craft and Craft, the biggest accounting company in the country.
lines.cn: 这家公司是 Craft and Craft，是全国最大的会计公司。

lines.en: I know the company well. It's big.
lines.cn: 这家公司我很清楚。是大公司。

lines.en: Yeah, yeah. The biggest. When do I have to let you know?
lines.cn: 是的，是的，最大的。我什么时候该给你回音？

lines.en: Talk it over. Think it over. Let me know by the end of the week.
lines.cn: 好好谈一谈，想一想。这周末以前告诉我你的决定。

lines.en: When would we have to move?
I also have my daughter to consider.
I don't want to interrupt her school year.
lines.cn: 我不愿意打断她这个学年。

lines.en: Let me know by the end of the week.
It's a great opportunity for you, Harry.
lines.cn: 这对你是个大好机会 Harry。

lines.en: Craft and Craft is the biggest in the country. Craft and Crraft
lines.cn: Craft and Craft 是全国最大的会计公司。

lines.en: I think Michelle is asleep now. Let's talk.
lines.cn: 我想 Michelle 现在睡着了。让我们谈谈吧。

lines.en: I met with Bill York today.
lines.cn: 今天我跟 Bill York 会面了。

lines.en: And I talked with Mr. Marchetta. Did York make the offer?
lines.cn: 我也和 Marchetta 先生谈了。York 向你提出工作邀请了吗？

lines.en: Yup. He asked me if I want the job.
lines.cn: 是的。他问我要不要接受那份工作。

lines.en: That's exciting, Harry. What was it?
lines.cn: 真令人兴奋，Harry。是什么职位？

lines.en: A vice-presidency with the biggest accounting company in the country-- Craft and Craft. Craft and Crraft。
lines.cn: 全国最大的会计公司——Craft and Craft 的副总裁。

lines.en: Sure I am. But there's so much more to consider.
lines.cn: 我当然兴奋。但是还有那么多问题需要考虑。
我和 Marchetta 先生谈了。

lines.en: What did he say? Did you tell him about me?
lines.cn: 他怎么说？你告诉他我的事了吗？

lines.en: Of course, Harry. I want what's best for you, and I think I can get a good job through Mr. Marchetta in Los Angeles also.
lines.cn: 当然，Harry。我希望你能有最好的发展，而且我想，通过 Marchetta 先生的帮助，我也能在洛杉矶找到一份好工作。

lines.en: I talked with him, and he understands completely.
lines.cn: 我与他谈了，他完全了解。

lines.en: He has a major toy buyer in Los Angeles, and he's pretty sure that I can get a good job there.

lines.en: And how do you feel about taking the job in Los Angeles?

lines.en: It's the biggest company in the country.

lines.en: Well ... I feel fine about it. Why shouldn't I?
lines.cn: 嗯……我觉得不错。为什么不？

lines.en: I love my school. I have so many good friends there now.
lines.cn: 我喜欢我的学校。我现在有那么多好朋友在那。

lines.en: I wouldn't miss a day even if I were really sick.
lines.cn: 即使我真的病了也不想错过一天。

lines.en: Come and sit down for a minute, Michelle.
I'd like to talk to you about something.

lines.cn: 但你爸爸和我正在讨论一件事，我想听听你的意见。

lines.en: I know. I heard you talking about it

lines.en: Well, I really wouldn't want to move, but ...
lines.cn: 噢，我实在不愿意搬家，但是……

lines.en: But if you and Daddy wanted to, I guess you know what's best for the family and for me.

lines.en: That's very considerate of you, Michelle.
I'd miss them a lot, but I know what it feels like to miss someone.
lines.cn: 我会很想念他们，但我知道想念一个人是什么滋味。

lines.en: Honey, we don't have to move if you're not going to be happy about it.
lines.cn: 亲爱的，如果搬家会让你不开心，我们不一定要搬。

lines.en: I think so. He's going to tell us tonight about the job offer.
lines.cn: 我想是这样。他今天晚上会告诉我们关于那份工作的事。

lines.en: Well, how was everybody's day today?
lines.cn: 那么，大家今天过得怎么样？

lines.en: Michelle was chosen to do Michelle the school poster for the play this year.

lines.en: And how was your day, Susan?
I see you're in a good mood.

lines.en: Michelle knows all about it. Michelle
Michelle and I have all kinds of feelings Michelle about leaving New York, the family, and friends.

当然是 Stewart 一家人。

lines.cn: 嗯，也许她会，也许她不会，

lines.en: Ping-Pong tables, soda machines, and lots of music.
lines.cn: 乒乓球桌、汽水自动售货机，还有吵闹的音乐。

lines.en: It's too noisy for some older people like Nat.
lines.cn: 它对于像 Nat 这样的老人来说太吵了。
我从来没有意识到这点。

lines.en: It's hard for some older people to take all that noise.
lines.cn: 一些老年人没法忍受那些噪音。

lines.en: That's why the new community center is a good idea.
lines.cn: 这就是为什么新的社区中心是个好主意。

lines.en: Part of the building for older people, part of the building for younger people.
lines.cn: 一部分场地给老年人，另一部分给年轻人。

lines.en: She's coming over this morning to help me with my math.
lines.cn: 她今天早晨要过来帮我补习数学。

lines.en: Do you want something cold to drink?
I really appreciate you coming over to help me with my math.
lines.cn: 我真的很感谢你过来帮我补数学。

lines.en: My final exam is next Tuesday.
You're so good in all your other subjects.
I just can't understand why you have so many problems with math.
lines.cn: 我就是不明白，你为什么在数学上遇到这么多困难。

lines.en: I thought that was Nat Baker who rang the front doorbell.
lines.cn: 我还以为是 Nat Baker 按大门门铃呢。

lines.en: We're just having some cola before getting to the tough stuff--math.
lines.cn: 我们只是先喝点可乐，再对付难缠的数学。

lines.en: He'll do anything to avoid getting down to math lessons, Mr. Stewart. Stewart
lines.cn: Stewart 先生，他为了逃避数学，什么办法都想得出来。

lines.en: I wasn't good at it, and I didn't like studying it.
lines.cn: 我不精于此道，也不爱去学它。

lines.en: But you had to be good at math.
I was. But not in high school.
For some reason, I couldn't get a handle on it.
lines.cn: 因为某些原因，我就是开不了窍。

lines.en: Then, in college, I became good at it.
lines.cn: 然后，在大学，我变得很精于数学。
看来 Robbie 还有希望。

lines.en: You think I can just skip it now and get to it at college?
lines.cn: 你想我现在略过数学，等到上了大学再学，可以吗？

lines.en: You'll never get to college to find out, Robbie, if you skip it now.
lines.cn: Robbie，如果你现在跳过数学，就根本进不了大学去验证这个想法。

lines.en: Sit down, Robbie. Let's get to work.
lines.cn: 坐下来 Robbie 让我们开始做功课吧。

lines.en: I'd like you to meet my friend Nat Baker.
lines.cn: 我来向你们介绍我的朋友 Nat Baker。

lines.en: This is Alexandra Pappas, and this is my grandson Robbie, whom I think you've met once or twice before.
lines.cn: 这是 Alexandra Pappas，这是我孙子 Robbie，我想你以前见过他一两次。

lines.en: Nice to meet you, Mr. Baker.
lines.cn: 很高兴见到你 Baker 先生。

lines.en: Hi, Mr. Baker. We met before.
lines.cn: 嗨 Baker 先生，我们以前见过面。

lines.en: In town. At the hardware store.
Don't let us keep you from your math tutoring, Robbie.
lines.cn: 别让我们打扰你的数学家教 Robbie。

lines.en: I know you want to get to it.

lines.cn: 再待一会儿…… 再一会儿。

lines.en: I told you. He'll use any excuse to avoid math.
lines.cn: 我说嘛，他就是找各种借口来逃避数学。

lines.en: Did you read the story in the paper, Malcolm?
lines.cn: 你看到报纸上的新闻了吗 Malcolm？

lines.en: It's a serious matter for a lot of us.
lines.cn: 对我们许多人来讲，这可是个严重的问题。

lines.en: It is. Come on out to the patio.
lines.cn: 的确如此。请到院子来吧。

lines.en: We'll talk about it out there.
Thanks. Nice to meet you ... again.
Come on! You'll hear about it.
We get our friends to roll their sleeves up and get to work.
lines.cn: 我们召集我们的朋友挽起袖子来做。

lines.en: If I could take a look at the place, I could probably tell what it requires to fix it up.
lines.cn: 如果能去那里看看，我大概就能判断修缮它需要什么。

lines.en: How much paint, how many hours of work ...
lines.cn: 多少油漆，多少小时的工作量……

lines.en: That's what I came to ask you to do, Malcolm.
lines.cn: 这正是我来请你做的 Malcolm。

lines.en: If you would supervise the refurbishing, I'll find the people to help do it.
lines.cn: 如果你来监督翻新，我就找人来帮忙。
我也要帮忙 Baker 先生。

lines.en: I can get some of my friends to go around the neighborhood and collect the furniture we need.
lines.cn: 我可以找些朋友走访附近住户，募集我们需要的家具。

lines.en: Tomorrow. Yes. We'll meet tomorrow morning, right here.
lines.cn: 明天。对我们明天早晨会面就在这儿。

lines.en: We might need you to come through with your friends, Robbie.
lines.cn: 我们也许需要你们多邀朋友来帮忙 Robbie。

lines.en: Not just to go around the neighborhood asking for furniture, but to help with the paint job.
lines.cn: 不只是去附近募集家具，还要帮忙粉刷。

lines.en: That's backbreaking work and may be too much for us.
lines.cn: 这可是累人的活，我们可能负荷不了。

lines.en: I'll do it. I'll talk to them.
lines.cn: 我来做，我去跟他们谈一谈。

lines.en: And tomorrow morning we'll all meet here to discuss the plan?
lines.cn: 是不是明天早上我们都聚到这来讨论整修计划？

lines.en: Come in, come in. Please, come in.
I'd like you to meet my friend Malcolm Stewart.
lines.cn: 我来为你介绍朋友 Malcolm Stewart。

lines.en: Malcolm, this is Joanne Thompson. Malcolm
Hello, Joanne. Nice to meet you.
And this is Abe Lucas. You must remember Abe.
lines.cn: 这是 Abe Lucas。你一定记得 Abe。

lines.en: He ran the drugstore and used to play drums with the jazz band on weekends.
lines.cn: 他以前经营药房，周末还常在爵士乐队里打鼓。

lines.en: Oh, sure I do. Hi, Abe.
Sit down, sit down. Have some coffee.
And I've got some delicious Danish pastry for you.
lines.cn: 我为你们准备了一些可口的丹麦点心。

lines.en: Where's your grandson Robbie and his friend Alexandra?
lines.cn: 你的孙子 Robbie 和他的朋友 Alexandra 呢？

lines.en: Weren't they going to be here this morning?
lines.cn: 他们不是今天早上要来这儿吗？

lines.en: Robbie left early this morning to meet Alexandra. Robbie
lines.cn: Robbie 早上很早出去接 Alexandra。

lines.en: Frankly, I thought they'd be here, but ...
lines.cn: 老实说，我原以为他们会在这儿，但……

lines.en: It's OK. I'm sure they meant well,
but they probably had other things on their minds.
lines.cn: 我相信他们是好意，但可能还有别的事要忙。

lines.en: I understand you used to be in the construction business, Malcolm. Malcolm。
lines.cn: 听说你以前从事建筑业，Malcolm。

lines.en: I wonder if you would take a look at the old library and make sure that it is in good condition so that we don't have to worry about any structural problems.
lines.cn: 不知道你能否去看看旧图书馆，确认它状况良好，这样我们就不用担心建筑结构的问题。

lines.en: When can I do that? I'd be happy to.
lines.cn: 我什么时候可以去看，我很乐意做这项工作。

lines.en: We've got permission to go inside the old building during the week-- Tuesday or Wednesday.
lines.cn: 我们已经获准在这周的星期二或星期三进入那栋旧建筑。

lines.en: That's fine with me. I can do it either day.
lines.cn: 对我来说时间都适合。两天，哪一天我都可以。

lines.en: I think the building just needs a good cleaning.
lines.cn: 我想那座建筑，只需要好好地打扫一下。

lines.en: Then we have to furnish it.
lines.cn: 然后我们还得添置家具。

lines.en: I wish Robbie and Alexandra had come to this meeting.
lines.cn: 我真希望 Robbie 和 Alexandra 已经来参加开会。

lines.en: They had some ideas about getting the place fixed up.
lines.cn: 他们对于怎么修复这个地方有些构想。

lines.en: Perhaps they'll show up. In the meantime,
let me give you some additional thoughts and ideas I have.
lines.cn: 趁这时候，让我再提些想法。

lines.en: As I said, mostly the building just needs a good cleaning.
lines.cn: 就像我先前所说这栋建筑物大部份仅需要好好打扫一下。

lines.en: This place can be developed with one real intergenerational program.
lines.cn: 我们可以在这里开展一项真正让不同年龄层共同参与的活动。

lines.en: A community center with the kinds of programs that fit everyone.
lines.cn: 让这个社区中心有适合每个人的各类活动。

lines.en: And programs that don't leave anyone out.
lines.cn: 而且是些不排除任何人的活动。

lines.en: But we can't do it without talking to the young people.
lines.cn: 但我们不能不先和年轻人谈谈就动手做。

lines.en: If only Robbie and Alexandra were here.
lines.cn: 要是 Robbie 和 Alexandra 在这儿多好。

lines.en: We'll have a chance to talk to them later.
lines.cn: 我们以后还有机会跟他们谈。
这不像是 Robbie 的作为。

lines.en: If he says he's going to be here, he's here.
lines.cn: 假如他说他要到这儿，他就一定会来。

lines.en: I wonder what the problem is.
lines.cn: 我不知道发生了什么问题。
嗨，各位好。抱歉我迟到了。

lines.en: But Alexandra and I have been busy at work this morning on the community-center project.
lines.cn: 不过，我和 Alexandra 今天一早一直在忙社区中心的项目。

lines.en: And we brought someone along who can help.
lines.cn: 而且我们带来可以帮助我们的人。
你记得 Charles Maxwell 吗，爷爷？

lines.en: He's the editor of the Riverdale paper.
lines.cn: 他是 Riverdale 报的编辑。

lines.en: He wrote some nice articles on Mom when she was running for the school board.
lines.cn: 妈妈竞选校董会时，他写过几篇介绍她的好文章。

lines.en: Yes, I remember. You were a great help.
lines.cn: 是的，我记得，你帮了个大忙。

lines.en: Hope to be a bigger help on the new community-center project.
lines.cn: 希望能在新社区中心这件事上提供更大的帮助。

lines.en: From what Robbie and Alexandra have told me, you people are making one big story.
lines.cn: 照 Robbie 和 Alexandra 告诉我的情况看，你们正在做一件值得大篇幅报道的事。

lines.en: Let me introduce you, Mr. Maxwell.
lines.cn: 让我给你介绍一下 Maxwell 先生。

lines.en: This is Nat Baker, who's responsible for this meeting, and this is Joanne Thompson--and Abe Lucas, who used to run the drugstore in town.
lines.cn: 这是负责本次会议的 Nat Baker，这是 Joanne Thompson，还有以前在镇上开药房的 Abe Lucas。

lines.en: Robbie and Alexandra told me Robbie what you need to fix up the old library.
lines.cn: Robbie 和 Alexandra 告诉了我，你们修缮旧图书馆需要什么。

lines.en: I am planning to write an editorial that I think will help you.
lines.cn: 我计划写一篇社论，我认为应该能帮助你们。

lines.en: Let's go. What are your questions?
lines.cn: 那就开始吧。你想问什么？

lines.en: OK. Now, I have ... first ... a couple of questions here.
Have you talked to the community council?
lines.cn: 你们跟社区的委员会谈过了吗？

lines.en: And have you had an engineer come in to do an inspection?
lines.cn: 你们可有一个工程师来做过检查吗？

lines.en: OK, what do you need most of all?
lines.cn: 好，你们最需要的是什么？

lines.en: Men and women, young and old, to give us their time.
lines.cn: 不管男女老幼，请他们贡献时间。

lines.en: To help scrub the building interior clean.
lines.cn: 帮忙把建筑内部擦洗干净。

lines.en: So that we can repaint it.
lines.cn: 好让我们可以重新粉刷。

lines.en: And you also need bodies to do repainting?
lines.cn: 你们也需要人手来重新粉刷吗？

lines.en: And we'll also need some ladders and some brushes and some paint.
lines.cn: 我们还需要一些梯子、刷子和油漆。

lines.en: When do you need the volunteers, and where do they report?
lines.cn: 你们什么时候需要志愿者？他们到哪里报到？

lines.en: I've got the council to agree to open the building for us on the next four weekends.
lines.cn: 我已经说服议会，在接下来的四个周末向我们开放那栋建筑。

lines.en: Are there any special requirements that I should list in the paper?
lines.cn: 有什么特别的要求要我列在报纸上的？

lines.en: Here is a copy of all the things we need to start with.
lines.cn: 这是我们一开始需要的所有东西的清单。

lines.en: Eight straight-back chairs. Thirty folding chairs.
lines.cn: 八张直背椅。三十张折椅。

lines.en: Six table lamps. Three end tables. One piano.
lines.cn: 六盏台灯、三张边桌、一架钢琴。

lines.en: These items shouldn't be difficult to come by once I print the article in the paper.
lines.cn: 等文章登报后，这些物品应该不难募集到。

lines.en: This community has always been very generous.
lines.cn: 这个社区一向是非常慷慨的。
我有同感 Maxwell 先生。

lines.en: What you're saying is, in order for this center to succeed, we need to put together volunteers from the various generations of future users.
lines.cn: 你的意思是，为了让这个中心成功，我们得从未来使用这里的各个年龄层中召集志愿者。

lines.en: And without their energy and stamina, there's no way we can complete this project.
lines.cn: 没有他们的精力和耐力，我们不可能完成这个项目。

lines.en: I've got it. Now give me some information about
how you see the building being used.
lines.cn: 现在请告诉我，你们打算怎样使用这栋建筑。

lines.en: Oh, here. On the ground floor we have the reception area ...
lines.cn: 噢，看这个。在一层我们会有一个接待区……

lines.en: Charles Maxwell lived up to his word. Charles Maxweell
lines.cn: Charles Maxwell 兑现了他的诺言。

lines.en: "At the Stewart family home on Linden Street yesterday, “ a group of caring Riverdale citizens gathered to plan the refurbishing of the old library to transform it into a new community center.
lines.cn: “昨天，一群热心的 Riverdale 居民在 Linden 街的 Stewart 家聚会，商讨翻修旧图书馆，把它改造成新的社区中心。

lines.en: The original plan by the council was tabled because of lack of funds.
lines.cn: 议会原来的计划因缺乏资金而被搁置。
这项新计划需要你的协助。

lines.en: You could call it a community unity plan.
lines.cn: 你可以称它为社区团结计划。

lines.en: It needs your time, and it needs your energy.
lines.cn: 它需要你的时间，需要你的力气。

lines.en: And it needs your contributions of furniture, paint, brushes, ladders, lamps, et cetera.
lines.cn: 它还需要你们捐赠家具、油漆、刷子、梯子、灯具等物品。

lines.en: A list of these items and a volunteer form can be picked up at the Riverdale Press offices.
lines.cn: 物品清单及志愿者报名表，可到 Riverdale Press 的办事处领取。

lines.en: By working together, this community can do anything to benefit its citizens, and we know you will all work together towards refurbishing the old library and making it a new community center.
lines.cn: 只要大家携手合作，这个社区就能办成任何造福居民的事。我们相信，大家会一起翻修旧图书馆，让它成为新的社区中心。
你今天从学校回来得这么早。

lines.en: Yeah, they're getting the assembly hall ready for the graduation ceremony, so we all got to go home early.
lines.cn: 是啊，学校正在布置礼堂，为毕业典礼做准备，所以我们都能提前回家。

lines.en: Well, now that you're here, you can help me with dinner.
lines.cn: 既然你回来了，就帮我准备晚饭吧。

lines.en: I need those potatoes peeled and sliced.
lines.cn: 那些马铃薯需要剥皮和切片。

lines.en: Alexandra's coming over to help me study for my math final Alexandra
lines.cn: Alexandra 要来帮我复习数学，准备期末考试。

lines.en: Well, in that case, you can wash the dishes and clean up after dinner.
lines.cn: 那样的话，你就晚饭后洗盘子、收拾一下吧。

lines.en: Can I invite Alexandra to stay for dinner?
lines.cn: 我可以请 Alexandra 留下来吃晚餐？

lines.en: You and Alexandra have become good friends, haven't you?
lines.cn: 你和 Alexandra 成了好朋友，不是吗？

lines.en: I'm going to miss her when she goes back to Greece.
lines.cn: 我会想念她，她回去希腊时。

lines.en: Would you like to give her a little farewell party?
lines.cn: 你要不要为她举行一次告别派对？

lines.en: Maybe we could make it a surprise.
lines.cn: 也许我们可以让它变成一个惊喜。

lines.en: Surprise parties don't always work out.
lines.cn: 惊喜派对，不是每次都成功的。

lines.en: Well, we could tell her it's a graduation party for me.
lines.cn: 我们可以告诉她，这是为我办的毕业聚会。

lines.en: When Alexandra arrives, we'll surprise her.
lines.cn: 等 Alexandra 到达时，我们再让她惊喜一下。

lines.en: Well, I suppose that might work.
lines.cn: 嗯，我想这样或许可以奏效。

lines.en: I'd like to give her a nice going-away present.
lines.cn: 我很想送给她一件好的离别礼物。

lines.en: I should have saved some money.
I'm sure Alexandra would be happy with something simple, Robbie.
lines.cn: Robbie，我相信送点简单的东西，Alexandra 就会很高兴。

lines.en: But, well, I'd like to give her something nice to remember me by.
lines.cn: 但我想送她一件好礼物，让她看见它就能想起我。

lines.en: Maybe I could borrow some money from you and Dad.
lines.cn: 也许我可以向你和爸爸借点钱。

lines.en: It's all right with me if it's all right with your dad.
lines.cn: 我没有问题，假如你爸爸答应的话。

lines.en: Is he still in his office?
Here are the X-rays you wanted, Dr. Stewart.
lines.cn: 这是你要的 X 光片 Stewart 医师。

lines.en: I don't see any breaks or fractures.
lines.cn: 我看不出有任何破裂或骨折。

lines.en: Hi, Dad. Am I interrupting you?
Well, that's what fathers are for.
lines.cn: 嗯，父亲们的功用正在于此。

lines.en: Well, before I go to college, I have the whole summer ...
lines.cn: 我上大学之前，还有一整个暑假……

lines.en: And I'm planning to get a job for the summer.
I applied for a job as a lifeguard at the community pool.
lines.cn: 我申请了社区游泳池的救生员工作。

lines.en: Yes. I'll be earning pretty good money if I get it.
lines.cn: 是的。若我得到这份工作的话，我可以赚不少钱。

lines.en: But right now, I'm kind of short of cash.
And my friend Alexandra is going back to Greece ...
lines.cn: 我的朋友 Alexandra 就要回希腊去了……

lines.en: Mom says we can give her a going-away surprise party.
lines.cn: 妈妈说我们可以给她举行一个让她惊喜的欢送派对。

lines.en: And I'd like to get her a nice gift ...
lines.cn: 我还想给她一份精致的礼物……

lines.en: Well, a wristwatch, so she'll think of me when she looks at the time.
lines.cn: 一块手表，这样她看时间时就会想起我。

lines.en: Well, I saw a nice watch.
lines.cn: 嗯，我已看中了一个手表。

lines.en: If you could lend me the money, I could pay you back out of my lifeguard salary.
lines.cn: 如果你能借我这笔钱，我可以用当救生员的工资还你。

lines.en: Well, I guess your mother and I can manage it.
lines.cn: 嗯，我想你妈和我可以设法帮这个忙。

lines.en: When do you need the money?
You'll probably want the family car so you can drive her home after the party.
lines.cn: 你可能还想用家里的车，聚会后开车送她回家。
我会小心的。谢谢你，爸爸。

lines.en: You're not so bad yourself, Son.
You ready for the next problem?
lines.cn: 你准备好做下一道题了吗？

lines.en: I can't look at another number.
lines.cn: 我简直一个数字也看不进去了。
休息一下喝点柠檬水好吗？

lines.en: Oh, by the way, when is your plane reservation for your flight to Athens?
lines.cn: 顺便问一下，你订的飞往雅典的航班是什么时候？

lines.en: Would you be able to come over Saturday night?
lines.cn: 星期六晚上你能过来吗？

lines.en: I should be finished packing by then.
lines.cn: 到那时候我应该已经整理好行李了。

lines.en: My folks are giving me a little graduation party.
lines.cn: 我父母要为我办个小型毕业聚会。

lines.en: My dad's letting me borrow the car.
Oh, well, that would be very nice.
Just my friend Mike and a few kids from school.
lines.cn: 只有我的朋友 Mike 和学校几个家伙。

lines.en: I'm going to miss all of you.
You've been like a second family to me.
lines.cn: 你们就像我的第二个家一样。

lines.en: Maybe you could come to visit me in Greece?
lines.cn: 也许你可以到希腊来看我？

lines.en: Are you excited about graduating from high school?
lines.cn: 你从高中毕业会不会感到很兴奋呢？

lines.en: I was when I first came to the United States.
lines.cn: 当我刚到美国来的时候，是感到有点紧张。

lines.en: I'd never been away from home, and I didn't know what it would be like.
lines.cn: 我从没离开过家，也不知道会是什么样。

lines.en: But then I found out that people are the same everywhere once you get to know them.
lines.cn: 但后来我发现，一旦彼此熟悉，就会知道哪里的人都一样。

lines.en: I'm glad I got to know you.
I'm glad I got to know you--and your family.
lines.cn: 我也很高兴能够认识你和你的一家人。

lines.en: Wouldn't it be nice if we could skip the examinations and get right to the graduation party?
lines.cn: 要是能跳过考试，直接参加毕业聚会，那该多好啊？

lines.en: But that isn't the way it works.
Yes. The Molinas are waiting for me.
lines.cn: 不会。Molina 一家人在等着我呢。

lines.en: I'll pick you up on Saturday night, OK?
lines.cn: 我星期六晚上去接你，好吗？

lines.en: She's really a good friend, isn't she?
lines.cn: 她真是个好朋友，不是吗？

lines.en: You are going to miss her.
Am I going to miss her?
You are going to miss her!
I'm going to miss her, and my math teacher's going to miss her.
lines.cn: 我会想念她，我的数学老师也会想念她。

lines.en: Well, you can write to her.
You're sure Alexandra's going to be surprised?
lines.cn: 你确定 Alexandra 会很惊讶？

lines.en: She has no idea that the party is in her honor.
lines.cn: 她不知道这个派对是给她办的。

lines.en: Millie, did you bring the tapes for dancing? Millie
lines.cn: Millie，你带跳舞用的录音带了吗？
太好了 Alexandra 会喜欢！

lines.en: I can't wait to see her face when she walks in here tonight.
lines.cn: 我迫不及待想看到她走进来时脸上的表情。

lines.en: My mom's decorating it right now.
Robbie, there's a phone call for you. Robbie
No, let's wait till Robbie gets back from the airport.
lines.cn: 不要。我们等 Robbie 从机场回来吧。

lines.en: Did she say why she had to leave today?
lines.cn: 她说了她为什么今天非走不可吗？

lines.en: She told Robbie that her flight tomorrow was canceled, so she had to take an earlier flight today.
lines.cn: 她告诉 Robbie，明天的航班取消了，所以她必须改乘今天较早的航班。

lines.en: Why is he blowing his horn like that?
lines.cn: 为什么他这样子按喇叭？

lines.en: Do you think we should take down the decorations?
lines.cn: 你觉得我们应当取掉这些装饰品吗？

lines.en: We should have done it sooner.
Especially when Alexandra gave me a surprise ...
lines.cn: 特别是 Alexandra 给了我一个惊喜……

lines.en: I called my parents from the airport.
lines.cn: 我从机场打电话给我父母。

lines.en: When I told them my friends were giving me a party, they insisted that I stay.
lines.cn: 我告诉他们，朋友们正在为我办聚会，他们就坚持让我留下来。

lines.en: So now I'm taking a flight on Monday instead.
lines.cn: 所以我现在要改搭星期一的班机走。

lines.en: But how did you know the party was for you?
lines.cn: 但是你怎么知道派对是为你举办的呢？

lines.en: Well, Robbie told me when he gave me this.
lines.cn: 嗯，当 Robbie 送给我这个的时候，他告诉了我。

lines.en: Now we can really start the party!
lines.cn: 现在我们可以真正开始舞会了！

lines.en: I'd like to say something first.
I would just like to thank all of you, my friends, who have made my stay in the United States so wonderful.
lines.cn: 我想感谢你们所有人，我的朋友们，是你们让我的美国之行如此美好。

lines.en: And to Robbie and the Stewart family for opening their home to me.
lines.cn: 也感谢 Robbie 和 Stewart 一家热情地接纳我。

lines.en: And I also have a little surprise for you, Robbie.
lines.cn: 我也有一个小小的惊喜给你 Robbie。

lines.en: I think you might be amused.
lines.cn: 我想你可能会觉得有意思。

lines.en: I guess we were thinking the same thought.
I knew we thought alike, but this is too much!
lines.cn: 我知道我们想法相似，可这也太巧了！

lines.en: Mrs. Stewart, may I have this dance? Stewart
lines.cn: Stewart 太太，我可以请你跳这支舞？

lines.en: Hot dogs. I love hot dogs.
There is nothing better than a hot dog in the country.
lines.cn: 在乡下，没有比吃热狗更棒的了。

lines.en: Cooked outdoors over an open fire.
I wish I had one now.
lines.cn: 我真希望现在就来一个。

lines.en: Do you remember when Daddy and I used to take you and Susan and Robbie to Jones Beach? Susan Roobbie
lines.cn: 你还记得，爸爸和我以前常带你、Susan 和 Robbie 去 Jones 海滩吗？

lines.en: We'd wait until dark and make a fire, and we'd cook the hot dogs.
lines.cn: 我们等到天黑，生起火，再烤热狗。

lines.en: And, oh, does anybody want ketchup?
I might as well take it along.
And now to make sure we've got the hamburger patties.
lines.cn: 再来，务必要带汉堡碎肉饼。

lines.en: I have to remember to put them in the bag tomorrow morning before we leave.
lines.cn: 我得记住明早出发前把它们放进袋子里。

lines.en: Mom, we really appreciate your taking care of Max for the weekend and giving up your free time.
lines.cn: 妈，真谢谢你放弃自己的休息时间，周末帮我们照顾 Max。

lines.en: Susan and Harry have a sitter for Michelle in the city, Susan and I'm taking care of Max.
lines.cn: Susan 和 Harry 在城里给 Michelle 请了保姆，我就来照顾 Max。

lines.en: I am happy to do it for you.
lines.cn: 我很高兴为你们做这件事。

lines.en: I guess Max is asleep by now.
lines.cn: 我想 Max 现在已经睡觉了。
噢，可怜的宝贝。他正在长牙齿。

lines.en: I feel so bad for him.
It hurts so much when a baby gets his first teeth.
lines.cn: 小孩子长的第一颗牙齿时好痛哟。

lines.en: Well, he wakes up several times during the night, and the pain is so bad.
lines.cn: 他夜里要醒好几次，疼得很厉害。

lines.en: I'm really concerned about going away for the weekend, Ellen, and leaving you with the full responsibility of taking care of Max.
lines.cn: Ellen，周末出门，把照顾 Max 的责任全交给你，我实在有些不放心。
特别是他现在在开始长牙。
我真希望他现在好一点。
别忘了，你公公是位儿科医生。

lines.en: We have a live-in doctor if there's a problem I can't handle.
lines.cn: 假如我遇到不能解决的问题，我们还有位驻家医生。

lines.en: We really don't have to be overly concerned.
lines.cn: 我们真的不需要过分担心。

lines.en: I'll go upstairs and stay with him until he falls asleep again.
lines.cn: 我上楼去陪他直到他又睡着。

lines.en: Try putting him across your lap on his stomach.
lines.cn: 试着让他趴在你的大腿上。

lines.en: When are Susan and Harry picking you up, Marilyn? Susan
lines.cn: Susan 和 Harry 什么时候来接你们 Marilyn？

lines.en: They're coming by at six tomorrow morning, so we can get an early start.
lines.cn: 他们明早六点过来，这样我们就能早点出发。

lines.en: And you'll have a full day in the country.
lines.cn: 你们就可以在乡下待一整天啦。

lines.en: Tomorrow night we'll be camping out in tents.
lines.cn: 明晚我们要在帐篷里露营。

lines.en: We'll be heading back late in the afternoon.
lines.cn: 我们会在黄昏时打道回府。

lines.en: You're going to have the time of your lives.
lines.cn: 你们将会玩得非常痛快。

lines.en: Camping out is such great fun.
lines.cn: 露营是件非常好玩的事。

lines.en: We'll have a great time camping out, I'm sure.
lines.cn: 我确定我们会在露营时玩得很开心。

lines.en: But I'm still a little worried about you, Ellen.
lines.cn: 不过我还是有点担心你，Ellen。

lines.en: It will be my great pleasure, Marilyn.
I think he'll sleep through the night now.
lines.cn: 我想他现在会睡到天亮。

lines.en: I hope he's good when we're away.
lines.cn: 我希望我们不在时，他很乖。

lines.en: Now, to check the list of things we need for the camping trip.
lines.cn: 现在，让我们检查一下露营旅行所需物品的清单吧。

lines.en: We need to bring a flashlight.
lines.cn: 我们需要带一个手电筒。

lines.en: It's in the right-hand drawer, next to the bottle openers.
lines.cn: 在右边的抽屉就在开瓶器旁边。

lines.en: Do we have a bottle opener on the list, Marilyn?
lines.cn: 清单上有开瓶器吗 Marilyn？

lines.en: Is that one of the things Susan and Harry are bringing?
lines.cn: 那是 Susan 和 Harry 要带的东西之一吗？

lines.en: And we're bringing the ketchup, mustard, relish--all that stuff.
lines.cn: 我们还要带番茄酱、芥末酱、酸黄瓜调味酱——这些东西。

lines.en: Well, here's the bottle opener, and here's the flashlight.
lines.cn: 哦，这是开瓶器，这是手电筒。

lines.en: For when we build our campfire.
I can't build a fire by rubbing two pieces of wood together.
lines.cn: 我总不能靠着磨擦两片木柴来取火吧。

lines.en: And don't forget your camera and film, Richard.
lines.cn: 别忘了你的照相机和底片 Richard。

lines.en: And let's not forget our cassette player and some tapes.
lines.cn: 还别忘了带上我们的卡式录音机和一些录音带。

lines.en: Some music tapes and some blank tapes so that we can record our thoughts about the trip.
lines.cn: 带些音乐带和空白带，这样就能录下我们对旅途的感想。

lines.en: The cassette player and the tapes.
To be away from the city on such a beautiful day is my idea of heaven!
lines.cn: 在这么美好的一天远离城市，这就是我心目中的天堂！

lines.en: The grass. The trees. The fresh air.
I told you you'd like it. I've been doing this for years.
lines.cn: 我告诉过你会喜欢的。我多年来一直从事这项活动。

lines.en: You have the spirit of a teenager, Susan.
Wait till you see yourself jumping around.
lines.cn: 等着看你自己活蹦乱跳的样子吧。

lines.en: That's what I love about Susan.
lines.cn: 这就是我爱 Susan 的一点。
她是一个真正的 Stewart 家人。

lines.en: Help me get this stuff out of the car.
lines.cn: 帮我将这些东西拿下车子。

lines.en: Well, we'll put everything over there.
lines.cn: 嗯，我们把所有的东西都放在那边。

lines.en: We'll set up our tents over there by the edge of the woods.
lines.cn: 我们就在那边树林边缘搭帐篷。

lines.en: Then we'll be able to make our fire there where it's safe.
lines.cn: 然后我们就可以在那儿找一个安全的地方生火了。

lines.en: Oh, there's our table and benches.
lines.cn: 哦，那是我们的桌子和长板凳。

lines.en: That's what makes this spot so good.
lines.cn: 那就是为什么这个地点这样好的道理。

lines.en: When you're out in the fresh air like this, it makes you hungry.
lines.cn: 来到户外，呼吸这样新鲜的空气，就容易饿。

lines.en: You guys are like three kids.
lines.cn: 你们三个就像孩子一样。

lines.en: Now that you mention it, I guess I am.
lines.cn: 你们一提到它，我想我也饿了。

lines.en: I mean, how could a guy not be hungry with all this talk about eating?
lines.cn: 我是说，大家都在谈吃的，一个人怎么可能不饿呢？

lines.en: Where's the bag with the chicken salad sandwiches?
lines.cn: 装鸡肉沙拉三明治的袋子在哪儿？

lines.en: Right here, next to the ice packs. Here.
lines.cn: 就在这，在冰袋旁边。这儿。

lines.en: Put the tablecloth on the picnic table, and I will bring the cola and the plastic cups.
lines.cn: 你把桌布铺在野餐桌上，我来拿可乐和塑料杯。

lines.en: Well, how do you like it so far?
lines.cn: 好了，到现在为止，你们感觉怎么样？
我从来没像这样轻松过。

lines.en: I wish we had brought Michelle, Harry.
lines.cn: 我真希望我们带了 Michelle 来 Harry。

lines.en: I wish we had brought Max.
lines.cn: 我也希望带上 Max 来。

lines.en: Marilyn, Susan, let's not begin to worry about Michelle and Max. Marilyn Susan
lines.cn: Marilyn，Susan，别又开始担心 Michelle 和 Max 了。

lines.en: We're having a good time, and they're in good hands.
lines.cn: 我们玩得很好，他们也得到很好的照顾。

lines.en: Are you having a good time, Susan?

lines.cn: 你还没有回答我的问题呢。

lines.en: I am having a good time, Harry.
I promise not to think about the city.
lines.cn: 我保证不再去想城里的事。

lines.en: Let's all just enjoy this wonderful place and this wonderful weather.
lines.cn: 我们就好好享受这个美丽的地方和这么好的天气吧。

lines.en: It was such a great idea to spend the weekend this way.
lines.cn: 这样过周末的主意简直太棒了。

lines.en: I thought you'd all like it.
lines.cn: 我料想你们都会喜欢的。

lines.en: Listen to the sounds of the summer that surround us.
lines.cn: 仔细倾听环绕我们的夏夜声息。

lines.en: Away from the telephones and account books.

lines.cn: 这是我提高精神的方法。

lines.en: I always go back to the city in a wonderful state of mind.
lines.cn: 我再回到城市时，精神总是十分饱满。

lines.en: We've only been here for a day, and I've completely forgotten about all my business problems.
lines.cn: 我们才来一天，我就已经把所有工作上的烦恼忘得一干二净了。

lines.en: The office seems so far away.
lines.cn: 办公室好像变得那么遥远。

lines.en: I'm glad you like it, Susan.
lines.cn: 我很高兴你喜欢它 Susan。

lines.en: We'll spend many more weekends like this.
lines.cn: 我们以后可以多度几次这样的周末。

lines.en: And next time we'll bring Michelle.
lines.cn: 下次我们带 Michelle 来。

lines.en: I wish she were here with us to enjoy the country.
lines.cn: 我真希望现在她就和我们在一起享受这乡村美景。

lines.en: And next time we'll bring Michelle.
lines.cn: 下次我们带上 Michelle 来。

lines.en: I can hardly keep my eyes open.
If only we could bottle the fresh air.
lines.cn: 要是我们用瓶子将新鲜空气装回去多好。
那样岂不是太美妙了吗？

lines.en: We could call it "Deep Sleep Country Air."
lines.cn: 我们可以称它为沉睡的乡村空气。

lines.en: I've been having a hard time keeping my eyes open just listening to it.
lines.cn: 光听着这些声音，我就快睁不开眼了。
它就像是一种特别的音乐。

lines.en: Too bad we can't bottle the sound.
lines.cn: 不能将声音装瓶真是太可惜了。

lines.en: I'm so glad everyone is asleep.
I thought Max would be crying, and everybody would be awake.
lines.cn: 我还以为 Max 会哭个不停，让大家都睡不着。

lines.en: My mother knows all there is to know about taking care of babies, I assure you.
lines.cn: 我向你保证，照顾宝宝的事，我妈妈样样都懂。

lines.en: Let's put some of this stuff away and then take off.
lines.cn: 我们把这些东西先收好一部分，然后就走吧。

lines.en: We've got a forty-minute drive into the city.
lines.cn: 我们还要开四十分钟车到城里去。

lines.en: Welcome home-- and I do mean welcome home.
lines.cn: 欢迎回家——我是真心盼着你们回来。

lines.en: But his teeth hurt, and he just can't get to sleep, poor dear.
lines.cn: 但他的牙疼让他不能入睡，可怜的小宝贝。
你们的周末过得怎么样？

lines.en: We had a great time, Mom.
The weather couldn't have been better.
Did you get a chance to get outside at all?
lines.cn: 你有机会到外面走走吗？
昨天下午，祖父帮我的忙。

lines.en: I went to the supermarket to get a few things, and I stayed out an extra half hour.
lines.cn: 我去超市买了点东西，还额外在外面多待了半个小时。

lines.en: The village was filled with people--the weather was so nice.
lines.cn: 镇上挤满了人，天气好的缘故。

lines.en: Harry's a professional camper, Mom. Harry
He knows all there is to know, and he made the weekend very easy for us to enjoy.
lines.cn: 他样样都懂，让我们轻轻松松地享受了这个周末。
别这样说，你们都帮了忙。

lines.en: Why don't you go to your room, Mom, and get some sleep.
lines.cn: 妈，你回房间去睡一会儿吧？

lines.en: Tell me more about your weekend.
lines.cn: 多告诉我一点你们的周末。
你们做了什么特别的事情吗？
有许多特别的乡村趣事。

lines.en: And we brought some home for you.
lines.cn: 而且带了一些回来给你。

lines.en: It was so nice to be out in the country.
lines.cn: 出去置身乡下真是太好了。
所有东西闻起来都很特别。

lines.en: It would have been great if we had been able to bottle the smells.
lines.cn: 若我们能将气味装瓶该有多好。

lines.en: It would be a great business if you could do that.
lines.cn: 假如能做到那样的话，可是一笔大生意。
噢，我们现在到家了 Ellen。
让我们看看它是不是有效果。

lines.en: I think we'd better head home.
lines.cn: 我想我们最好上路回家啦。

lines.en: It's getting late, and we have a bit of a drive.
lines.cn: 已经晚了，而我们还要开好一段路呢。

lines.en: Well, all your things are inside.
lines.cn: 嗯，所有你们的东西都拿下来了。
替我向 Richard 说声再见。

lines.en: We'll call you all tomorrow night.
lines.cn: 我们明天晚上打电话给你们。

lines.en: I'm so tired I think I'm overtired.
lines.cn: 我好累，我想我是累过头了。

lines.en: I don't know if I can get to sleep.
lines.cn: 我不知道我能否睡得着。

lines.en: Oh. Oh, where did you get that?
The soothing sounds of the country.
A little further to the right, Tom.
Good. What do you think, Richard?
It's the first thing people will see when they come in.
lines.cn: 这是人们走进来所看到的第一件东西。

lines.en: It sets the tone for the whole show.
lines.cn: 它决定了整个展览的气氛。

lines.en: The next thing they'll see is this enlargement with the words Family Album, U.S.A. Family Album, U.S.A.
lines.cn: 他们接着会看到这张写着《美国写真集》的放大照片。

lines.en: I can't believe this is really happening!
lines.cn: 我不敢相信这一切真的发生！

lines.en: Years of work went into these pictures.
lines.cn: 多年心血换来这些照片。

lines.en: I know, but it's still a dream come true.
lines.cn: 我知道，但这终究是一个梦想实现了。

lines.en: Well, remember, we're not sure what the critics are going to write about your show yet.
lines.cn: 不过，别忘了，我们还不知道评论家会怎样评价你的展览。

lines.en: And you never know what the man from the New York Times is going to say about it.
lines.cn: 你也猜不到《纽约时报》的人会怎么说。

lines.en: The reviews of this show are important for the sales of your book.
lines.cn: 这次展览的评论，对你的书的销量很重要。

lines.en: When do we see the reviews?
lines.cn: 什么时候我们可以看到评论？

lines.en: One of the critics is coming over this morning for a preview.
lines.cn: 一位评论家今天早上要来看预展。

lines.en: I hope he's in a good mood.
Marilyn and I hope to use money from the sales of this book Marilyn to buy a new house.
lines.cn: 我和 Marilyn 希望用这本书的销售收入买栋新房子。

lines.en: The book will be a success.
And the show will help promote it.
lines.cn: 而这次展览会有利于促销它。

lines.en: Speaking of promoting the book, do I really have to autograph copies for the guests at the opening?
lines.cn: 说到宣传这本书，我真的得在开幕式上给来宾签书吗？

lines.en: A lot of people come to openings just so they can get the autograph of somebody who may be famous someday.
lines.cn: 很多人参加开幕式，就是为了拿到某个将来可能成名的人的签名。

lines.en: Couldn't we wait until I'm famous?
lines.cn: 难道不能等到我成名了再说？

lines.en: That might be sooner than you think.
lines.cn: 那也许比你想像的要快。

lines.en: This one over here, Mr. Carlson?
lines.cn: 这张就摆这儿吗 Carlson 先生？

lines.en: It's too close to the refreshments.
No, I think this one belongs in the "people-at-work" section.
lines.cn: 不我认为它属于工作中的人那一区。

lines.en: How many people will you be bringing?
My wife Marilyn, my father and mother, my brother Robbie, my sister and her husband and their daughter.
lines.cn: 我太太 Marilyn，我父母，我弟弟 Robbie，还有我妹妹、她丈夫和他们的女儿。

lines.en: No such thing as "too many" at an opening.
lines.cn: 展览开幕怎么会嫌人太多呢。

lines.en: They've stood by me through all this.
lines.cn: 他们一直支持我做这件事。

lines.en: Mitchell, so nice of you to come. Mitchell
Richard, this is Mitchell Johnson. Richard
Mitchell is one of the most important syndicated reviewers in the country.
lines.cn: Mitchell 是全国最重要的报业集团评论家之一。

lines.en: Well, you're the young man who did all this.
lines.cn: 嗯，你就是那位拍这些照片的年轻人。

lines.en: Nice to meet you, Mr. Johnson.
lines.cn: 很高兴见到你 Johnson 先生。

lines.en: Mitchell has always encouraged new talent. Mitchell
Well ... you mind if I look around and see what it says to me?
lines.cn: 你们不介意我四处看看，感受一下这些作品吧？

lines.en: What does that mean when he goes, "Mm-hmm, mm-hmm, mm-hmm"?
lines.cn: 他发出“嗯哼，嗯哼，嗯哼”的声音，是什么意思？

lines.en: It probably means he's clearing his throat.
lines.cn: 也许表示他正在清嗓子。

lines.en: I don't care what the critics say, Mr. Stewart.
lines.cn: 我不管评论家怎么说 Stewart 先生。

lines.en: Tom is studying photography at NYU. Tom
lines.cn: Tom 正在纽约大学学习摄影。

lines.en: He's working with me during the summer months as an intern.
lines.cn: 他在夏天的这几个月到我这来当实习生。

lines.en: I'd like to see your work.
lines.cn: 我希望能看到你的作品。

lines.en: It's not good enough to show.
Oh, I'd still like to see your work.
lines.cn: 噢，我仍然希望看到你的作品。

lines.en: You may be the next Ansel Adams and not even know it.
lines.cn: 你或许是第二个 Ansel Adams 而不自知呢。

lines.en: If you really mean it, I'll bring some of my pictures into the gallery.
lines.cn: 如果你是认真的，我就带一些照片到画廊来。
你的照片很有意思 Stewart 先生。

lines.en: You have a most unusual eye.
lines.cn: 你有着极为不寻常的眼光。

lines.en: Are you going to be reviewing the show, Mitchell?
lines.cn: 你会评论这项展览吗 Mitchell？

lines.en: Oh, yes. It's definitely worth reviewing.
lines.cn: 噢，是的。它着实值得评论。

lines.en: Oh, you know I never answer that question, Harvey.
lines.cn: 噢，你知道我从不回答这类的问题 Harvey。

lines.en: I'd like an advance copy of the book, though, so I can study it.
lines.cn: 不过，我想要一本新书样本，好仔细研究一下。

lines.en: I have an autographed one in my office.
lines.cn: 在我办公室，有一本签了名的。

lines.en: Tom, would you give Mr. Johnson Tom the copy of Richard's book on my desk?
lines.cn: Tom，请把我桌上那本 Richard 的书交给 Johnson 先生，好吗？
请跟我来 Johnson 先生。

lines.en: Do you think he liked my photographs?
lines.cn: 你觉得他喜欢我的摄影？

lines.en: We'll know when tonight's papers come out.
lines.cn: 今晚的报纸出来的时候，我们就知道了。

lines.en: We're supposed to be there before the guests arrive.
lines.cn: 我们应该在客人到达之前到场。

lines.en: Help me with this tie, will you?
But this is what you've been working for all these years.
lines.cn: 但你多年来的工作，为的就是这个呀。

lines.en: I worked to put together a book of photographs.
lines.cn: 我的工作是创作出一本摄影书。
而今天这个却是演艺事业。

lines.en: Well, it's all part of the same job.
lines.cn: 嗯，它们都是同一项工作的一部份。

lines.en: I earned this, and I'm going to enjoy it.
lines.cn: 我辛苦赢得的，我要去享受它。

lines.en: As soon as I recover from my nervous breakdown.
lines.cn: 只等我从神经崩溃中恢复过来。

lines.en: A critic was there this morning.
lines.cn: 一个评论家早上去过了。

lines.en: I have to sign copies of my book for a lot of people I never met before.
lines.cn: 我还得给许多从未见过的人签书。

lines.en: My new shoes hurt my feet ...
lines.cn: 我的新鞋弄痛了我的脚……

lines.en: You're going to be a great success.
lines.cn: 你会获得很大的成功的。

lines.en: As soon as I get these cuff links on.
Mom and Dad are already on their way down to the gallery.
lines.cn: 妈妈和爸爸已经出发去画廊了。
好了！你看起来很有魅力。

lines.en: Well, I suppose I've run out of excuses.
lines.cn: 看来我已经找不出借口了。

lines.en: Before we go to the gallery, I just want to tell you that I never could have done this book without your help and your love.
lines.cn: 去画廊之前，我想告诉你：没有你的帮助和爱，我绝不可能完成这本书。

lines.en: Your show doesn't begin until eight thirty.
lines.cn: 你的展览八点半才开始。

lines.en: Richard! Welcome! Good luck tonight! Richard
lines.cn: Richard 欢迎，祝你今天晚上好运！

lines.en: This is my publisher, Harvey Carlson.
lines.cn: 这是我的出版商 Harvey Carlson。
你曾经见过我太太 Marilyn……
很高兴见到你。很高兴见到你。

lines.en: This is my father, Dr. Philip Stewart ...
lines.cn: 这是我父亲 Philip Stewart 医生……

lines.en: Nice to meet you, Mr. Carlson.
lines.cn: 很高兴见到你 Carlson 先生。

lines.en: And this is my sister Susan and her husband Harry Bennett and his daughter Michelle.
lines.cn: 这是我妹妹 Susan、她丈夫 Harry Bennett，以及他的女儿 Michelle。

lines.en: And this gentleman is my grandfather, Malcolm Stewart.
lines.cn: 这位绅士是我祖父 Malcolm Stewart。

lines.en: There are hors d'oeuvres at the table, fruit punch at the bar.
lines.cn: 桌上有开胃小点，吧台有水果宾治。

lines.en: Can I get you something, Mr. Stewart?
lines.cn: 要我替你拿点什么吗 Stewart 先生？

lines.en: You can feel very proud of your grandson, Mr. Stewart.
lines.cn: Stewart 先生，你可以为你的孙子感到非常骄傲。

lines.en: I'm proud of all my grandchildren, Mr. Carlson.
lines.cn: 我为我所有的孙子孙女感到骄傲 Carlson 先生。

lines.en: If you need anything, just ask.
lines.cn: 假如你需要什么，尽管讲。

lines.en: Did Mitchell Johnson's review come out yet? Mitchell Johnsson
lines.cn: Mitchell Johnson 的评论出来了没有？

lines.en: The newspapers don't come out till about ten o'clock.
lines.cn: 报纸要差不多十点钟才出来。

lines.en: When they come out, we'll get it.
lines.cn: 一出来，我们就会拿到手。

lines.en: Tom's about to open the doors. Tom
"Richard Stewart's show at the Carlson Gallery "Richard Stewaart is a collection of photographs from his new book entitled Family Album, U.S.A.
lines.cn: “Richard Stewart 在 Carlson 画廊的展览，汇集了他的新书《美国写真集》中的照片。

lines.en: There is power and beauty in Mr. Stewart's work, Stewart and his book introduces us to a remarkable new talent."
lines.cn: Stewart 先生的作品展现了力量与美，他的书让我们认识了一位才华出众的新秀。”

lines.en: Ladies and gentlemen, if I may have your attention for a moment, please?
lines.cn: 女士们、先生们，请大家注意一下，好吗？

lines.en: I hope you're all enjoying the exhibition.
lines.cn: 我希望你们都喜欢这个展览。

lines.en: And I would like to introduce the young man who spent the last five years taking these remarkable pictures and writing the background for Family Album,U.S.A.-- Mr. Richard Stewart. Richard Stewarrt
lines.cn: 现在，我想介绍一位年轻人，他花了五年时间拍摄这些出色的照片，并为《美国写真集》撰写背景说明——Richard Stewart 先生。

lines.en: I want to thank all of you for coming here tonight.
lines.cn: 我非常感谢你们大家今天晚上的赏光。

lines.en: I'd like to thank Harvey Carlson for his faith in my project.
lines.cn: 我要感谢 Harvey Carlson 对这个项目的信任。

lines.en: But most of all, I would like to thank my family for their love and support all through this adventure.
lines.cn: 但最要感谢的是我的家人，感谢他们在这段旅程中始终给予我的爱和支持。
噢，我真高兴终于结束了。

lines.en: Hope it wins a Pulitzer Prize.
lines.cn: 希望它能得 Pulitzer 奖。

lines.en: I'll settle for an "A" in my photography course.
lines.cn: 我只要摄影课能得"A"就满足了。

lines.en: Ah, Richard, Marilyn, I want you to meet John O'Neill.
lines.cn: 啊 Richard Marilyn 我向你们介绍 John O'Neill。

lines.en: I've been looking forward to meeting your husband, Mrs. Stewart.
lines.cn: Stewart 太太，我一直希望能见到你先生。

lines.en: I'm really impressed by your show.
lines.cn: 你的展览让我留下了深刻的印象。

lines.en: In fact, I'd like your autograph.
lines.cn: 事实上，我想要你的签名。

lines.en: Mr. O'Neill is the publisher of several magazines. O'Neill
lines.cn: O'Neill 先生是几本杂志的出版人。

lines.en: Of course. I've seen you on television.
lines.cn: 当然。我在电视上看见过你。

lines.en: Mr. O'Neill was so impressed with your work O'Neill that he wants to develop it into a magazine concept.
lines.cn: O'Neill 先生对你的作品印象很深，想以此发展一个杂志项目。

lines.en: Well, that sounds very exciting, but where would I fit into the plan?
lines.cn: 这听上去很令人兴奋，不过我在这个计划中担任什么角色呢？

lines.en: I'd like you to be the photo editor of the magazine.
lines.cn: 我想请你担任这本杂志的摄影编辑。
哦 Richard 很令人兴奋！

lines.en: Hold on. Wait a minute, please.
The problem is that I'm a photographer, not an editor.
lines.cn: 问题是我是一个摄影师，不是一个编辑。

lines.en: In fact, I love what I do ... which is going out with a camera and a roll of film and seeing the wonder of humanity.
lines.cn: 其实，我热爱我的工作……带着相机和一卷胶卷出门，去发现人间的奇妙。

lines.en: Now, I appreciate your offer, but I've worked so hard on Family Album, U.S.A., and I'm giving some thought to a new book on a different subject.
lines.cn: 我很感谢你的邀请，不过我为《美国写真集》付出了很多心血，现在又在构思一本不同主题的新书。

lines.en: I'm flattered, but I enjoy taking pictures, and I want to continue doing that.
lines.cn: 承蒙厚爱，我受宠若惊，但我喜欢拍照，也想继续做下去。

lines.en: Thank you, but I'm happy being a photographer.
lines.cn: 谢谢你，但我很乐意继续当摄影师。

lines.en: Richard, I know your next book will be a success. Richard
lines.cn: Richard，我相信你的下一本书会成功。
你真不愧是 Stewart 家的人！
